name: OAI.ShortDraft.complex_row_extraction
statement:
theorem complex_row_extraction {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (rows : Finset α) (primes : Finset β) (row : β → α)
    (A : α → ℂ) (untwisted : α) (error bound : ℝ)
    (herror : 0 ≤ error)
    (hrows : primes.image row ⊆ rows)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn row (primes : Set β))
    (happrox : ∀ p ∈ primes, ‖A untwisted - A (row p)‖ ≤ error)
    (hmean : (∑ u ∈ rows, ‖A u‖ ^ 2) ≤ bound) :
    (primes.card : ℝ) * ‖A untwisted‖ ^ 2 ≤
      2 * bound + 2 * (primes.card : ℝ) * error ^ 2

name: OAI.ShortDraft.finite_row_extraction
statement:
theorem finite_row_extraction {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (rows : Finset α) (primes : Finset β) (row : β → α)
    (a : α → ℝ) (a₀ error bound : ℝ)

    (hinj : Set.InjOn row (primes : Set β))
    (happrox : ∀ p ∈ primes, a₀ ≤ a (row p) + error)

      2 * bound + 2 * (primes.card : ℝ) * error ^ 2

name: OAI.ShortDraft.two_poisson_budget
statement:
theorem two_poisson_budget
    (K X F R B J Δ K' childColumnMass R' : ℝ)
    (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hX : 0 < X) (hF : 0 < F)
    (hB : 0 < B) (hJpos : 0 < J) (hΔpos : 0 < Δ)
    (hJ : J ≤ B ^ 2) (hΔ : B * F ≤ Δ)
    (hK' : K' = K * J / (Δ ^ 2 * B ^ 2))
    (hM' : childColumnMass = X * F * J / (Δ * B ^ 2))
    (hR' : R' ≤ R * Δ) :
    K' * R' / childColumnMass ≤ K * R / (X * F) ∧
      K' ≤ K / (B * F) ^ 2 ∧
      childColumnMass ≤ X * F / (B * F) ∧
      (Δ * B ^ 2 / J) * childColumnMass = X * F

name: OAI.ShortDraft.two_poisson_charge
statement:
theorem two_poisson_charge
    (R R' b0 B F A t ge Δ : ℝ)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hF : 1 ≤ F) (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hge : 0 ≤ ge)
    (hb0B : b0 ≤ B)
    (hR' : R' ≤ R * b0 * t * ge)
    (hΔ : Δ = B * F * A * t * ge) : R' ≤ R * Δ

name: OAI.ShortDraft.two_poisson_cost_identity
statement:
theorem two_poisson_cost_identity
    (K A C d L B F c Y g e Li J t ge v X Δ : ℝ)
    (hK : K ≠ 0) (hC : C ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0) (hL : L ≠ 0)
    (hB : B ≠ 0) (hF : F ≠ 0) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hg : g ≠ 0) (he : e ≠ 0) (hLi : Li ≠ 0)
    (hJ : J ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hY : Y = L ^ 2 * B ^ 4 * F ^ 2 * d / (K * C ^ 2 * J))
    (hM : X = Li / (g * v) * (J * C * e * v))
    (hΔ : Δ = B * F * A * t * ge) :
    (K * A * C / (d * L ^ 2 * B ^ 2 * F * Real.sqrt c)) *
      (Y * g / (e * Li)) *
      ((B * Real.sqrt c / J) * t * ge) * X = Δ * B ^ 2 / J

name: OAI.ShortDraft.two_poisson_scale_substitution
statement:
theorem two_poisson_scale_substitution
    (K X F B L A C d t J Y g e ge v Li K' X' F' Δ : ℝ)
    (hK : K ≠ 0) (hB : B ≠ 0) (hF : F ≠ 0)
    (hA : A ≠ 0) (hC : C ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (ht : t ≠ 0) (hJ : J ≠ 0) (he : e ≠ 0)
    (hge : ge ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hL0 : L ≠ 0)
    (hL : L = X / B ^ 3)
    (hLi : Li = L / (A * C * t))
    (hg : g = e * ge)
    (hY : Y = L ^ 2 * B ^ 4 * F ^ 2 * d / (K * C ^ 2 * J))
    (hK' : K' = d * e ^ 2 * Li ^ 2 / (Y * g ^ 2))
    (hX' : X' = Li / (g * v))
    (hF' : F' = J * C * e * v)
    (hΔ : Δ = B * F * A * t * ge) :
    K' = K * J / (Δ ^ 2 * B ^ 2) ∧
      X' * F' = X * F * J / (Δ * B ^ 2)

name: OAI.ShortDraft.zero_free_of_analytic_identity
statement:
theorem zero_free_of_analytic_identity
    (σ : ℝ) (hσ : σ < 1) (L M W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hL : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ L {s | σ < s.re})
    (hM : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ M {s | σ < s.re})
    (hW : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ W {s | σ < s.re})
    (heq : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → L s * M s = W s)
    (ρ : ℂ) (hρ : σ < ρ.re) (hWρ : W ρ ≠ 0) : L ρ ≠ 0

name: OAI.ShortDraft.zero_free_of_regularized_analytic_identity
statement:
theorem zero_free_of_regularized_analytic_identity
    (σ : ℝ) (hσ : σ < 1) (L Lregular M W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hLregular : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ Lregular {s | σ < s.re})
    (hM : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ M {s | σ < s.re})
    (hW : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ W {s | σ < s.re})
    (hregular : ∀ s : ℂ, σ < s.re → s ≠ 1 →
      Lregular s = (s - 1) * L s)
    (heq : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re →
      Lregular s * M s = (s - 1) * W s)
    (ρ : ℂ) (hρ : σ < ρ.re) (hρone : ρ ≠ 1)
    (hWρ : W ρ ≠ 0) : L ρ ≠ 0

name: OAI.ShortDraftLocal.active_zero_local_row
statement:
theorem active_zero_local_row (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ)
    (hχ₂ : χ ^ 2 ≠ 1) (ε x : F) :
    (∑ h : Fˣ, ((χ⁻¹) ^ 2) (h : F) *
      ψ ((ε * x) * ((h⁻¹ : Fˣ) : F))) =
      (χ ^ 2)⁻¹ ε * gaussSum (χ ^ 2) ψ * (χ ^ 2)⁻¹ x

name: OAI.ShortDraftLocal.additive_unit_sum
statement:
theorem additive_unit_sum (ψ : AddChar F ℂ) (hψ : ψ ≠ 1) (a : F) :
    (∑ y : Fˣ, ψ (a * (y : F))) =
      if a = 0 then (Fintype.card Fˣ : ℂ) else -1

name: OAI.ShortDraftLocal.gaussSum_eq_units_sum
statement:
theorem gaussSum_eq_units_sum (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ) :
    gaussSum χ ψ = ∑ y : Fˣ, χ (y : F) * ψ (y : F)

name: OAI.ShortDraftLocal.gaussSum_mulShift_any
statement:
theorem gaussSum_mulShift_any (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ)
    (hχ : χ ≠ 1) (a : F) :
    gaussSum χ (ψ.mulShift a) = χ⁻¹ a * gaussSum χ ψ

name: OAI.ShortDraftLocal.nontrivial_fourier_coefficient
statement:
theorem nontrivial_fourier_coefficient (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ)
    (hχ : χ ≠ 1) (h : F) :
    (∑ t : F, χ t * ψ (-(h * t))) =
      χ⁻¹ h * gaussSum χ (ψ.mulShift (-1))

name: OAI.ShortDraftLocal.sextic_character_exponent
statement:
theorem sextic_character_exponent (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (hχ : χ ^ 6 = 1) :
    χ⁻¹ * χ⁻¹ ^ 2 = χ ^ 3

name: OAI.ShortDraftLocal.sextic_character_quadratic
statement:
theorem sextic_character_quadratic (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (hχ : χ ^ 6 = 1) :
    (χ ^ 3)⁻¹ = χ ^ 3

name: OAI.ShortDraftLocal.sextic_fourier_theta_row
statement:
theorem sextic_fourier_theta_row (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ)
    (hχ : χ ^ 6 = 1) (hχ₃ : χ ^ 3 ≠ 1)
    (σ : Fˣ) (ε x : F) :
    (Fintype.card F : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      (∑ h : Fˣ,
        (∑ t : F, χ t * ψ (-(h * t))) *
        (((χ⁻¹) ^ 2) (σ * h)) *
        ψ ((ε * x) * ((h⁻¹ : Fˣ) : F))) =
      ((χ⁻¹) ^ 2) σ *
      ((Fintype.card F : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        gaussSum χ (ψ.mulShift (-1)) * gaussSum (χ ^ 3) ψ * (χ ^ 3) ε) *
      (χ ^ 3) x

name: OAI.ShortDraftLocal.sextic_fourth_mask
statement:
theorem sextic_fourth_mask (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ)
    (hχ : χ ^ 6 = 1) (hψ : ψ ≠ 1) (a : F) :
    (∑ h : Fˣ, ((χ⁻¹) ^ 4 * (χ⁻¹) ^ 2) h *
      ψ (a * ((h⁻¹ : Fˣ) : F))) =
      if a = 0 then (Fintype.card Fˣ : ℂ) else -1

name: OAI.ShortDraftLocal.sextic_inversion_gaussSum
statement:
theorem sextic_inversion_gaussSum (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ)
    (hχ : χ ^ 6 = 1) (a : F) :
    (∑ h : Fˣ, (χ⁻¹ * χ⁻¹ ^ 2) h * ψ (a * ((h⁻¹ : Fˣ) : F))) =
      gaussSum (χ ^ 3) (ψ.mulShift a)

name: OAI.ShortDraftLocal.sextic_inversion_sum
statement:
theorem sextic_inversion_sum (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ)
    (hχ : χ ^ 6 = 1) (a : F) :
    (∑ h : Fˣ, (χ⁻¹ * χ⁻¹ ^ 2) h * ψ (a * ((h⁻¹ : Fˣ) : F))) =
      ∑ y : Fˣ, (χ ^ 3) y * ψ (a * (y : F))

name: OAI.ShortDraftLocal.sextic_local_row
statement:
theorem sextic_local_row (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ)
    (hχ : χ ^ 6 = 1) (hχ₃ : χ ^ 3 ≠ 1) (ε x : F) :
    (∑ h : Fˣ, (χ⁻¹ * χ⁻¹ ^ 2) h * ψ ((ε * x) * ((h⁻¹ : Fˣ) : F))) =
      (χ ^ 3) ε * gaussSum (χ ^ 3) ψ * (χ ^ 3) x

name: OAI.ShortDraftLocal.trivial_fourier_coefficient
statement:
theorem trivial_fourier_coefficient (ψ : AddChar F ℂ)
    (hψ : ψ ≠ 1) (h : F) :
    (∑ t : F, (1 : MulChar F ℂ) t * ψ (-(h * t))) =
      if h = 0 then (Fintype.card Fˣ : ℂ) else -1

name: OAI.AnalyticBridge.b0_count_scale
statement:
theorem b0_count_scale
    (b0 J2 s c B : ℝ)

name: OAI.AnalyticBridge.fiber_mass_bound
statement:
theorem fiber_mass_bound {Λ : Type*} [DecidableEq Λ]
    (S : Finset Ω) (T : Finset Λ) (label : Ω → Λ)
    (weight : Ω → ℝ) (A : Λ → ℂ) (M : ℝ)
    (hmap : ∀ ω ∈ S, label ω ∈ T)
    (hfiber : ∀ a ∈ T,
      (∑ ω ∈ S with label ω = a, weight ω) ≤ M) :
    (∑ ω ∈ S, weight ω * ‖A (label ω)‖ ^ 2) ≤
      M * (∑ a ∈ T, ‖A a‖ ^ 2)

name: OAI.AnalyticBridge.four_factor_label_count

name: OAI.AnalyticBridge.reassembled_bilinear_bound
statement:
theorem reassembled_bilinear_bound
    {Λ₁ Λ₂ : Type*} [DecidableEq Λ₁] [DecidableEq Λ₂]
    (S : Finset Ω) (T₁ : Finset Λ₁) (T₂ : Finset Λ₂)
    (label₁ : Ω → Λ₁) (label₂ : Ω → Λ₂)
    (w : Ω → ℂ) (A : Λ₁ → ℂ) (B : Λ₂ → ℂ)
    (M₁ M₂ : ℝ)
    (hM₁ : 0 ≤ M₁)
    (hmap₁ : ∀ ω ∈ S, label₁ ω ∈ T₁)
    (hmap₂ : ∀ ω ∈ S, label₂ ω ∈ T₂)
    (hfiber₁ : ∀ a ∈ T₁,
      (∑ ω ∈ S with label₁ ω = a, ‖w ω‖) ≤ M₁)
    (hfiber₂ : ∀ a ∈ T₂,
      (∑ ω ∈ S with label₂ ω = a, ‖w ω‖) ≤ M₂) :
    ‖∑ ω ∈ S, w ω * A (label₁ ω) * star (B (label₂ ω))‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (M₁ * ∑ a ∈ T₁, ‖A a‖ ^ 2) *
        (M₂ * ∑ a ∈ T₂, ‖B a‖ ^ 2)

name: OAI.AnalyticBridge.square_label_count
statement:
theorem square_label_count (F : Finset ℕ) (y E : ℕ)

name: OAI.AnalyticBridge.weighted_cauchy_sq
statement:

    ‖∑ ω ∈ S, w ω * U ω * star (V ω)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ ω ∈ S, ‖w ω‖ * ‖U ω‖ ^ 2) *
        (∑ ω ∈ S, ‖w ω‖ * ‖V ω‖ ^ 2)

name: OAI.ExpBound.exp_neg_le_half

name: OAI.ExpBound.norm_tsum_exp_le_two
statement:
theorem norm_tsum_exp_le_two

name: OAI.ShortDraftMellin.dirichlet_exp_mellin_identity
statement:
theorem dirichlet_exp_mellin_identity
    {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q)
    (s : ℂ) (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    χ.LFunction s *
      mellin (fun D : ℝ => mobiusExpSum χ D⁻¹) (-s) =
        Complex.Gamma s

name: OAI.ShortDraftMellin.dirichlet_exp_zero_free_of_power_bound
statement:
theorem dirichlet_exp_zero_free_of_power_bound
    {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hχ : χ ≠ 1)
    (σ : ℝ) (hσpos : 0 < σ) (hσ : σ < 1)
    (hlocal : LocallyIntegrableOn
      (fun D : ℝ => mobiusExpSum χ D⁻¹) (Set.Ioi 0))
    (htop : (fun D : ℝ => mobiusExpSum χ D⁻¹) =O[atTop]
      (fun D : ℝ => D ^ σ))
    (hflat : ∀ b : ℝ,
      (fun D : ℝ => mobiusExpSum χ D⁻¹) =O[𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)]
        (fun D : ℝ => D ^ b))
    (ρ : ℂ) (hρ : σ < ρ.re) : χ.LFunction ρ ≠ 0

name: OAI.ShortDraftMellin.dirichlet_exponential_mellin_identity
statement:
theorem dirichlet_exponential_mellin_identity
    {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N)
    (F : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hF : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
      HasSum (fun n : ℕ =>
        χ n * (ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℂ) *
          Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) * t)) (F t))
    (s : ℂ) (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    χ.LFunction s * mellin (fun D : ℝ => F D⁻¹) (-s) =
      Complex.Gamma s

name: OAI.ShortDraftMellin.dirichlet_zero_free_of_mellin_bound
statement:
theorem dirichlet_zero_free_of_mellin_bound
    {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (hχ : χ ≠ 1)
    (σ : ℝ) (hσ : σ < 1)
    (A : ℝ → ℂ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hlocal : LocallyIntegrableOn A (Set.Ioi 0))
    (htop : A =O[atTop] (fun t : ℝ => t ^ σ))
    (hzero : A =ᶠ[𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)] (fun _ => 0))
    (hW : Differentiable ℂ W)
    (heq : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re →
      χ.LFunction s * mellin A (-s) = W s)
    (ρ : ℂ) (hρ : σ < ρ.re) (hWρ : W ρ ≠ 0) :
    χ.LFunction ρ ≠ 0

name: OAI.ShortDraftMellin.inverse_mellin_analytic

name: OAI.ShortDraftMellin.mellin_of_exponential_smoothing
statement:
theorem mellin_of_exponential_smoothing
    (a : ℕ → ℂ) (F : ℝ → ℂ) (s : ℂ)
    (hs : 1 < s.re) (ha0 : a 0 = 0)
    (hF : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
      HasSum (fun n : ℕ => a n * Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) * t)) (F t))

name: OAI.ShortDraftMellin.mobius_char_exp_summable
statement:
theorem mobius_char_exp_summable
    {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ =>
      χ n * (ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℂ) *
        Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) * t))

name: OAI.FiniteFieldSieve.character_gauss_expansion
statement:
theorem character_gauss_expansion (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ)
    (hχ : χ ≠ 1) (n : F) :
    χ n * gaussSum χ⁻¹ ψ =
      ∑ u : F, χ⁻¹ u * ψ (n * u)

name: OAI.FiniteFieldSieve.character_sum_le_additive_energy
statement:
theorem character_sum_le_additive_energy {ι : Type*} (I : Finset ι)
    (n : ι → F) (a : ι → ℂ) (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ)
    (hχ : χ ≠ 1) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ I, a i * χ (n i)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ u : F, ‖∑ i ∈ I, a i * ψ (n i * u)‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.FiniteFieldSieve.gauss_shift_all
statement:
theorem gauss_shift_all (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ)
    (hχ : χ ≠ 1) (n : F) :
    gaussSum χ (ψ.mulShift n) = χ⁻¹ n * gaussSum χ ψ

name: OAI.FiniteFieldSieve.primitive_gauss_norm_sq
statement:
theorem primitive_gauss_norm_sq (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ)
    (hχ : χ ≠ 1) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    ‖gaussSum χ ψ‖ ^ 2 = (Fintype.card F : ℝ)

name: OAI.FiniteRingSieve.complete_character_plancherel
statement:
theorem complete_character_plancherel (a : Rˣ → ℂ) :
    (∑ χ : MulChar R ℂ, ‖∑ u : Rˣ, a u * χ (u : R)‖ ^ 2) =
      (Fintype.card Rˣ : ℝ) * ∑ u : Rˣ, ‖a u‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.FiniteRingSieve.sum_chars
statement:
theorem sum_chars (a : R) :
    (∑ χ : MulChar R ℂ, χ a) =
      if a = 1 then (Fintype.card Rˣ : ℂ) else 0

name: OAI.FiniteRingSieve.unit_char_orthogonal
statement:
theorem unit_char_orthogonal (u v : Rˣ) :
    (∑ χ : MulChar R ℂ, star (χ (u : R)) * χ (v : R)) =
      if u = v then (Fintype.card Rˣ : ℂ) else 0

name: OAI.FourierBridge.coefficientMomentBound_nonneg
statement:
theorem coefficientMomentBound_nonneg (J : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    0 ≤ coefficientMomentBound J C

name: OAI.FourierBridge.coupled_cutoff_active
statement:
theorem coupled_cutoff_active
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (W : ι → ℝ → ℂ) (V : ℝ → ℂ) (a y M : ι → ℝ)
    (hwindow : ∀ j z, W j z ≠ 0 → |z| ≤ M j)
    (hVone : ∀ s,
      |s| ≤ ∑ j : ι, |a j| * M j → V s = 1)
    (hprod : (∏ j : ι, W j (y j)) ≠ 0) :
    V (∑ j : ι, a j * y j) = 1

name: OAI.FourierBridge.coupled_factor_derivative_bound
statement:
theorem coupled_factor_derivative_bound
    (F : ℝ → ℂ) (R a y H CF : ℝ) (A n j : ℕ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hH : 1 ≤ H)
    (ha : |a| ≤ H) (hexp : Real.exp (a * y) ≤ H)
    (hj : j ≤ n)
    (_hCF : 0 ≤ CF)
    (hFdecay : ∀ i ≤ n, ∀ u, 0 ≤ u →
      (1 + u) ^ (A + n) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F u‖ ≤ CF) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun z : ℝ => F (R * Real.exp (a * z))) y‖ ≤
      j.factorial * (CF / (1 + R * Real.exp (a * y)) ^ (A + n)) *
        (H ^ 2 * (1 + R)) ^ j

name: OAI.FourierBridge.coupled_factor_uniform_derivative
statement:
theorem coupled_factor_uniform_derivative
    (F : ℝ → ℂ) (R a y m H CF : ℝ) (A n j : ℕ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hm : 0 < m) (hm1 : m ≤ 1)
    (hH : 1 ≤ H) (ha : |a| ≤ H)
    (hexpLower : m ≤ Real.exp (a * y))
    (hexpUpper : Real.exp (a * y) ≤ H)
    (hj : j ≤ n) (hCF : 0 ≤ CF)
    (hFdecay : ∀ i ≤ n, ∀ u, 0 ≤ u →
      (1 + u) ^ (A + n) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F u‖ ≤ CF) :
    m ^ (A + n) * (1 + R) ^ A *
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun z : ℝ => F (R * Real.exp (a * z))) y‖ ≤
        (j.factorial : ℝ) * CF * (H ^ 2) ^ j

name: OAI.FourierBridge.coupled_log_coefficient_bound
statement:
theorem coupled_log_coefficient_bound
    (V F : ℝ → ℂ) (R m H L CW CF : ℝ) (A J : ℕ)
    (hVc : HasCompactSupport V)
    (hVs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) (hFs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hm : 0 < m) (hm1 : m ≤ 1)
    (hH : 1 ≤ H) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hCW : 0 ≤ CW) (hCF : 0 ≤ CF)
    (hVderiv : ∀ i ≤ J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower, ∀ y,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i V y‖ ≤ CW)
    (hwindow : ∀ y,
      (∃ i ≤ J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i V y‖ ≠ 0) →
        m ≤ Real.exp y ∧ Real.exp y ≤ H ∧ |y| ≤ L)
    (hFdecay : ∀ j ≤ J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower,
      ∀ i ≤ j, ∀ u, 0 ≤ u →
        (1 + u) ^ (A + j) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F u‖ ≤ CF) :
    (m ^ (A + (J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower)) *
      (1 + R) ^ A) *
      (∫ t : ℝ, (1 + ‖t‖) ^ J *
        ‖(𝓕 (logProfile V F R 1 hVc hVs hFs)) t‖) ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ J *
        (coefficientMomentBound 0
          (profileMomentConstant (J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower)
            L H CW CF) +
        coefficientMomentBound J
          (profileMomentConstant (J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower)
            L H CW CF))

name: OAI.FourierBridge.coupled_log_separation
statement:
theorem coupled_log_separation
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (W : ι → ℝ → ℂ) (F V : ℝ → ℂ) (R : ℝ)
    (a y : ι → ℝ)
    (hVc : HasCompactSupport V)
    (hVs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V)
    (hFs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F)
    (hactive : (∏ j : ι, W j (y j)) ≠ 0 →
      V (∑ j : ι, a j * y j) = 1) :
    (∏ j : ι, W j (y j)) *
      F (R * Real.exp (∑ j : ι, a j * y j)) =
      ∫ t : ℝ,
        (∏ j : ι, W j (y j) * logPhase t (a j * y j)) *
          (𝓕 (logProfile V F R 1 hVc hVs hFs)) t

name: OAI.FourierBridge.derivative_scale_absorption
statement:
theorem derivative_scale_absorption
    (R u m H CF : ℝ) (A n j : ℕ)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hm : 0 < m)
    (_hH : 0 ≤ H) (hCF : 0 ≤ CF)
    (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hlower : m * (1 + R) ≤ 1 + u)
    (hj : j ≤ n) :
    m ^ (A + n) * (1 + R) ^ A *
      ((j.factorial : ℝ) * (CF / (1 + u) ^ (A + n)) *
        (H ^ 2 * (1 + R)) ^ j) ≤
      (j.factorial : ℝ) * CF * (H ^ 2) ^ j

name: OAI.FourierBridge.exp_argument_derivative_bound
statement:
theorem exp_argument_derivative_bound
    (R a y H : ℝ) (i : ℕ)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hH : 1 ≤ H)
    (ha : |a| ≤ H) (hexp : Real.exp (a * y) ≤ H)
    (hi : 1 ≤ i) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z : ℝ => R * Real.exp (a * z)) y‖ ≤
      (H ^ 2 * (1 + R)) ^ i

name: OAI.FourierBridge.fourier_coefficient_moment
statement:
theorem fourier_coefficient_moment (g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (J : ℕ) :
    ∫ t : ℝ, ‖t‖ ^ J * ‖(𝓕 g) t‖ ≤
      (2 ^ (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower *
        ∫ t : ℝ, (1 + ‖t‖) ^ (-(volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower : ℝ)) *
      ((SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0) (𝓕 g) +
        (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ (J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower) 0) (𝓕 g))

name: OAI.FourierBridge.fourier_seminorm_from_derivative_integrals
statement:
theorem fourier_seminorm_from_derivative_integrals
    (g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (k : ℕ) :
    (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k 0) (𝓕 g) ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ k *
        ∑ p ∈ Finset.range 1 ×ˢ Finset.range (k + 1),
          ∫ v : ℝ, ‖v‖ ^ p.1 * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ p.2 g v‖

name: OAI.FourierBridge.logPhase_add
statement:
theorem logPhase_add (t u v : ℝ) :
    logPhase t (u + v) = logPhase t u * logPhase t v

name: OAI.FourierBridge.logPhase_sum
statement:
theorem logPhase_sum {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (t : ℝ) (z : ι → ℝ) :
    logPhase t (∑ i ∈ s, z i) = ∏ i ∈ s, logPhase t (z i)

name: OAI.FourierBridge.logPhase_zero
statement: theorem logPhase_zero (t : ℝ) : logPhase t 0 = 1

name: OAI.FourierBridge.logProfile_apply
statement:
theorem logProfile_apply
    (W : ℝ → ℂ) (F : ℝ → ℂ) (R a y : ℝ)
    (hWc : HasCompactSupport W)
    (hWs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W)
    (hFs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) :
    logProfile W F R a hWc hWs hFs y = W y * F (R * Real.exp (a * y))

name: OAI.FourierBridge.logProfile_coefficient_integrable
statement:
theorem logProfile_coefficient_integrable
    (W F : ℝ → ℂ) (R a : ℝ) (J : ℕ)
    (hWc : HasCompactSupport W)
    (hWs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W)
    (hFs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) :
    Integrable (fun t : ℝ => ‖t‖ ^ J *
      ‖(𝓕 (logProfile W F R a hWc hWs hFs)) t‖) volume

name: OAI.FourierBridge.logProfile_coefficient_moment
statement:
theorem logProfile_coefficient_moment
    (W F : ℝ → ℂ) (R a : ℝ) (J : ℕ)
    (hWc : HasCompactSupport W)
    (hWs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W)
    (hFs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) :
    ∫ t : ℝ, ‖t‖ ^ J * ‖(𝓕 (logProfile W F R a hWc hWs hFs)) t‖ ≤
      (2 ^ (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower *
        ∫ t : ℝ, (1 + ‖t‖) ^ (-(volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower : ℝ)) *
      ((SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0)
          (𝓕 (logProfile W F R a hWc hWs hFs)) +
        (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ (J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower) 0)
          (𝓕 (logProfile W F R a hWc hWs hFs)))

name: OAI.FourierBridge.logProfile_derivative_decay
statement:
theorem logProfile_derivative_decay
    (W F : ℝ → ℂ) (R a m H CW CF : ℝ) (A n : ℕ)
    (hWs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W) (hFs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hm : 0 < m) (hm1 : m ≤ 1)
    (hH : 1 ≤ H) (ha : |a| ≤ H)
    (hCW : 0 ≤ CW) (hCF : 0 ≤ CF)
    (hWderiv : ∀ i ≤ n, ∀ y,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i W y‖ ≤ CW)
    (hwindow : ∀ y,
      (∃ i ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i W y‖ ≠ 0) →
        m ≤ Real.exp (a * y) ∧ Real.exp (a * y) ≤ H)
    (hFdecay : ∀ i ≤ n, ∀ u, 0 ≤ u →
      (1 + u) ^ (A + n) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F u‖ ≤ CF)
    (y : ℝ) :
    m ^ (A + n) * (1 + R) ^ A *
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z : ℝ => W z * F (R * Real.exp (a * z))) y‖ ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (n.choose i : ℝ) * CW *
          ((n - i).factorial * CF * (H ^ 2) ^ (n - i))

name: OAI.FourierBridge.logProfile_pointwise_decay
statement:
theorem logProfile_pointwise_decay
    (W F : ℝ → ℂ) (R a m CW CF : ℝ) (A : ℕ)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hm : 0 < m) (hm1 : m ≤ 1)
    (hCW : 0 ≤ CW) (hCF : 0 ≤ CF)
    (hWbound : ∀ y, ‖W y‖ ≤ CW)
    (hlower : ∀ y, W y ≠ 0 → m ≤ Real.exp (a * y))
    (hFdecay : ∀ u, 0 ≤ u → (1 + u) ^ A * ‖F u‖ ≤ CF)
    (y : ℝ) :
    m ^ A * (1 + R) ^ A * ‖W y * F (R * Real.exp (a * y))‖ ≤
      CW * CF

name: OAI.FourierBridge.logProfile_uniform_seminorm
statement:
theorem logProfile_uniform_seminorm
    (W F : ℝ → ℂ) (R a m H L CW CF : ℝ) (A n k : ℕ)
    (hWc : HasCompactSupport W)
    (hWs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W) (hFs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hm : 0 < m) (hm1 : m ≤ 1)
    (hH : 1 ≤ H) (ha : |a| ≤ H)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hCW : 0 ≤ CW) (hCF : 0 ≤ CF)
    (hWderiv : ∀ i ≤ n, ∀ y,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i W y‖ ≤ CW)
    (hwindow : ∀ y,
      (∃ i ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i W y‖ ≠ 0) →
        m ≤ Real.exp (a * y) ∧
        Real.exp (a * y) ≤ H ∧ |y| ≤ L)
    (hFdecay : ∀ i ≤ n, ∀ u, 0 ≤ u →
      (1 + u) ^ (A + n) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F u‖ ≤ CF) :
    m ^ (A + n) * (1 + R) ^ A *
      (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n) (logProfile W F R a hWc hWs hFs) ≤
      L ^ k * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (n.choose i : ℝ) * CW *
          ((n - i).factorial * CF * (H ^ 2) ^ (n - i)))

name: OAI.FourierBridge.logProfile_zero_seminorm_decay
statement:
theorem logProfile_zero_seminorm_decay
    (W F : ℝ → ℂ) (R a m CW CF : ℝ) (A : ℕ)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hm : 0 < m) (hm1 : m ≤ 1)
    (hCW : 0 ≤ CW) (hCF : 0 ≤ CF)
    (hWbound : ∀ y, ‖W y‖ ≤ CW)
    (hlower : ∀ y, W y ≠ 0 → m ≤ Real.exp (a * y))
    (hFdecay : ∀ u, 0 ≤ u → (1 + u) ^ A * ‖F u‖ ≤ CF)
    (hWc : HasCompactSupport W)
    (hWs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W)
    (hFs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) :
    m ^ A * (1 + R) ^ A *
      (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0) (logProfile W F R a hWc hWs hFs) ≤
      CW * CF

name: OAI.FourierBridge.profileDerivativeConstant_nonneg
statement:
theorem profileDerivativeConstant_nonneg (n : ℕ) (H CW CF : ℝ)
    (hCW : 0 ≤ CW) (hCF : 0 ≤ CF) :
    0 ≤ profileDerivativeConstant n H CW CF

name: OAI.FourierBridge.profileMomentConstant_dominates
statement:
theorem profileMomentConstant_dominates (K j : ℕ) (L H CW CF : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hCW : 0 ≤ CW) (hCF : 0 ≤ CF) (hj : j ≤ K) :
    (1 + L ^ (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower) *
      profileDerivativeConstant j H CW CF ≤
      profileMomentConstant K L H CW CF

name: OAI.FourierBridge.profileMomentConstant_nonneg
statement:
theorem profileMomentConstant_nonneg (K : ℕ) (L H CW CF : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hCW : 0 ≤ CW) (hCF : 0 ≤ CF) :
    0 ≤ profileMomentConstant K L H CW CF

name: OAI.FourierBridge.schwartzDerivativeDecayConstant_nonneg
statement:
theorem schwartzDerivativeDecayConstant_nonneg
    (F : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (M K : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ schwartzDerivativeDecayConstant F M K

name: OAI.FourierBridge.schwartz_derivative_decay_finite
statement:
theorem schwartz_derivative_decay_finite
    (F : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (A K j i : ℕ) (u : ℝ)
    (hj : j ≤ K) (hi : i ≤ j) (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    (1 + u) ^ (A + j) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F u‖ ≤
      schwartzDerivativeDecayConstant F (A + K) K

name: OAI.FourierBridge.schwartz_log_inversion
statement:
theorem schwartz_log_inversion (g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (y : ℝ) :
    g y = ∫ t : ℝ,
      Complex.exp ((↑(2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ t y) * Complex.I)) * (𝓕 g) t

name: OAI.FourierBridge.smooth_log_separation
statement:
theorem smooth_log_separation
    (W : ℝ → ℂ) (F : ℝ → ℂ) (R a y : ℝ)
    (hWc : HasCompactSupport W)
    (hWs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W)
    (hFs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) :
    W y * F (R * Real.exp (a * y)) =
      ∫ t : ℝ, Complex.exp ((↑(2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ t y) * Complex.I)) *
        (𝓕 (logProfile W F R a hWc hWs hFs)) t

name: OAI.FourierBridge.uniform_fourier_coefficient_moment
statement:
theorem uniform_fourier_coefficient_moment
    (g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (J : ℕ) (S C : ℝ)
    (hS : 0 ≤ S) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hsource : ∀ i ≤ J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower,
      S * ((SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 i) g +
        (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower i) g) ≤ C) :
    S * (∫ t : ℝ, ‖t‖ ^ J * ‖(𝓕 g) t‖) ≤
      (2 ^ (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower *
        ∫ t : ℝ, (1 + ‖t‖) ^ (-(volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower : ℝ)) *
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ 0 * (0 + 1) *
        (2 ^ (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower *
          ∫ t : ℝ, (1 + ‖t‖) ^ (-(volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower : ℝ)) * C +
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower) *
          (J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower + 1) *
          (2 ^ (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower *
            ∫ t : ℝ, (1 + ‖t‖) ^ (-(volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower : ℝ)) * C)

name: OAI.FourierBridge.uniform_fourier_one_plus_moment
statement:
theorem uniform_fourier_one_plus_moment
    (g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (J : ℕ) (S C : ℝ)
    (hS : 0 ≤ S) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hsource : ∀ i ≤ J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower,
      S * ((SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 i) g +
        (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower i) g) ≤ C) :
    S * (∫ t : ℝ, (1 + ‖t‖) ^ J * ‖(𝓕 g) t‖) ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ J *
        (coefficientMomentBound 0 C + coefficientMomentBound J C)

name: OAI.FourierBridge.uniform_fourier_seminorm_transfer
statement:
theorem uniform_fourier_seminorm_transfer
    (g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (k : ℕ) (S C : ℝ)
    (hS : 0 ≤ S) (_hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hsource : ∀ i ≤ k,
      S * ((SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 i) g +
        (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower i) g) ≤ C) :
    S * (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k 0) (𝓕 g) ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (k + 1) *
        (2 ^ (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower *
          ∫ t : ℝ, (1 + ‖t‖) ^ (-(volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower : ℝ)) * C

name: OAI.FourierBridge.uniform_logProfile_coefficient_moment
statement:
theorem uniform_logProfile_coefficient_moment
    (W F : ℝ → ℂ) (R a m H L CW CF C : ℝ) (A J : ℕ)
    (hWc : HasCompactSupport W)
    (hWs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W) (hFs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hm : 0 < m) (hm1 : m ≤ 1)
    (hH : 1 ≤ H) (ha : |a| ≤ H)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hCW : 0 ≤ CW) (hCF : 0 ≤ CF) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hWderiv : ∀ i ≤ J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower, ∀ y,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i W y‖ ≤ CW)
    (hwindow : ∀ y,
      (∃ i ≤ J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i W y‖ ≠ 0) →
        m ≤ Real.exp (a * y) ∧
        Real.exp (a * y) ≤ H ∧ |y| ≤ L)
    (hFdecay : ∀ j ≤ J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower,
      ∀ i ≤ j, ∀ u, 0 ≤ u →
        (1 + u) ^ (A + j) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F u‖ ≤ CF)
    (hCbound : ∀ j ≤ J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower,
      (1 + L ^ (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower) *
        profileDerivativeConstant j H CW CF ≤ C) :
    (m ^ (A + (J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower)) *
      (1 + R) ^ A) *
      (∫ t : ℝ, ‖t‖ ^ J *
        ‖(𝓕 (logProfile W F R a hWc hWs hFs)) t‖) ≤
      (2 ^ (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower *
        ∫ t : ℝ, (1 + ‖t‖) ^ (-(volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower : ℝ)) *
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ 0 * (0 + 1) *
        (2 ^ (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower *
          ∫ t : ℝ, (1 + ‖t‖) ^ (-(volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower : ℝ)) * C +
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower) *
          (J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower + 1) *
          (2 ^ (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower *
            ∫ t : ℝ, (1 + ‖t‖) ^ (-(volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower : ℝ)) * C)

name: OAI.FourierBridge.uniform_logProfile_coefficient_moment_explicit
statement:
theorem uniform_logProfile_coefficient_moment_explicit
    (W F : ℝ → ℂ) (R a m H L CW CF : ℝ) (A J : ℕ)
    (hWc : HasCompactSupport W)
    (hWs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W) (hFs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hm : 0 < m) (hm1 : m ≤ 1)
    (hH : 1 ≤ H) (ha : |a| ≤ H)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hCW : 0 ≤ CW) (hCF : 0 ≤ CF)
    (hWderiv : ∀ i ≤ J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower, ∀ y,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i W y‖ ≤ CW)
    (hwindow : ∀ y,
      (∃ i ≤ J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i W y‖ ≠ 0) →
        m ≤ Real.exp (a * y) ∧
        Real.exp (a * y) ≤ H ∧ |y| ≤ L)
    (hFdecay : ∀ j ≤ J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower,
      ∀ i ≤ j, ∀ u, 0 ≤ u →
        (1 + u) ^ (A + j) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F u‖ ≤ CF) :
    (m ^ (A + (J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower)) *
      (1 + R) ^ A) *
      (∫ t : ℝ, ‖t‖ ^ J *
        ‖(𝓕 (logProfile W F R a hWc hWs hFs)) t‖) ≤
      (2 ^ (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower *
        ∫ t : ℝ, (1 + ‖t‖) ^ (-(volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower : ℝ)) *
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ 0 * (0 + 1) *
        (2 ^ (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower *
          ∫ t : ℝ, (1 + ‖t‖) ^ (-(volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower : ℝ)) *
          profileMomentConstant (J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower)
            L H CW CF +
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower) *
          (J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower + 1) *
          (2 ^ (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower *
            ∫ t : ℝ, (1 + ‖t‖) ^ (-(volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower : ℝ)) *
          profileMomentConstant (J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower)
            L H CW CF)

name: OAI.FourierBridge.uniform_logProfile_source_pair
statement:
theorem uniform_logProfile_source_pair
    (W F : ℝ → ℂ) (R a m H L CW CF C : ℝ) (A K n : ℕ)
    (hWc : HasCompactSupport W)
    (hWs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W) (hFs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hm : 0 < m) (hm1 : m ≤ 1)
    (hH : 1 ≤ H) (ha : |a| ≤ H)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hCW : 0 ≤ CW) (hCF : 0 ≤ CF)
    (hn : n ≤ K)
    (hWderiv : ∀ i ≤ K, ∀ y,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i W y‖ ≤ CW)
    (hwindow : ∀ y,
      (∃ i ≤ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i W y‖ ≠ 0) →
        m ≤ Real.exp (a * y) ∧
        Real.exp (a * y) ≤ H ∧ |y| ≤ L)
    (hFdecay : ∀ j ≤ K, ∀ i ≤ j, ∀ u, 0 ≤ u →
      (1 + u) ^ (A + j) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F u‖ ≤ CF)
    (hCbound : ∀ j ≤ K,
      (1 + L ^ (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower) *
        profileDerivativeConstant j H CW CF ≤ C) :
    (m ^ (A + K) * (1 + R) ^ A) *
      ((SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n)
          (logProfile W F R a hWc hWs hFs) +
        (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower n)
          (logProfile W F R a hWc hWs hFs)) ≤ C

name: OAI.ShortDraftCRT.addChar_congr_of_dvd
statement:
theorem addChar_congr_of_dvd
    (ι : R →+* K) (ψ : AddChar K ℂ) (lam d a b x : R)
    (hlam : ι lam ≠ 0) (hd : ι d ≠ 0)
    (hperiod : ∀ y : R, ψ (ι y / ι lam) = 1)
    (hcong : d ∣ a - b) :
    ψ (ι a * ι x / (ι lam * ι d)) =
      ψ (ι b * ι x / (ι lam * ι d))

name: OAI.ShortDraftCRT.addChar_crt_list_codifferent
statement:
theorem addChar_crt_list_codifferent (ι : R →+* K) (ψ : AddChar K ℂ)
    (lam z : R) (ps : List R)
    (hlam : ι lam ≠ 0)
    (hperiod : ∀ y : R, ψ (ι y / ι lam) = 1)
    (hpair : ps.Pairwise IsCoprime)
    (hp : ∀ p ∈ ps, ι p ≠ 0) :
    ∃ ws : List R, ws.length = ps.length ∧
      ψ (ι z / (ι lam * ι ps.prod)) =
        (List.zipWith (fun p w => ψ (ι (w * z) / (ι lam * ι p))) ps ws).prod

name: OAI.ShortDraftCRT.addChar_crt_of_isCoprime
statement:
theorem addChar_crt_of_isCoprime
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (ι : R →+* K) (ψ : AddChar K ℂ)
    (m n : R) (z : K)
    (hcop : IsCoprime n m) (hm : ι m ≠ 0) (hn : ι n ≠ 0) :
    ∃ u v : R,
      u * n + v * m = 1 ∧
      ψ (z / (ι m * ι n)) =
        ψ (ι u * z / ι m) * ψ (ι v * z / ι n)

name: OAI.ShortDraftCRT.addChar_crt_pair
statement:
theorem addChar_crt_pair (ψ : AddChar K ℂ) (m n u v z : K)
    (hm : m ≠ 0) (hn : n ≠ 0) (hbez : u * n + v * m = 1) :
    ψ (z / (m * n)) = ψ (u * z / m) * ψ (v * z / n)

name: OAI.ShortDraftCRT.bezout_with_lam_cube
statement:
theorem bezout_with_lam_cube {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (lam c₀ r : R)
    (hcop : IsCoprime r (lam ^ 3 * c₀)) :
    ∃ u v : R,
      u * r + v * c₀ = 1 ∧
      lam ^ 3 ∣ v ∧
      lam ^ 3 * c₀ ∣ u * r - 1

    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a c₀ h r : R)

statement:

name: OAI.ShortDraftCRT.crossDen_ne_zero
statement:
theorem crossDen_ne_zero (ι : R →+* K) (c₀ : R)

statement:

name: OAI.ShortDraftCRT.cross_fraction_eq
statement:
theorem cross_fraction_eq (ι : R →+* K) (a c₀ : R)
    (rows : List (R × R)) (hc₀ : ι c₀ ≠ 0)
    (hp : ∀ ph ∈ rows, ι ph.1 ≠ 0) :
    ι (crossNum a c₀ rows) / ι (crossDen c₀ rows) =
      ι a / ι c₀ +
        (rows.map fun ph => ι ph.2 / ι ph.1).sum

name: OAI.ShortDraftCRT.fixed_ray_denominator
statement:
theorem fixed_ray_denominator (a c₀ : R) (rows : List (R × R))

    (hpair : rows.Pairwise fun x y => IsCoprime x.1 y.1) :

      crossDen c₀ rows = c₀ * (rows.map Prod.fst).prod

name: OAI.ShortDraftCRT.local_epsilon_identity
statement:
theorem local_epsilon_identity (lam t σ h : K)
    (hlam : lam ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) (hσ : σ ≠ 0) (hh : h ≠ 0) :
    (-(lam ^ 3 * t * σ)⁻¹) * h⁻¹ * lam ^ 3 =
      -((σ * h)⁻¹) * t⁻¹

name: OAI.ShortDraftCRT.normalized_crt_pair
statement:
theorem normalized_crt_pair {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (ι : R →+* K) (ψ : AddChar K ℂ)
    (lam c₀ r d x u w : R)
    (hlam : ι lam ≠ 0) (hc₀ : ι c₀ ≠ 0) (hr : ι r ≠ 0)
    (hbez : u * r + (lam ^ 3 * w) * c₀ = 1) :
    ψ (-(ι d * (ι x / ι lam ^ 4)) / (ι c₀ * ι r)) =
      ψ (-(ι d * ι u * (ι x / ι lam ^ 4)) / ι c₀) *
        ψ (ι (-d * w * x) / (ι lam * ι r))

name: OAI.ShortDraftDescent.binary_energy_descent
statement:
theorem binary_energy_descent
    {Node : Type*} (rank : Node → ℕ) (energy mass : Node → ℝ)
    (left right : Node → Node) (costLeft costRight : Node → ℝ)
    (henergy : ∀ x, 0 ≤ energy x)
    (hmass : ∀ x, 0 ≤ mass x)
    (hcostLeft : ∀ x, 0 ≤ costLeft x)
    (hcostRight : ∀ x, 0 ≤ costRight x)
    (hterminal : ∀ x, rank x = 0 → energy x ≤ mass x)
    (hstep : ∀ x, rank x ≠ 0 →
      rank (left x) < rank x ∧ rank (right x) < rank x ∧
      energy x ^ 2 ≤
        (costLeft x * energy (left x)) *
          (costRight x * energy (right x)) ∧
      costLeft x * mass (left x) ≤ mass x ∧
      costRight x * mass (right x) ≤ mass x) :
    ∀ x, energy x ≤ mass x

name: OAI.GaussCRT.addChar_crt_factor
statement:
theorem addChar_crt_factor (m n : ℕ) (h : m.Coprime n)
    (ψ : AddChar (ZMod (m * n)) ℂ) (x : ZMod (m * n)) :
    ψ x =
      leftAddChar m n h ψ ((ZMod.chineseRemainder h x).1) *
      rightAddChar m n h ψ ((ZMod.chineseRemainder h x).2)

name: OAI.GaussCRT.crt_left_axis
statement:
theorem crt_left_axis (m n r : ℕ) (h : m.Coprime n)
    [NeZero m] [NeZero n]
    (hr : ((n * r : ℕ) : ZMod m) = 1) (z : ZMod m) :
    (ZMod.chineseRemainder h).symm (z, 0) =
      ((n * r * z.val : ℕ) : ZMod (m * n))

name: OAI.GaussCRT.crt_right_axis
statement:
theorem crt_right_axis (m n r : ℕ) (h : m.Coprime n)
    [NeZero m] [NeZero n]
    (hr : ((m * r : ℕ) : ZMod n) = 1) (z : ZMod n) :
    (ZMod.chineseRemainder h).symm (0, z) =
      ((m * r * z.val : ℕ) : ZMod (m * n))

name: OAI.GaussCRT.gauss_shift_cross
statement:
theorem gauss_shift_cross (m n r : ℕ) [NeZero m]
    (χ : MulChar (ZMod m) ℂ)
    (hr : ((n * r : ℕ) : ZMod m) = 1) :
    gaussSum χ ((ZMod.stdAddChar (N := m)).mulShift (r : ZMod m)) =
      χ (n : ZMod m) * gaussSum χ (ZMod.stdAddChar (N := m))

name: OAI.GaussCRT.gauss_sum_chinese_product
statement:
theorem gauss_sum_chinese_product (m n : ℕ)
    [NeZero m] [NeZero n] [NeZero (m * n)] (h : m.Coprime n)
    (χm : MulChar (ZMod m) ℂ) (χn : MulChar (ZMod n) ℂ)
    (ψm : AddChar (ZMod m) ℂ) (ψn : AddChar (ZMod n) ℂ) :
    (∑ x : ZMod (m * n),
      χm ((ZMod.chineseRemainder h x).1) *
      χn ((ZMod.chineseRemainder h x).2) *
      ψm ((ZMod.chineseRemainder h x).1) *
      ψn ((ZMod.chineseRemainder h x).2)) =
      gaussSum χm ψm * gaussSum χn ψn

name: OAI.GaussCRT.gauss_sum_crt
statement:
theorem gauss_sum_crt (m n : ℕ)
    [NeZero m] [NeZero n] [NeZero (m * n)] (h : m.Coprime n)
    (χm : MulChar (ZMod m) ℂ) (χn : MulChar (ZMod n) ℂ)
    (ψ : AddChar (ZMod (m * n)) ℂ) :
    (∑ x : ZMod (m * n),
      χm ((ZMod.chineseRemainder h x).1) *
      χn ((ZMod.chineseRemainder h x).2) * ψ x) =
      gaussSum χm (leftAddChar m n h ψ) *
      gaussSum χn (rightAddChar m n h ψ)

name: OAI.GaussCRT.gauss_sum_crt_standard
statement:
theorem gauss_sum_crt_standard (m n r s : ℕ)
    [NeZero m] [NeZero n] [NeZero (m * n)]
    (h : m.Coprime n)
    (hr : ((n * r : ℕ) : ZMod m) = 1)
    (hs : ((m * s : ℕ) : ZMod n) = 1)
    (χm : MulChar (ZMod m) ℂ) (χn : MulChar (ZMod n) ℂ) :
    (∑ x : ZMod (m * n),
      χm ((ZMod.chineseRemainder h x).1) *
      χn ((ZMod.chineseRemainder h x).2) *
      (ZMod.stdAddChar (N := m * n)) x) =
      χm (n : ZMod m) * χn (m : ZMod n) *
        gaussSum χm (ZMod.stdAddChar (N := m)) *
        gaussSum χn (ZMod.stdAddChar (N := n))

name: OAI.GaussCRT.leftAddChar_std_apply
statement:
theorem leftAddChar_std_apply (m n r : ℕ) (h : m.Coprime n)
    [NeZero m] [NeZero n] [NeZero (m * n)]
    (hr : ((n * r : ℕ) : ZMod m) = 1) (z : ZMod m) :
    leftAddChar m n h (ZMod.stdAddChar (N := m * n)) z =
      (ZMod.stdAddChar (N := m)) ((r : ZMod m) * z)

name: OAI.GaussCRT.rightAddChar_std_apply
statement:
theorem rightAddChar_std_apply (m n r : ℕ) (h : m.Coprime n)
    [NeZero m] [NeZero n] [NeZero (m * n)]
    (hr : ((m * r : ℕ) : ZMod n) = 1) (z : ZMod n) :
    rightAddChar m n h (ZMod.stdAddChar (N := m * n)) z =
      (ZMod.stdAddChar (N := n)) ((r : ZMod n) * z)

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.addChar_crt_factor
statement:
theorem addChar_crt_factor (e : T ≃+* R × S) (ψ : AddChar T ℂ) (x : T) :
    ψ x = leftAddChar e ψ (e x).1 * rightAddChar e ψ (e x).2

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.bezout_inverse_left
statement:
theorem bezout_inverse_left {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    {a b u v : A} (hbez : u * a + v * b = 1) :
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}) b) *
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}) v) = 1

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.bezout_inverse_right
statement:

    {a b u v : A} (hbez : u * a + v * b = 1) :
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {b}) a) *
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {b}) u) = 1

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.bezout_of_principal_coprime
statement:

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.crt_left_inverse_coordinate
statement:
theorem crt_left_inverse_coordinate {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    {a b u v : A} (hbez : u * a + v * b = 1) (x : A) :
    (Ideal.quotientMulEquivQuotientProd
      (Ideal.span {a}) (Ideal.span {b})
      (principal_coprime_of_bezout hbez)).symm
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}) x, 0) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {a}) * (Ideal.span {b})) (x * v * b)

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.crt_right_inverse_coordinate
statement:
theorem crt_right_inverse_coordinate {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    {a b u v : A} (hbez : u * a + v * b = 1) (y : A) :
    (Ideal.quotientMulEquivQuotientProd
      (Ideal.span {a}) (Ideal.span {b})
      (principal_coprime_of_bezout hbez)).symm
        (0, Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {b}) y) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {a}) * (Ideal.span {b})) (y * u * a)

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.gauss_shift_bezout_left
statement:
theorem gauss_shift_bezout_left {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    {a b u v : A} [Fintype (A ⧸ Ideal.span {a})]
    (hbez : u * a + v * b = 1)
    (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ Ideal.span {a}) ℂ)
    (ψ : AddChar (A ⧸ Ideal.span {a}) ℂ) :
    gaussSum χ (ψ.mulShift (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}) v)) =
      χ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}) b) * gaussSum χ ψ

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.gauss_shift_bezout_right
statement:
theorem gauss_shift_bezout_right {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    {a b u v : A} [Fintype (A ⧸ Ideal.span {b})]
    (hbez : u * a + v * b = 1)
    (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ Ideal.span {b}) ℂ)
    (ψ : AddChar (A ⧸ Ideal.span {b}) ℂ) :
    gaussSum χ (ψ.mulShift (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {b}) u)) =
      χ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {b}) a) * gaussSum χ ψ

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.gauss_sum_crt
statement:
theorem gauss_sum_crt [Fintype T] [Fintype R] [Fintype S]
    (e : T ≃+* R × S) (χR : MulChar R ℂ) (χS : MulChar S ℂ)
    (ψ : AddChar T ℂ) :
    (∑ x : T, χR (e x).1 * χS (e x).2 * ψ x) =
      gaussSum χR (leftAddChar e ψ) * gaussSum χS (rightAddChar e ψ)

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.gauss_sum_ideal_crt
statement:
theorem gauss_sum_ideal_crt {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    (I J : Ideal A) (h : IsCoprime I J)
    [Fintype (A ⧸ I * J)] [Fintype (A ⧸ I)] [Fintype (A ⧸ J)]
    (χI : MulChar (A ⧸ I) ℂ) (χJ : MulChar (A ⧸ J) ℂ)
    (ψ : AddChar (A ⧸ I * J) ℂ) :
    (∑ x : A ⧸ I * J,
      χI (Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.mul_le_left : I * J ≤ I) x) *
      χJ (Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.mul_le_right : I * J ≤ J) x) * ψ x) =
      gaussSum χI (leftAddChar (Ideal.quotientMulEquivQuotientProd I J h) ψ) *
      gaussSum χJ (rightAddChar (Ideal.quotientMulEquivQuotientProd I J h) ψ)

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.gauss_sum_trace_crt
statement:
theorem gauss_sum_trace_crt {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    (ι : A →+* ℂ) (ψ : AddChar ℂ ℂ) (lam : ℂ)
    {a b u v : A} (hbez : u * a + v * b = 1)
    [Fintype (A ⧸ (Ideal.span {a}) * (Ideal.span {b}))]
    [Fintype (A ⧸ Ideal.span {a})]
    [Fintype (A ⧸ Ideal.span {b})]
    (ha : ι a ≠ 0) (hb : ι b ≠ 0) (hlam : lam ≠ 0)
    (hbase : ∀ x : A, ψ (ι x / lam) = 1)
    (χa : MulChar (A ⧸ Ideal.span {a}) ℂ)
    (χb : MulChar (A ⧸ Ideal.span {b}) ℂ) :
    (∑ x : A ⧸ (Ideal.span {a}) * (Ideal.span {b}),
      χa (Ideal.Quotient.factor
        (Ideal.mul_le_left : (Ideal.span {a}) * (Ideal.span {b}) ≤ Ideal.span {a}) x) *
      χb (Ideal.Quotient.factor
        (Ideal.mul_le_right : (Ideal.span {a}) * (Ideal.span {b}) ≤ Ideal.span {b}) x) *
      traceProdChar ι ψ lam a b ha hb hlam hbase x) =
      χa (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}) b) *
      χb (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {b}) a) *
      gaussSum χa (traceModChar ι ψ lam a ha hlam hbase) *
      gaussSum χb (traceModChar ι ψ lam b hb hlam hbase)

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.gauss_sum_trace_crt_of_coprime
statement:
theorem gauss_sum_trace_crt_of_coprime {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    (ι : A →+* ℂ) (ψ : AddChar ℂ ℂ) (lam : ℂ)
    (a b : A)
    (hcop : IsCoprime (Ideal.span {a}) (Ideal.span {b}))
    [Fintype (A ⧸ (Ideal.span {a}) * (Ideal.span {b}))]
    [Fintype (A ⧸ Ideal.span {a})]
    [Fintype (A ⧸ Ideal.span {b})]
    (ha : ι a ≠ 0) (hb : ι b ≠ 0) (hlam : lam ≠ 0)
    (hbase : ∀ x : A, ψ (ι x / lam) = 1)
    (χa : MulChar (A ⧸ Ideal.span {a}) ℂ)
    (χb : MulChar (A ⧸ Ideal.span {b}) ℂ) :
    (∑ x : A ⧸ (Ideal.span {a}) * (Ideal.span {b}),
      χa (Ideal.Quotient.factor
        (Ideal.mul_le_left : (Ideal.span {a}) * (Ideal.span {b}) ≤ Ideal.span {a}) x) *
      χb (Ideal.Quotient.factor
        (Ideal.mul_le_right : (Ideal.span {a}) * (Ideal.span {b}) ≤ Ideal.span {b}) x) *
      traceProdChar ι ψ lam a b ha hb hlam hbase x) =
      χa (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}) b) *
      χb (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {b}) a) *
      gaussSum χa (traceModChar ι ψ lam a ha hlam hbase) *
      gaussSum χb (traceModChar ι ψ lam b hb hlam hbase)

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.leftAddChar_traceProd
statement:
theorem leftAddChar_traceProd {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    (ι : A →+* ℂ) (ψ : AddChar ℂ ℂ) (lam : ℂ)
    {a b u v : A} (hbez : u * a + v * b = 1)
    (ha : ι a ≠ 0) (hb : ι b ≠ 0) (hlam : lam ≠ 0)
    (hbase : ∀ x : A, ψ (ι x / lam) = 1) :
    leftAddChar
      (Ideal.quotientMulEquivQuotientProd (Ideal.span {a}) (Ideal.span {b})
        (principal_coprime_of_bezout hbez))
      (traceProdChar ι ψ lam a b ha hb hlam hbase) =
      (traceModChar ι ψ lam a ha hlam hbase).mulShift
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}) v)

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.principal_coprime_of_bezout
statement:
theorem principal_coprime_of_bezout {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    {a b u v : A} (h : u * a + v * b = 1) :
    IsCoprime (Ideal.span {a}) (Ideal.span {b})

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.quotientAddChar_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientAddChar_mk {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (ψ : AddChar A ℂ)
    (hper : ∀ a : A, a ∈ I → ψ a = 1) (a : A) :
    quotientAddChar I ψ hper (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a) = ψ a

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.rawTraceChar_period
statement:
theorem rawTraceChar_period {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    (ι : A →+* ℂ) (ψ : AddChar ℂ ℂ) (lam : ℂ) (c : A)
    (hc : ι c ≠ 0) (hlam : lam ≠ 0)
    (hbase : ∀ x : A, ψ (ι x / lam) = 1)
    (x : A) (hx : x ∈ Ideal.span {c}) :
    rawTraceChar ι ψ lam c x = 1

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.rightAddChar_traceProd
statement:
theorem rightAddChar_traceProd {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    (ι : A →+* ℂ) (ψ : AddChar ℂ ℂ) (lam : ℂ)
    {a b u v : A} (hbez : u * a + v * b = 1)
    (ha : ι a ≠ 0) (hb : ι b ≠ 0) (hlam : lam ≠ 0)
    (hbase : ∀ x : A, ψ (ι x / lam) = 1) :
    rightAddChar
      (Ideal.quotientMulEquivQuotientProd (Ideal.span {a}) (Ideal.span {b})
        (principal_coprime_of_bezout hbez))
      (traceProdChar ι ψ lam a b ha hb hlam hbase) =
      (traceModChar ι ψ lam b hb hlam hbase).mulShift
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {b}) u)

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.traceModChar_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem traceModChar_mk {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    (ι : A →+* ℂ) (ψ : AddChar ℂ ℂ) (lam : ℂ) (c : A)
    (hc : ι c ≠ 0) (hlam : lam ≠ 0)
    (hbase : ∀ x : A, ψ (ι x / lam) = 1) (x : A) :
    traceModChar ι ψ lam c hc hlam hbase
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c}) x) =
      ψ (ι x / (ι c * lam))

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.traceProdChar_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem traceProdChar_mk {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    (ι : A →+* ℂ) (ψ : AddChar ℂ ℂ) (lam : ℂ) (a b : A)
    (ha : ι a ≠ 0) (hb : ι b ≠ 0) (hlam : lam ≠ 0)
    (hbase : ∀ x : A, ψ (ι x / lam) = 1) (x : A) :
    traceProdChar ι ψ lam a b ha hb hlam hbase
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {a}) * (Ideal.span {b})) x) =
      ψ (ι x / (ι (a * b) * lam))

    ¬ ∃ f : (O ⧸ Finset.univ.prod P) → ℤ,
      ∀ x : O,

    (hcop : IsCoprime lambdaIdeal (Finset.univ.prod P))
    (s : Finset ι) (i₀ : ι) (hi₀ : i₀ ∉ s) :

    (hsame : quadraticProduct P (-1) = quadraticProduct Q (-1))

    correctedQuadraticProduct P x * correctedQuadraticProduct Q x =

    ∃ x : O,

    ¬ ∃ f : (O ⧸ (Finset.univ.erase i₀).prod P) → ℤ,
      ∀ x : O,

name: OAI.ActualEisensteinSieve.finiteQuadratic_not_factor_without_prime
statement:
theorem finiteQuadratic_not_factor_without_prime
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (P : ι → Ideal O)

    (hpair : Pairwise (Function.onFun IsCoprime P))
    (hodd : ∀ i, ringChar (O ⧸ P i) ≠ 2) (i₀ : ι) :
    ¬ ∃ f : ((j : {j : ι // j ≠ i₀}) → O ⧸ P j.1) → ℤ,
      ∀ x : O,
        (∏ j : ι, localQuadratic (P j) x) =

name: OAI.PoissonChildCRT.child_row_label_identity
statement:
theorem child_row_label_identity (hχ : χ ^ 6 = 1)
    (d e k J C v : ℕ) :
    (χ (e : ZMod n))⁻¹ * χ (d : ZMod n) * χ (k : ZMod n) *
        (χ ((J * C : ℕ) : ZMod n)) ^ 4 * (χ (v : ZMod n)) ^ 4
      = χ ((d * e * k : ℕ) : ZMod n) *
        (χ ((J * C * e * v : ℕ) : ZMod n)) ^ 4

name: OAI.PoissonChildCRT.child_row_label_with_mask
statement:
theorem child_row_label_with_mask (hχ : χ ^ 6 = 1)
    (b0 t g e r d k J C v : ℕ) (hg : g = e * r) :
    mask n (b0 * t) * mask n g *
      ((χ (e : ZMod n))⁻¹ * χ (d : ZMod n) * χ (k : ZMod n) *
        (χ ((J * C : ℕ) : ZMod n)) ^ 4 * (χ (v : ZMod n)) ^ 4)
      = mask n (b0 * t * r) *
        (χ ((d * e * k : ℕ) : ZMod n) *
          (χ ((J * C * e * v : ℕ) : ZMod n)) ^ 4)

name: OAI.PoissonChildCRT.inverse_as_row_and_label
statement:
theorem inverse_as_row_and_label (hχ : χ ^ 6 = 1) (e : ℕ) :
    (χ (e : ZMod n))⁻¹ = χ (e : ZMod n) * (χ (e : ZMod n)) ^ 4

statement:
theorem mask_absorb_char (e : ℕ) :

statement:
theorem mask_absorb_inv_char (e : ℕ) :

name: OAI.PoissonChildCRT.mask_mul
statement:
theorem mask_mul (n a b : ℕ) :
    mask n (a * b) = mask n a * mask n b

name: OAI.PoissonChildCRT.sum_child_row_label_with_mask
statement:
theorem sum_child_row_label_with_mask
    (S : Finset ℕ) (χ : (n : ℕ) → MulChar (ZMod n) ℂ)
    (hχ : ∀ n, χ n ^ 6 = 1) (a : ℕ → ℂ)
    (b0 t g e r d k J C v : ℕ) (hg : g = e * r) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, a n *
      (mask n (b0 * t) * mask n g *
        ((χ n (e : ZMod n))⁻¹ * χ n (d : ZMod n) * χ n (k : ZMod n) *
          (χ n ((J * C : ℕ) : ZMod n)) ^ 4 *
          (χ n (v : ZMod n)) ^ 4))) =
    (∑ n ∈ S, a n *
      (mask n (b0 * t * r) *
        (χ n ((d * e * k : ℕ) : ZMod n) *
          (χ n ((J * C * e * v : ℕ) : ZMod n)) ^ 4)))

name: OAI.PoissonFirstLocal.exponent_table
statement:
theorem exponent_table (parityBit ε₁ ε₂ : Bool) :
    totalExp₁ parityBit ε₁ ε₂ % 6 = (if retained parityBit ε₁ ε₂ then 4 else 0) ∧
    totalExp₂ parityBit ε₁ ε₂ % 6 = (if retained parityBit ε₁ ε₂ then 4 else 0)

name: OAI.PoissonFirstLocal.first_local_identity
statement:
theorem first_local_identity (side parityBit ε₁ ε₂ : Bool)
    (n p : ℕ) (χ : MulChar (ZMod n) ℂ) (hχ : χ ^ 6 = 1) :
    oldFactor side parityBit ε₁ ε₂ n p χ = newFactor parityBit ε₁ ε₂ n p χ

name: OAI.PoissonFirstLocal.first_prime_product_identity
statement:
theorem first_prime_product_identity
    (side : Bool) (P : Finset ℕ)
    (parityBit ε₁ ε₂ : ℕ → Bool)
    (n : ℕ) (χ : MulChar (ZMod n) ℂ) (hχ : χ ^ 6 = 1) :
    (∏ p ∈ P, oldFactor side (parityBit p) (ε₁ p) (ε₂ p) n p χ) =
      (χ ((∏ p ∈ P with retained (parityBit p) (ε₁ p) (ε₂ p), p : ℕ) : ZMod n)) ^ 4 *
      mask n (∏ p ∈ P with ¬retained (parityBit p) (ε₁ p) (ε₂ p), p)

name: OAI.PoissonFirstLocal.first_prime_product_with_b0
statement:
theorem first_prime_product_with_b0
    (side : Bool) (P : Finset ℕ)
    (parityBit ε₁ ε₂ : ℕ → Bool)
    (n b₀ m : ℕ) (χ : MulChar (ZMod n) ℂ) (hχ : χ ^ 6 = 1)
    (hB : (∏ p ∈ P with ¬retained (parityBit p) (ε₁ p) (ε₂ p), p) ∣ b₀)
    (hb : b₀ ∣
      ((∏ p ∈ P with ¬retained (parityBit p) (ε₁ p) (ε₂ p), p) *
       (∏ p ∈ P with retained (parityBit p) (ε₁ p) (ε₂ p), p)) ^ m) :
    (∏ p ∈ P, oldFactor side (parityBit p) (ε₁ p) (ε₂ p) n p χ) =
      (χ ((∏ p ∈ P with retained (parityBit p) (ε₁ p) (ε₂ p), p : ℕ) : ZMod n)) ^ 4 *
      mask n b₀

name: OAI.PoissonFirstLocal.mask_redundant_overlap
statement:
theorem mask_redundant_overlap
    (n J B₀ b₀ m : ℕ) (χ : MulChar (ZMod n) ℂ)
    (hB : B₀ ∣ b₀) (hb : b₀ ∣ (B₀ * J) ^ m) :
    (χ (J : ZMod n)) ^ 4 * mask n B₀ =
      (χ (J : ZMod n)) ^ 4 * mask n b₀

name: OAI.PoissonFirstLocal.sum_first_prime_product_identity
statement:
theorem sum_first_prime_product_identity
    (S P : Finset ℕ) (side : Bool)
    (parityBit ε₁ ε₂ : ℕ → Bool)
    (χ : (n : ℕ) → MulChar (ZMod n) ℂ)
    (hχ : ∀ n, χ n ^ 6 = 1) (a : ℕ → ℂ) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, a n *
      (∏ p ∈ P, oldFactor side (parityBit p) (ε₁ p) (ε₂ p) n p (χ n))) =
    (∑ n ∈ S, a n *
      ((χ n ((∏ p ∈ P with retained (parityBit p) (ε₁ p) (ε₂ p), p : ℕ) : ZMod n)) ^ 4 *
       mask n (∏ p ∈ P with ¬retained (parityBit p) (ε₁ p) (ε₂ p), p)))

name: OAI.PoissonFirstLocal.sum_first_prime_product_with_b0
statement:
theorem sum_first_prime_product_with_b0
    (S P : Finset ℕ) (side : Bool)
    (parityBit ε₁ ε₂ : ℕ → Bool)
    (χ : (n : ℕ) → MulChar (ZMod n) ℂ)
    (hχ : ∀ n, χ n ^ 6 = 1) (a : ℕ → ℂ)
    (b₀ m : ℕ)
    (hB : (∏ p ∈ P with ¬retained (parityBit p) (ε₁ p) (ε₂ p), p) ∣ b₀)
    (hb : b₀ ∣
      ((∏ p ∈ P with ¬retained (parityBit p) (ε₁ p) (ε₂ p), p) *
       (∏ p ∈ P with retained (parityBit p) (ε₁ p) (ε₂ p), p)) ^ m) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, a n *
      (∏ p ∈ P, oldFactor side (parityBit p) (ε₁ p) (ε₂ p) n p (χ n))) =
    (∑ n ∈ S, a n *
      ((χ n ((∏ p ∈ P with retained (parityBit p) (ε₁ p) (ε₂ p), p : ℕ) : ZMod n)) ^ 4 *
       mask n b₀))

name: OAI.ShortDraftFiniteGaussFourier.gauss_transform
statement:
theorem gauss_transform (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ)
    (hχ : χ ≠ 1) (h : F) :
    (∑ x : F, χ x * ψ (h * x)) =
      if h = 0 then 0 else (χ h)⁻¹ * gaussSum χ ψ

name: OAI.ShortDraftFiniteGaussFourier.product_gauss_transform
statement:
theorem product_gauss_transform
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (E : ι → Type*) [∀ i, Field (E i)] [∀ i, Fintype (E i)]
    (χ : ∀ i, MulChar (E i) ℂ) (ψ : ∀ i, AddChar (E i) ℂ)
    (hχ : ∀ i, χ i ≠ 1) (h : ∀ i, E i) :
    (∑ x : ∀ i, E i, ∏ i, χ i (x i) * ψ i (h i * x i)) =
      ∏ i, if h i = 0 then 0 else (χ i (h i))⁻¹ * gaussSum (χ i) (ψ i)

name: OAI.ConcreteBreveE.gauss_sum_breveE_actual_O
statement:
theorem gauss_sum_breveE_actual_O
    (a b : O) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hcop : IsCoprime (Ideal.span {a}) (Ideal.span {b}))
    [Fintype (O ⧸ (Ideal.span {a}) * (Ideal.span {b}))]
    [Fintype (O ⧸ Ideal.span {a})]
    [Fintype (O ⧸ Ideal.span {b})]
    (χa : MulChar (O ⧸ Ideal.span {a}) ℂ)
    (χb : MulChar (O ⧸ Ideal.span {b}) ℂ) :
    (∑ x : O ⧸ (Ideal.span {a}) * (Ideal.span {b}),
      χa (Ideal.Quotient.factor
        (Ideal.mul_le_left : (Ideal.span {a}) * (Ideal.span {b}) ≤ Ideal.span {a}) x) *
      χb (Ideal.Quotient.factor
        (Ideal.mul_le_right : (Ideal.span {a}) * (Ideal.span {b}) ≤ Ideal.span {b}) x) *
      eisTraceProdChar ShortDraftTrace.breveE breveE_period_coordinates
        a b ha hb x) =
      χa (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}) b) *
      χb (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {b}) a) *
      gaussSum χa (eisTraceModChar ShortDraftTrace.breveE
        breveE_period_coordinates a ha) *
      gaussSum χb (eisTraceModChar ShortDraftTrace.breveE
        breveE_period_coordinates b hb)

name: OAI.ConcreteTraceCRT.gauss_sum_actual_O
statement:
theorem gauss_sum_actual_O
    (ψ : AddChar ℂ ℂ)
    (hperiod : ∀ c d : ℤ,
      ψ (((c : ℂ) + (d : ℂ) * omega3) / eisLam) = 1)
    (a b : O) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hcop : IsCoprime (Ideal.span {a}) (Ideal.span {b}))
    [Fintype (O ⧸ (Ideal.span {a}) * (Ideal.span {b}))]
    [Fintype (O ⧸ Ideal.span {a})]
    [Fintype (O ⧸ Ideal.span {b})]
    (χa : MulChar (O ⧸ Ideal.span {a}) ℂ)
    (χb : MulChar (O ⧸ Ideal.span {b}) ℂ) :
    (∑ x : O ⧸ (Ideal.span {a}) * (Ideal.span {b}),
      χa (Ideal.Quotient.factor
        (Ideal.mul_le_left : (Ideal.span {a}) * (Ideal.span {b}) ≤ Ideal.span {a}) x) *
      χb (Ideal.Quotient.factor
        (Ideal.mul_le_right : (Ideal.span {a}) * (Ideal.span {b}) ≤ Ideal.span {b}) x) *
      eisTraceProdChar ψ hperiod a b ha hb x) =
      χa (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}) b) *
      χb (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {b}) a) *
      gaussSum χa (eisTraceModChar ψ hperiod a ha) *
      gaussSum χb (eisTraceModChar ψ hperiod b hb)

name: OAI.ShortDraftGauss.norm_gaussSum_eq_sqrt_card

name: OAI.ShortDraftGauss.norm_normalized_gaussSum

name: OAI.ShortDraftGaussJacobi.cubic_gauss_cube
statement:
theorem cubic_gauss_cube (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ)
    (horder : orderOf χ = 3) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    gaussSum χ ψ ^ 3 = (Fintype.card F : ℂ) * jacobiSum χ χ

name: OAI.ShortDraftGaussJacobi.cubic_jacobi_product

theorem cubic_jacobi_product (χ : MulChar F ℂ)

name: OAI.ShortDraftGaussJacobi.jacobiSum_reduction_zero
statement:
theorem jacobiSum_reduction_zero {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (χ : MulChar F R) (ρ : R →+* F) (m : ℕ)
    (hχ : ∀ x : F, ρ (χ x) = x ^ m)
    (hm : 2 * m < Fintype.card F - 1) :
    ρ (jacobiSum χ χ) = 0

name: OAI.ShortDraftGaussJacobi.normalized_cubic_gauss_cube
statement:
theorem normalized_cubic_gauss_cube (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ)

    (gaussSum χ ψ / (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card F : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ 3 =

name: OAI.ShortDraftGaussJacobi.sum_cubic_jacobi_reduction_zero

name: OAI.ShortDraftGaussianPhaseTable.phase_cocycle

name: OAI.ShortDraftQuadraticGauss.quadratic_gauss_as_square_phase

theorem quadratic_gauss_as_square_phase (ψ : AddChar F ℂ)

name: OAI.ShortDraftQuotientPhase.quotient_phase
statement:
theorem quotient_phase (R : A → A → B) (G : A → B)
    (hRright : ∀ a b c, R a (b * c) = R a b * R a c)
    (hRsym : ∀ a b, R a b = R b a)
    (hRone : ∀ a, R a 1 = 1)
    (hRtwo : ∀ a b, R a b ^ 2 = 1)
    (hGmul : ∀ a b, G (a * b) = G a * G b * R a b)
    (hGone : G 1 = 1)
    (a b : A) :
    R a a * (G a)⁻¹ * G b * R a b = G (b * a⁻¹)

name: OAI.ShortDraftSextic.sextic_power_is_unit_mask

name: OAI.AnalyticBridge.first_poisson_local_ratio_bound
statement:
theorem first_poisson_local_ratio_bound
    (c E A1 A2 s J2 J B : ℝ)
    (_hc : 0 ≤ c) (_hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (_hA1 : 0 < A1) (_hA2 : 0 < A2)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hJ2 : 1 ≤ J2) (_hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hJ : J = s * J2) (hJpos : 0 < J)
    (hJdyad : J ≤ B ^ 2)
    (hlocal : c * E / (A1 * A2) = s / J2 ^ 2) :
    c * E / (A1 * A2) ≤ B ^ 4 / J

name: OAI.AnalyticBridge.restrict_positive_side_to_weight_support
statement:
theorem restrict_positive_side_to_weight_support
    {Ω : Type*} (S : Finset Ω) (w : Ω → ℂ) (U : Ω → ℂ) :
    (∑ ω ∈ S with w ω ≠ 0, ‖w ω‖ * ‖U ω‖ ^ 2) =
      (∑ ω ∈ S, ‖w ω‖ * ‖U ω‖ ^ 2)

name: OAI.AnalyticBridge.schwartz_fourier_one_plus_integrable
statement:
theorem schwartz_fourier_one_plus_integrable
    (g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (J : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun t : ℝ =>
      (1 + ‖t‖) ^ J * ‖(𝓕 g) t‖) volume

name: OAI.AnalyticBridge.weighted_cauchy_ball_enlargement
statement:
theorem weighted_cauchy_ball_enlargement
    {Ω Λ : Type*} [DecidableEq Λ]
    (S : Finset Ω) (T : Finset Λ) (label : Ω → Λ)
    (w : Ω → ℂ) (A B : Λ → ℂ)
    (M₁ M₂ : ℝ) (hM₁ : 0 ≤ M₁)
    (hsupport : ∀ ω ∈ S, w ω ≠ 0 → label ω ∈ T)
    (hfiber : ∀ a ∈ T,
      (∑ ω ∈ S with label ω = a, ‖w ω‖) ≤ M₁)
    (hfiber₂ : ∀ a ∈ T,
      (∑ ω ∈ S with label ω = a, ‖w ω‖) ≤ M₂) :
    ‖∑ ω ∈ S, w ω * A (label ω) * star (B (label ω))‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (M₁ * ∑ a ∈ T, ‖A a‖ ^ 2) *
        (M₂ * ∑ a ∈ T, ‖B a‖ ^ 2)

name: OAI.AnalyticBridge.weighted_fourier_minkowski
statement:
theorem weighted_fourier_minkowski
    {Ω : Type*} (S : Finset Ω)
    (b : ℝ → ℂ) (φ : Ω → ℝ → ℂ) (J : ℕ) (H : ℝ)
    (_hH : 0 ≤ H)
    (hint : ∀ ω ∈ S,
      Integrable (fun t : ℝ => b t * φ ω t) volume)
    (hweight : Integrable
      (fun t : ℝ => (1 + ‖t‖) ^ J * ‖b t‖) volume)
    (hφ : ∀ t : ℝ,
      ‖∑ ω ∈ S, φ ω t‖ ≤ H * (1 + ‖t‖) ^ J) :
    ‖∑ ω ∈ S, ∫ t : ℝ, b t * φ ω t‖ ≤
      H * ∫ t : ℝ, (1 + ‖t‖) ^ J * ‖b t‖

name: OAI.AnalyticBridge.weighted_fourier_minkowski_with_decay
statement:
theorem weighted_fourier_minkowski_with_decay
    {Ω : Type*} (S : Finset Ω)
    (b : ℝ → ℂ) (φ : Ω → ℝ → ℂ)
    (A J : ℕ) (R H C : ℝ)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hH : 0 ≤ H)
    (hint : ∀ ω ∈ S,
      Integrable (fun t : ℝ => b t * φ ω t) volume)
    (hweight : Integrable
      (fun t : ℝ => (1 + ‖t‖) ^ J * ‖b t‖) volume)
    (hφ : ∀ t : ℝ,
      ‖∑ ω ∈ S, φ ω t‖ ≤ H * (1 + ‖t‖) ^ J)
    (hcoeff : (1 + R) ^ A *
      (∫ t : ℝ, (1 + ‖t‖) ^ J * ‖b t‖) ≤ C) :
    (1 + R) ^ A *
      ‖∑ ω ∈ S, ∫ t : ℝ, b t * φ ω t‖ ≤ H * C

name: OAI.JacobiQuadratic.gauss_sextic_relation
statement:
theorem gauss_sextic_relation (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ)
    (hchar : ringChar F ≠ 2) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hχ1 : χ ≠ 1) (hχ2 : χ ^ 2 ≠ 1) (hχ4 : χ ^ 4 ≠ 1)
    (hχ3 : χ ^ 3 = (quadraticChar F).ringHomComp (Int.castRingHom ℂ))
    (hχ6 : χ ^ 6 = 1) :
    χ (4 : F) * gaussSum χ ψ * (Fintype.card F : ℂ) =
      gaussSum (χ ^ 3) ψ * gaussSum (χ ^ 2) ψ ^ 2

name: OAI.JacobiQuadratic.jacobi_quadratic
statement:
theorem jacobi_quadratic (χ : MulChar F ℂ)
    (hchar : ringChar F ≠ 2) (hχ : χ ≠ 1) :
    jacobiSum χ ((quadraticChar F).ringHomComp (Int.castRingHom ℂ)) =
      χ (4 : F) * jacobiSum χ χ

name: OAI.JacobiQuadratic.normalized_gauss_sextic_relation
statement:
theorem normalized_gauss_sextic_relation (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ)
    (hchar : ringChar F ≠ 2) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hχ1 : χ ≠ 1) (hχ2 : χ ^ 2 ≠ 1) (hχ4 : χ ^ 4 ≠ 1)
    (hχ3 : χ ^ 3 = (quadraticChar F).ringHomComp (Int.castRingHom ℂ))
    (hχ6 : χ ^ 6 = 1)
    (s : ℂ) (hs : s ^ 2 = (Fintype.card F : ℂ)) (hs0 : s ≠ 0) :
    χ (4 : F) * (gaussSum χ ψ / s) * (gaussSum (χ ^ 2) ψ / s) =
      (gaussSum (χ ^ 3) ψ / s) * (gaussSum (χ ^ 2) ψ / s) ^ 3

name: OAI.ShortDraftLocal.general_inversion_gauss
statement:
theorem general_inversion_gauss {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F]
    (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ) (j : ℕ) (a : F) :
    (∑ h : Fˣ, (((χ ^ j)⁻¹ * (χ⁻¹) ^ 2) h) *
      ψ (a * ((h⁻¹ : Fˣ) : F))) =
      gaussSum (χ ^ (j + 2)) (ψ.mulShift a)

name: OAI.ShortDraftLocal.sextic_fourier_theta_row_general
statement:
theorem sextic_fourier_theta_row_general
    {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F]
    (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ) (j : ℕ)
    (hχj : χ ^ j ≠ 1) (hχj2 : χ ^ (j + 2) ≠ 1)
    (σ : Fˣ) (ε x : F) :
    (Fintype.card F : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      (∑ h : Fˣ,
        (∑ t : F, (χ ^ j) t * ψ (-(h * t))) *
          (((χ⁻¹) ^ 2) (σ * h)) *
          ψ ((ε * x) * ((h⁻¹ : Fˣ) : F))) =
      ((χ⁻¹) ^ 2) σ *
      ((Fintype.card F : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        gaussSum (χ ^ j) (ψ.mulShift (-1)) *
        gaussSum (χ ^ (j + 2)) ψ * (χ ^ (j + 2))⁻¹ ε) *
      (χ ^ (j + 2))⁻¹ x

name: OAI.ConcreteBreveE.normalizedTraceGaussProduct_crt
statement:
theorem normalizedTraceGaussProduct_crt
    (a b : O) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hcop : IsCoprime (Ideal.span {a}) (Ideal.span {b}))
    (χa : MulChar (O ⧸ Ideal.span {a}) ℂ)
    (χb : MulChar (O ⧸ Ideal.span {b}) ℂ) :
    normalizedTraceGaussProduct a b ha hb χa χb =
      χa (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}) b) *
      χb (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {b}) a) *
      normalizedTraceGauss a ha χa * normalizedTraceGauss b hb χb

name: OAI.CubeInversion.cube_coefficient_filter
statement:
theorem cube_coefficient_filter
    (m : ℕ) (c W : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hc : ∀ a b, c (a * b) = c a * c b) :
    (∑ h ∈ m.divisors,
      (ArithmeticFunction.moebius h : ℂ) * c h * c (m / h) * W m) =
      if m = 1 then c m * W m else 0

name: OAI.CubeInversion.cube_index_filter_complex
statement:
theorem cube_index_filter_complex (m : ℕ) :
    (∑ h ∈ m.divisors, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius h : ℂ)) =
      if m = 1 then 1 else 0

name: OAI.CubeInversion.finite_cube_inversion
statement:
theorem finite_cube_inversion
    (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : 1 ∈ S) (c W : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hc : ∀ a b, c (a * b) = c a * c b) :
    (∑ m ∈ S, ∑ h ∈ m.divisors,
      (ArithmeticFunction.moebius h : ℂ) * c h * c (m / h) * W m) =
        c 1 * W 1

name: OAI.CubeInversion.finite_cube_inversion_with_columns
statement:
theorem finite_cube_inversion_with_columns {N : Type*} [DecidableEq N]
    (columns : Finset N) (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : 1 ∈ S)
    (a : N → ℂ) (c : ℕ → ℂ) (W : N → ℕ → ℂ)
    (hc : ∀ x y, c (x * y) = c x * c y) :
    (∑ n ∈ columns, a n *
      (∑ m ∈ S, ∑ h ∈ m.divisors,
        (ArithmeticFunction.moebius h : ℂ) * c h * c (m / h) * W n m)) =
      ∑ n ∈ columns, a n * (c 1 * W n 1)

name: OAI.FixedRayActiveSet.admissible_branch_count
statement:
theorem admissible_branch_count
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (j : ι → ℕ) :
    ((Finset.univ : Finset ι).powerset.filter
      (fun A => (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => j i ≠ 0)) ⊆ A)).card
      ≤ 2 ^ Fintype.card ι

name: OAI.FixedRayActiveSet.assemble_local_A5
statement:
theorem assemble_local_A5
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (F : ι → Type*) [∀ i, Field (F i)] [∀ i, Fintype (F i)]
    (j : ι → ℕ) (f : ∀ i, F i → ℂ)
    (scalar dual : ι → ℂ)
    (hzero : ∀ i, j i ≠ 0 → f i 0 = 0)
    (hactive : ∀ i, (∑ u : (F i)ˣ, f i (u : F i)) =
      scalar i * dual i) :
    (∑ h : ∀ i, F i, ∏ i, f i (h i)) =
      ∑ A ∈ ((Finset.univ : Finset ι).powerset.filter
        (fun A => (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => j i ≠ 0)) ⊆ A)),
        (∏ i ∈ A, scalar i * dual i) *
          (∏ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι) \ A, f i 0)

name: OAI.FixedRayActiveSet.branch_zero_of_local_mask
statement:
theorem branch_zero_of_local_mask
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (I A : Finset ι)
    (scalar dual inactive : ι → ℂ)
    (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ A) (hzero : dual i = 0) :
    (∏ k ∈ A, scalar k * dual k) *
      (∏ k ∈ I \ A, inactive k) = 0

name: OAI.FixedRayActiveSet.product_sum_by_active_set
statement:
theorem product_sum_by_active_set
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (F : ι → Type*) [∀ i, Field (F i)] [∀ i, Fintype (F i)]
    (f : ∀ i, F i → ℂ) :
    (∑ h : ∀ i, F i, ∏ i, f i (h i)) =
      ∑ A ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι).powerset,
        (∏ i ∈ A, ∑ u : (F i)ˣ, f i (u : F i)) *
          (∏ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι) \ A, f i 0)

name: OAI.PowerExtraction.from_mean_square_and_prime_rows
statement:
theorem from_mean_square_and_prime_rows
    (D ε J A : ℝ) (hD : 1 ≤ D) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hJ : D ^ ((11 / 60 : ℝ) - ε) ≤ J)
    (hmean : J * A ^ 2 ≤
      2 * D ^ ((21 / 10 : ℝ) + ε) +
      2 * J * D ^ (49 / 30 : ℝ)) :
    A ≤ 2 * D ^ ((23 / 24 : ℝ) + ε)

name: OAI.AnalyticBridge.bounded_separated_double_integrable
statement:
theorem bounded_separated_double_integrable
    {Ω : Type*} (S : Finset Ω)
    (g₁ g₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (u v : Ω → ℝ → ℂ)
    (humeas : ∀ ω ∈ S, AEStronglyMeasurable (u ω) volume)
    (hvmeas : ∀ ω ∈ S, AEStronglyMeasurable (v ω) volume)
    (hubdd : ∀ ω ∈ S, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ, ‖u ω t‖ ≤ M)
    (hvbdd : ∀ ω ∈ S, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ, ‖v ω t‖ ≤ M) :
    (∀ t₁ : ℝ, ∀ ω ∈ S,
      Integrable (fun t₂ : ℝ =>
        (𝓕 g₂) t₂ * (u ω t₁ * v ω t₂)) volume) ∧
    (∀ ω ∈ S,
      Integrable (fun t₁ : ℝ =>
        (𝓕 g₁) t₁ *
          (∫ t₂ : ℝ,
            (𝓕 g₂) t₂ * (u ω t₁ * v ω t₂))) volume)

name: OAI.AnalyticBridge.double_weighted_fourier_minkowski
statement:
theorem double_weighted_fourier_minkowski
    {Ω : Type*} (S : Finset Ω)
    (b₁ b₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (φ : Ω → ℝ → ℝ → ℂ)
    (J₁ J₂ : ℕ) (H : ℝ) (hH : 0 ≤ H)
    (hinner : ∀ t₁ : ℝ, ∀ ω ∈ S,
      Integrable (fun t₂ : ℝ => b₂ t₂ * φ ω t₁ t₂) volume)
    (houter : ∀ ω ∈ S,
      Integrable (fun t₁ : ℝ =>
        b₁ t₁ * (∫ t₂ : ℝ, b₂ t₂ * φ ω t₁ t₂)) volume)
    (hweight₁ : Integrable
      (fun t₁ : ℝ => (1 + ‖t₁‖) ^ J₁ * ‖b₁ t₁‖) volume)
    (hweight₂ : Integrable
      (fun t₂ : ℝ => (1 + ‖t₂‖) ^ J₂ * ‖b₂ t₂‖) volume)
    (hφ : ∀ t₁ t₂ : ℝ,
      ‖∑ ω ∈ S, φ ω t₁ t₂‖ ≤
        H * (1 + ‖t₁‖) ^ J₁ * (1 + ‖t₂‖) ^ J₂) :
    ‖∑ ω ∈ S,
        ∫ t₁ : ℝ,
          b₁ t₁ * (∫ t₂ : ℝ, b₂ t₂ * φ ω t₁ t₂)‖ ≤
      H *
        (∫ t₁ : ℝ, (1 + ‖t₁‖) ^ J₁ * ‖b₁ t₁‖) *
        (∫ t₂ : ℝ, (1 + ‖t₂‖) ^ J₂ * ‖b₂ t₂‖)

name: OAI.FourierBridge.coupled_double_log_separation
statement:
theorem coupled_double_log_separation
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (W : ι → ℝ → ℂ) (F₁ F₂ V₁ V₂ : ℝ → ℂ)
    (R₁ R₂ : ℝ) (a₁ a₂ y : ι → ℝ)
    (hV₁c : HasCompactSupport V₁) (hV₁s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V₁)
    (hF₁s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F₁)
    (hV₂c : HasCompactSupport V₂) (hV₂s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V₂)
    (hF₂s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F₂)
    (hactive₁ : (∏ j : ι, W j (y j)) ≠ 0 →
      V₁ (∑ j : ι, a₁ j * y j) = 1)
    (hactive₂ : (∏ j : ι, W j (y j)) ≠ 0 →
      V₂ (∑ j : ι, a₂ j * y j) = 1) :
    (∏ j : ι, W j (y j)) *
      F₁ (R₁ * Real.exp (∑ j : ι, a₁ j * y j)) *
      F₂ (R₂ * Real.exp (∑ j : ι, a₂ j * y j)) =
      ∫ t₁ : ℝ,
        (∫ t₂ : ℝ,
          (∏ j : ι,
            W j (y j) * logPhase t₁ (a₁ j * y j) *
              logPhase t₂ (a₂ j * y j)) *
            (𝓕 (logProfile V₂ F₂ R₂ 1 hV₂c hV₂s hF₂s)) t₂) *
          (𝓕 (logProfile V₁ F₁ R₁ 1 hV₁c hV₁s hF₁s)) t₁

    (P : Finset ℕ) (parityBit ε₁ ε₂ : ℕ → Bool) :
    (∏ p ∈ P, localC (parityBit p) (ε₁ p) (ε₂ p) p) *
      (∏ p ∈ P, localCorrectionE (parityBit p) (ε₁ p) (ε₂ p) p) *
      (∏ p ∈ P, localJ2 (parityBit p) (ε₁ p) (ε₂ p) p) ^ 2 =
    (∏ p ∈ P, localA (ε₁ p) p) *
      (∏ p ∈ P, localA (ε₂ p) p) *
      (∏ p ∈ P, localS (parityBit p) p)

    (hrows : primes.image row ⊆ rows)

    (hmean : (∑ u ∈ rows, ‖A u‖ ^ 2) ≤

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.gauss_transform_crt
statement:
theorem gauss_transform_crt {T R S : Type*}
    [CommRing T] [Field R] [Field S]
    [Fintype T] [Fintype R] [Fintype S]
    (e : T ≃+* R × S)
    (χR : MulChar R ℂ) (χS : MulChar S ℂ)
    (ψ : AddChar T ℂ) (hχR : χR ≠ 1) (hχS : χS ≠ 1)
    (h : T) :
    (∑ x : T, χR (e x).1 * χS (e x).2 * ψ (h * x)) =
      (if (e h).1 = 0 then 0 else
        (χR (e h).1)⁻¹ * gaussSum χR (leftAddChar e ψ)) *
      (if (e h).2 = 0 then 0 else
        (χS (e h).2)⁻¹ * gaussSum χS (rightAddChar e ψ))

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.gauss_transform_ideal_crt
statement:
theorem gauss_transform_ideal_crt {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    (I J : Ideal A) (hc : IsCoprime I J)
    [I.IsMaximal] [J.IsMaximal]
    [Fintype (A ⧸ I * J)] [Fintype (A ⧸ I)] [Fintype (A ⧸ J)]
    (χI : MulChar (A ⧸ I) ℂ) (χJ : MulChar (A ⧸ J) ℂ)
    (ψ : AddChar (A ⧸ I * J) ℂ)
    (hχI : χI ≠ 1) (hχJ : χJ ≠ 1)
    (h : A ⧸ I * J) :
    (∑ x : A ⧸ I * J,
      χI (Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.mul_le_left : I * J ≤ I) x) *
      χJ (Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.mul_le_right : I * J ≤ J) x) *
      ψ (h * x)) =
      (if Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.mul_le_left : I * J ≤ I) h = 0
        then 0 else
        (χI (Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.mul_le_left : I * J ≤ I) h))⁻¹ *
          gaussSum χI
            (leftAddChar (Ideal.quotientMulEquivQuotientProd I J hc) ψ)) *
      (if Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.mul_le_right : I * J ≤ J) h = 0
        then 0 else
        (χJ (Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.mul_le_right : I * J ≤ J) h))⁻¹ *
          gaussSum χJ
            (rightAddChar (Ideal.quotientMulEquivQuotientProd I J hc) ψ))

    ((64 * (D / N + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      192 * (D : ℝ) ^ (49 / 60 : ℝ)

name: OAI.PowerExtraction.from_finite_sixth_power_rows_with_constant
statement:
theorem from_finite_sixth_power_rows_with_constant
    {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (rows : Finset α) (primes : Finset β) (row : β → α)
    (A : α → ℂ) (untwisted : α) (D ε C : ℝ)
    (hD : 1 ≤ D) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hC : 1 ≤ C)
    (hrows : primes.image row ⊆ rows)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn row (primes : Set β))
    (happrox : ∀ p ∈ primes,
      ‖A untwisted - A (row p)‖ ≤ C * D ^ (49 / 60 : ℝ))
    (hcount : D ^ ((11 / 60 : ℝ) - ε) ≤ (primes.card : ℝ))
    (hmean : (∑ u ∈ rows, ‖A u‖ ^ 2) ≤
      D ^ ((21 / 10 : ℝ) + ε)) :
    ‖A untwisted‖ ≤ 2 * C * D ^ ((23 / 24 : ℝ) + ε)

name: OAI.PowerExtraction.from_mean_square_and_prime_rows_with_constant
statement:
theorem from_mean_square_and_prime_rows_with_constant
    (D ε J A C : ℝ) (hD : 1 ≤ D) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hC : 1 ≤ C)
    (hJ : D ^ ((11 / 60 : ℝ) - ε) ≤ J)
    (hmean : J * A ^ 2 ≤
      2 * D ^ ((21 / 10 : ℝ) + ε) +
      2 * J * C ^ 2 * D ^ (49 / 30 : ℝ)) :
    A ≤ 2 * C * D ^ ((23 / 24 : ℝ) + ε)

theorem eisenstein_gaussian_poisson {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :

name: OAI.ActualEisensteinCubic.eisEmbedding_fiber_norm_sq
statement:
theorem eisEmbedding_fiber_norm_sq (a b x y m n : ℤ) :
    ‖eisEmbedding
      (ActualEisensteinCoordinates.eval x y +
        ActualEisensteinCoordinates.eval a b *
          ActualEisensteinCoordinates.eval m n)‖ ^ 2 =
      ((a*a-a*b+b*b)*(m*m-m*n+n*n) +
      ((2*a-b)*x+(2*b-a)*y)*m +
      (-(a+b)*x+(2*a-b)*y)*n +
      (x*x-x*y+y*y) : ℤ)

      ActualEisensteinCoordinates.eval a b *

    ActualEisensteinCoordinates.eval (x + a*m-b*n)
      (y+b*m+(a-b)*n)

name: OAI.ActualEisensteinCubic.fiber_quadratic_expansion
statement:
theorem fiber_quadratic_expansion (a b x y m n : ℤ) :
    let q := a*a-a*b+b*b
    let X := x+a*m-b*n
    let Y := y+b*m+(a-b)*n
    X*X-X*Y+Y*Y =
      q*(m*m-m*n+n*n) +
      ((2*a-b)*x+(2*b-a)*y)*m +
      (-(a+b)*x+(2*a-b)*y)*n +
      (x*x-x*y+y*y)

name: OAI.ActualEisensteinCubic.actual_oscillatory_gaussian_coordinate
statement:
theorem actual_oscillatory_gaussian_coordinate
    (a b m n : ℤ) (hc : ActualEisensteinCoordinates.eval a b ≠ 0)
    (η : ℝ) :
    let c : O := ActualEisensteinCoordinates.eval a b
    let z : O := ActualEisensteinCoordinates.eval m n
    (eisTraceModChar ShortDraftTrace.breveE
        ConcreteBreveE.breveE_period_coordinates c hc)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c}) z ^ 2) *
      Complex.exp (-(Real.pi : ℂ) * (η : ℂ) *
        (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 : ℂ)) =
      Complex.exp (-(Real.pi : ℂ) *
        ((η : ℂ) * ((m*m-m*n+n*n : ℤ) : ℂ) -
          2 * Complex.I *
            (((-b*m*m+2*a*m*n+(b-a)*n*n : ℤ) : ℂ) /
              ((a*a-a*b+b*b : ℤ) : ℂ))))

name: OAI.ActualEisensteinCubic.sixth_power_rows_within_norm_cutoff

      (Ideal.absNorm (Ideal.span {p i}) : ℝ) ≤
        (D : ℝ) ^ (11 / 60 : ℝ))
    (hcover : ∀ u : O,
      (Ideal.absNorm (Ideal.span {u}) : ℝ) ≤

name: OAI.EisensteinGaussianPrefactor.complex_eta_times_prefactor

name: OAI.OscillatoryDeterminant.inverse_quadratic
statement:
theorem inverse_quadratic (t a b k l : ℂ)
    (hq : q a b ≠ 0) (hr : r t a b ≠ 0) :
    (D t a b * k^2 - 2 * B t a b * k*l + A t a b * l^2) /
      (A t a b * D t a b - (B t a b)^2) =
      (t * q a b / (4 * r t a b)) * (k^2+k*l+l^2) +
        Complex.I / (2 * r t a b) *
          ((a-b)*k^2+2*a*k*l+b*l^2)

theorem binary_gaussian_poisson_real_det {a b d : ℂ} {R : ℝ}

    (hpd : 0 < a.re * d.re - b.re ^ 2) :

      (1 / ((R : ℂ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ))) *
        ∑' z : ℤ × ℤ, RankTwoComplex.dualGaussian a b d z

name: OAI.OscSpecial.coefficient_re

name: OAI.OscSpecial.dualGaussian_inverseForm

name: OAI.RationalPrimeExtraction.lower_count_and_extract
statement:
theorem lower_count_and_extract
    [DecidableEq O] (A : O → ℂ) (rows : Finset O) (E B : ℝ) (hE : 0 ≤ E) :
    ∃ Y₀ : ℝ, ∀ Y : ℝ, Y₀ ≤ Y →
      (selected Y).image (fun r : ℕ => (r : O) ^ 6) ⊆ rows →
      (∀ r ∈ selected Y, ‖A 1 - A ((r : O) ^ 6)‖ ≤ E) →
      (∑ u ∈ rows, ‖A u‖ ^ 2) ≤ B →
      (Real.log 2 / 20) * (Y / Real.log Y) * ‖A 1‖ ^ 2 ≤
        2 * B + 2 * ((selected Y).card : ℝ) * E ^ 2

name: OAI.ActualEisensteinCubic.actual_oscillatory_binary_coordinate
statement:
theorem actual_oscillatory_binary_coordinate
    (a b m n : ℤ) (hc : ActualEisensteinCoordinates.eval a b ≠ 0)
    (η : ℝ) :
    let c : O := ActualEisensteinCoordinates.eval a b
    let z : O := ActualEisensteinCoordinates.eval m n
    (eisTraceModChar ShortDraftTrace.breveE
        ConcreteBreveE.breveE_period_coordinates c hc)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c}) z ^ 2) *
      Complex.exp (-(Real.pi : ℂ) * (η : ℂ) *
        (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 : ℂ)) =
      RankTwoComplex.binaryGaussian
        (OscSpecial.A η (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ))
        (OscSpecial.B η (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ))
        (OscSpecial.D η (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ)) (m,n)

name: OAI.ActualEisensteinCubic.actual_oscillatory_poisson
statement:
theorem actual_oscillatory_poisson
    (a b : ℤ) (hc : ActualEisensteinCoordinates.eval a b ≠ 0)
    (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    let c : O := ActualEisensteinCoordinates.eval a b
    let q : ℝ := OscSpecial.q (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    let r : ℝ := OscSpecial.r η (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    (∑' z : O,
      (eisTraceModChar ShortDraftTrace.breveE
        ConcreteBreveE.breveE_period_coordinates c hc)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c}) z ^ 2) *
      Complex.exp (-(Real.pi : ℂ) * (η : ℂ) *
        (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 : ℂ))) =
      (1 / ((OscSpecial.R η (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ))) *
        ∑' y : O,
          Complex.exp (-(Real.pi : ℂ) *
            ((η : ℂ) * (q : ℂ) / (4 * (r : ℂ))) *
            (‖eisEmbedding y‖ ^ 2 : ℂ)) *
          ShortDraftTrace.breveE
            (eisEmbedding (-(c * y^2)) / eisLam / ((4*r : ℝ) : ℂ))

        (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 : ℂ))) =
      ∑' p : ℤ × ℤ,
        RankTwoComplex.binaryGaussian
          (OscSpecial.A η (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ))
          (OscSpecial.B η (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ))
          (OscSpecial.D η (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ)) p

name: OAI.ActualEisensteinCubic.breveE_dual_quadratic_real_scale
statement:
theorem breveE_dual_quadratic_real_scale
    (r : ℝ) (a b k l : ℤ) :
    ShortDraftTrace.breveE
      (eisEmbedding (-(ActualEisensteinCoordinates.eval a b *
        (ActualEisensteinCoordinates.eval (k+l) k)^2)) /
        eisLam / ((4*r : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
      Complex.exp (-(2 * Real.pi * Complex.I *
        (((a-b)*k^2+2*a*k*l+b*l^2 : ℤ) : ℂ)) /

        eisLam / ((4*r : ℝ) : ℂ)) =

name: OAI.ActualEisensteinCubic.dual_gaussian_is_actual_trace_phase
statement:
theorem dual_gaussian_is_actual_trace_phase
    (a b k l : ℤ)
    (hc : ActualEisensteinCoordinates.eval a b ≠ 0)
    (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    let c : O := ActualEisensteinCoordinates.eval a b
    let y : O := dualFrequencyEquiv (k,l)
    let q : ℝ := OscSpecial.q (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    let r : ℝ := OscSpecial.r η (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    RankTwoComplex.dualGaussian
        (OscSpecial.A η (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ))
        (OscSpecial.B η (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ))
        (OscSpecial.D η (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ)) (k,l) =
      Complex.exp (-(Real.pi : ℂ) *
        ((η : ℂ) * (q : ℂ) / (4 * (r : ℂ))) *
        (‖eisEmbedding y‖ ^ 2 : ℂ)) *
      ShortDraftTrace.breveE
        (eisEmbedding (-(c * y^2)) / eisLam / ((4*r : ℝ) : ℂ))

name: OAI.OscSpecial.dualGaussian_explicit
statement:
theorem dualGaussian_explicit {η a b : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hq : 0 < q a b)
    (z : ℤ × ℤ) :
    RankTwoComplex.dualGaussian (A η a b) (B η a b) (D η a b) z =
      Complex.exp (-(Real.pi : ℂ) *
        (((η : ℂ) * (q a b : ℂ) / (4 * (r η a b : ℂ))) *
          ((z.1 : ℂ) ^ 2 + (z.1 : ℂ) * (z.2 : ℂ) + (z.2 : ℂ) ^ 2) +
         Complex.I / (2 * (r η a b : ℂ)) *
          (((a-b : ℝ) : ℂ) * (z.1 : ℂ) ^ 2 +
            2 * (a : ℂ) * (z.1 : ℂ) * (z.2 : ℂ) +
            (b : ℂ) * (z.2 : ℂ) ^ 2)))

    (hmean : J * A ^ 2 ≤
      2 * D ^ ((31 / 15 : ℝ) + ε) +

name: OAI.OscSpecial.dual_phase_term_error
statement:
theorem dual_phase_term_error {η a b : ℝ} (_hη : 0 < η) (hq : 0 < q a b)

    ‖dualVarTerm η a b z - dualFixedTerm η a b z‖ ≤

name: OAI.ActualEisensteinCubic.dual_abel_coefficient
statement:
theorem dual_abel_coefficient (a b : ℤ)
    (hq : 0 < OscSpecial.q (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ)) :
    let a2 := (ActualEisensteinCoordinates.coords (2 : O)).1
    let b2 := (ActualEisensteinCoordinates.coords (2 : O)).2
    (((4 / OscSpecial.q (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      ((2 / (Real.sqrt 3 *
        (((a2*a2-a2*b2+b2*b2 : ℤ) : ℝ))) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =

    let b2 := (ActualEisensteinCoordinates.coords (2 : O)).2
    (((Real.sqrt q / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      (((4 / q : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        ((2 / (Real.sqrt 3 *
          (((a2*a2-a2*b2+b2*b2 : ℤ) : ℝ))) : ℝ) : ℂ))) =

name: OAI.ShortDraftLocal.direct_theta_jone_local_row
statement:
theorem direct_theta_jone_local_row (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ)
    (hχ : χ ≠ 1) (σ : Fˣ) (ε x : F) :
    (Fintype.card F : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      (∑ h : Fˣ,
        (∑ t : F, χ t * ψ (-(h * t))) *
        (χ ^ 2) (σ * h) *
        ψ ((ε * x) * ((h⁻¹ : Fˣ) : F))) =
      (χ ^ 2) σ *
      ((Fintype.card F : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        gaussSum χ (ψ.mulShift (-1)) * gaussSum χ⁻¹ ψ * χ ε) * χ x

name: OAI.ShortDraftLocal.no_quadratic_scalar

    ¬ ∃ d : ℂ, ∀ x : F, c * χ x = d * (χ ^ 3) x

name: OAI.SevenEighths.FiniteFourier.primitive_character_expansion
statement:
theorem primitive_character_expansion (χ : MulChar R ℂ)
    (hχ : IsPrimitiveOnIdeals χ) (ψ : AddChar R ℂ) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (a : R) :
    χ a = (∑ x : R, χ⁻¹ x * ψ (a * x)) / gaussSum χ⁻¹ ψ

name: OAI.SevenEighths.FiniteFourier.primitive_gaussSum_mulShift
statement:
theorem primitive_gaussSum_mulShift (χ : MulChar R ℂ)
    (hχ : IsPrimitiveOnIdeals χ) (ψ : AddChar R ℂ) (a : R) :
    gaussSum χ (ψ.mulShift a) = χ⁻¹ a * gaussSum χ ψ

name: OAI.SevenEighths.FiniteFourier.primitive_gaussSum_mul_conjugate
statement:
theorem primitive_gaussSum_mul_conjugate (χ : MulChar R ℂ)
    (hχ : IsPrimitiveOnIdeals χ) (ψ : AddChar R ℂ) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    gaussSum χ ψ * star (gaussSum χ ψ) = (Fintype.card R : ℂ)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.FiniteFourier.primitive_gaussSum_ne_zero
statement:
theorem primitive_gaussSum_ne_zero (χ : MulChar R ℂ)
    (hχ : IsPrimitiveOnIdeals χ) (ψ : AddChar R ℂ) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) :

name: OAI.SevenEighths.FiniteFourier.primitive_gaussSum_norm
statement:
theorem primitive_gaussSum_norm (χ : MulChar R ℂ)
    (hχ : IsPrimitiveOnIdeals χ) (ψ : AddChar R ℂ) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) :

name: OAI.SevenEighths.FiniteFourier.primitive_gaussSum_norm_sq
statement:
theorem primitive_gaussSum_norm_sq (χ : MulChar R ℂ)
    (hχ : IsPrimitiveOnIdeals χ) (ψ : AddChar R ℂ) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    ‖gaussSum χ ψ‖ ^ 2 = (Fintype.card R : ℝ)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.FiniteFourier.transform_inversion
statement:
theorem transform_inversion (ψ : AddChar R ℂ) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (f : R → ℂ) (x : R) :
    (∑ a : R, transform ψ f a * ψ (-(a * x))) =
      (Fintype.card R : ℂ) * f x

name: OAI.SevenEighths.FiniteFourier.transform_primitive_character
statement:
theorem transform_primitive_character (χ : MulChar R ℂ)
    (hχ : IsPrimitiveOnIdeals χ) (ψ : AddChar R ℂ) (a : R) :
    transform ψ χ a = χ⁻¹ a * gaussSum χ ψ
