theorem exists_primitive_quotient (χ : MulChar R ℂ) :

OAI.SevenEighths.FiniteConductor.exists_primitive_product_quotient_with_bound_and_mask
statement:
theorem exists_primitive_product_quotient_with_bound_and_mask
    (χ ψ : MulChar R ℂ) (I J : Ideal R)
    (hχ : FactorsThroughIdeal χ I) (hψ : FactorsThroughIdeal ψ J) :
    ∃ (K : Ideal R) (φ : MulChar (R ⧸ K) ℂ),
      I ⊓ J ≤ K ∧ φ.toUnitHom.comp (quotientUnits K) = (χ * ψ).toUnitHom ∧
      IsPrimitiveOnIdeals φ ∧ Maximal (FactorsThroughIdeal (χ * ψ)) K ∧
      Nat.card (R ⧸ K) ≤ Nat.card (R ⧸ I) * Nat.card (R ⧸ J) ∧
      ∀ a : R, χ a * ψ a = if IsUnit a then φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk K a) else 0

statement:

    ∃ (I : Ideal R) (φ : MulChar (R ⧸ I) ℂ),
      J ≤ I ∧ φ.toUnitHom.comp (quotientUnits I) = χ.toUnitHom ∧
      IsPrimitiveOnIdeals φ ∧ Maximal (FactorsThroughIdeal χ) I

name: OAI.SevenEighths.FiniteConductor.exists_primitive_quotient_above_with_bound_and_mask
statement:
theorem exists_primitive_quotient_above_with_bound_and_mask

      J ≤ I ∧ φ.toUnitHom.comp (quotientUnits I) = χ.toUnitHom ∧
      IsPrimitiveOnIdeals φ ∧ Maximal (FactorsThroughIdeal χ) I ∧
      Nat.card (R ⧸ I) ≤ Nat.card (R ⧸ J) ∧
      ∀ a : R, χ a = if IsUnit a then φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a) else 0

        0 < σ ∧ ∀ x ∈ S, x ≤ sSup (insert (1 / 2 : ℝ) S) -
          continuationMargin (sSup (insert (1 / 2 : ℝ) S)) ω σ) :

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Continuation.nonzero_of_common_signal
statement:
theorem nonzero_of_common_signal (β ω σ c : ℝ) (hω : 0 < ω)
    (L Lregular R H : ℂ → ℂ) (J f : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hL : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ Lregular
      {s : ℂ | β - Supremum.continuationMargin β ω σ < s.re})
    (hR : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ R
      {s : ℂ | β - Supremum.continuationMargin β ω σ < s.re})
    (hH : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ H {s : ℂ | 7 / 8 < s.re})
    (hcontract : ∀ s : ℂ, 7 / 8 < s.re → ‖H s - 1‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ))
    (hlocal : LocallyIntegrableOn f (Set.Ioi 0))
    (hzero : RapidDecayAtZero f)
    (hJ : J =O[atTop] (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (7 / 8 + c + ω)))
    (herror : (fun x => J x - f x) =O[atTop]
      (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (β + c - σ)))
    (heq : ∀ s : ℂ, max (β - Supremum.continuationMargin β ω σ) 1 < s.re →
      Lregular s * signalMellin f c s = R s * gaussianMultiplier H s)
    {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : β - Supremum.continuationMargin β ω σ < ρ.re)
    (hregular : Lregular ρ = R ρ * L ρ) (hRρ : R ρ ≠ 0) : L ρ ≠ 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Continuation.nonzero_of_regularized_signal
statement:
theorem nonzero_of_regularized_signal (a b c : ℝ)
    (L Lregular R W : ℂ → ℂ) (f : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hL : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ Lregular {s : ℂ | a < s.re})
    (hR : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ R {s : ℂ | a < s.re})
    (hW : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ W {s : ℂ | a < s.re})
    (hlocal : LocallyIntegrableOn f (Set.Ioi 0))
    (htop : f =O[atTop] (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (a + c)))
    (hzero : RapidDecayAtZero f)
    (heq : ∀ s : ℂ, max a b < s.re →
      Lregular s * signalMellin f c s = R s * W s)
    {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : a < ρ.re)
    (hregular : Lregular ρ = R ρ * L ρ)
    (hRρ : R ρ ≠ 0) (hWρ : W ρ ≠ 0) : L ρ ≠ 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Continuation.product_identity_on_halfPlane

theorem mellin_mellinInv_eq (σ : ℝ) (F : ℂ → ℂ) (f : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hf : MellinConvergent f (σ : ℂ))
    (hF : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => F ((σ : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi * y * Complex.I)))
    (hcont : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => F ((σ : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi * y * Complex.I)))
    (hrep : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → f x = mellinInv σ F x) (y : ℝ) :

      F ((σ : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi * y * Complex.I)

statement:
theorem signalMellin_eq_on_line (f : ℝ → ℂ) (A : ℂ → ℂ) (c d : ℝ)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CubicDyadicDecay.mixed_descendant_le
statement:
lemma mixed_descendant_le (M N e d δ : ℝ) (hM : 0 < M) (hN : 0 < N)
    (he : 1 ≤ e) (hed : e ≤ d) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    (N/d)^(3*δ)*(M/e)^(-δ)*((M/e)*(N/d))^(2/3 : ℝ) ≤

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CubicDyadicDecay.poisson_envelope_descendant_le
statement:
theorem poisson_envelope_descendant_le (M N e d δ ξ P Q : ℝ)
    (hM : 0 < M) (hN : 0 < N) (he : 1 ≤ e) (hed : e ≤ d)
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hξ : 1 ≤ ξ) (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) :
    (N/d)^(3*δ)*(M/e)^(-δ) *
        (P*((M/e)*(N/d))^(2/3 : ℝ) + Q*(M/e)^(1-ξ)*(N/d)^(2*ξ-1)) ≤
      N^(3*δ)*M^(-δ) * (P*(M*N)^(2/3 : ℝ)+Q*M^(1-ξ)*N^(2*ξ-1))

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CubicDyadicDecay.poisson_small_power_identity

lemma poisson_small_power_identity (M N δ β : ℝ) (hM : 0 < M) (hN : 0 < N) :

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CubicDyadicDecay.secondary_descendant_le

    (N/d)^(3*δ)*(M/e)^(-δ)*(M/e)^(1-ξ)*(N/d)^(2*ξ-1) ≤
      N^(3*δ)*M^(-δ)*M^(1-ξ)*N^(2*ξ-1)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CubicDyadicDecay.secondary_monomial_identity
statement:
lemma secondary_monomial_identity (M N δ ξ : ℝ) (hM : 0 < M) (hN : 0 < N) :
    N^(3*δ)*M^(-δ)*M^(1-ξ)*N^(2*ξ-1) =
      M^(1-ξ-δ)*N^(2*ξ-1+3*δ)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CubicSieve.extracted_coefficients_energy_le

    (S : Finset ι) (coef : ι → ℂ) (χ : ι → MulChar R ℂ)
    (hχ : ∀ n ∈ S, χ n ^ 3 = 1) (b c : ι → R) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, ‖coef n * star (χ n (b n)) *
      (if IsUnit (c n) then (1 : ℂ) else 0)‖ ^ 2) ≤
      ∑ n ∈ S, ‖coef n‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CubicSieve.row_decomposition_sum
statement:

    (χ : ι → MulChar R ℂ) (hχ : ∀ n ∈ S, χ n ^ 3 = 1)
    (a b c : M) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, coef n * χ n (ρ n (a * b ^ 2 * c ^ 3))) =
      ∑ n ∈ S,
        (coef n * star (χ n (ρ n b)) *
          (if IsUnit (ρ n c) then 1 else 0)) * χ n (ρ n a)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CubicSieve.cube_family_block_energy_le
statement:
theorem cube_family_block_energy_le {c : Type*} [Fintype c]
    (A : Matrix a n ℂ) (B : Matrix b n ℂ) (coef : n → ℂ) (mask : c → n → ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, ‖A i j‖ ≤ 1) (hB : ∀ k j, ‖B k j‖ ≤ 1)
    (hmask : ∀ l j, ‖mask l j‖ ≤ 1) :
    (∑ l, ∑ k, ∑ i, ‖∑ j, A i j * star (B k j) * coef j * mask l j‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (Fintype.card c : ℝ) *
        min ((Fintype.card b : ℝ) * squaredNorm A)
          ((Fintype.card a : ℝ) * squaredNorm B) * ∑ j, ‖coef j‖ ^ 2

      min ((Fintype.card b : ℝ) * squaredNorm A)
        ((Fintype.card a : ℝ) * squaredNorm B) * ∑ j, ‖coef j‖ ^ 2

statement:
theorem canonical_transition (F M ell A t g theta V j : ℝ) :
    childF F ell A t g theta V j 0 - childM M ell A t g theta V j 0 =
      F - M + decrease ell A t g theta V ∧
    4 * childF F ell A t g theta V j 0 -
      3 * childM M ell A t g theta V j 0 =
      4 * F - 3 * M + 2 * (A + t + g - theta + V) + j

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.childF_upper
statement:
theorem childF_upper {F ell A t g theta V j delta eta : ℝ}
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hell : 0 ≤ ell) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hgt : -2 * eta ≤ g - theta) (hj : j ≤ 2 * ell + 3 * eta)
    (hdelta : delta ≤ 6 * eta) :
    childF F ell A t g theta V j delta ≤ F + 11 * eta

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.child_margins
statement:
theorem child_margins {F M Q Q' z c ell A t g theta V j delta eta : ℝ}
    (h : CanonicalMargins F M Q z c)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hj : 0 ≤ j)
    (hgt : -2 * eta ≤ g - theta) (hdelta : 0 ≤ delta) (heta : 0 ≤ eta)
    (hQ : Q' ≤ Q + decrease ell A t g theta V + 4 * eta) :
    CanonicalMargins (childF F ell A t g theta V j delta)
      (childM M ell A t g theta V j eta) Q' z (c - 7 * eta)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.child_margins_sharp
statement:
theorem child_margins_sharp {F M Q Q' z c ell A t g theta V j delta eta : ℝ}
    (h : CanonicalMargins F M Q z c)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hj : 0 ≤ j)
    (hgt : -2 * eta ≤ g - theta)
    (hQ : Q' ≤ Q + decrease ell A t g theta V + 4 * eta) :
    c + delta - 5 * eta ≤
      childF F ell A t g theta V j delta -
      childM M ell A t g theta V j eta - Q' - z ∧
    c + 4 * delta - 7 * eta ≤
      4 * childF F ell A t g theta V j delta -
      3 * childM M ell A t g theta V j eta - 6 * z

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.child_row_decrease
statement:
theorem child_row_decrease {M ell A t g theta V j eta d : ℝ}

    (hj : j ≤ 2 * ell + 3 * eta) (hterminal : d ≤ ell + V)

    3 * d / 2 ≤ M - childM M ell A t g theta V j eta

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.initial_margins
statement:
theorem initial_margins {m r z G P delta eta tau Q c₁ c₂ : ℝ}
    (h₁ : r + 2 * z ≤ m - c₁) (h₂ : 2 * r + 8 * z ≤ 3 * m - c₂)
    (hG : 0 ≤ G) (hP : -2 * eta ≤ P) (hQ : Q ≤ P + G + 3 * eta)
    (hc : 0 ≤ min c₁ c₂) (hdelta : 0 ≤ delta) (heta : eta ≤ min c₁ c₂ / 100)
    (htau : tau ≤ min c₁ c₂ / 100) :
    CanonicalMargins (initialF r z G P delta)
      (initialM m r z G P eta tau) Q (z - G) (3 * min c₁ c₂ / 4)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.initial_margins_sharp
statement:
theorem initial_margins_sharp {m r z G P delta eta tau Q c₁ c₂ : ℝ}
    (h₁ : r + 2 * z ≤ m - c₁) (h₂ : 2 * r + 8 * z ≤ 3 * m - c₂)
    (hG : 0 ≤ G) (hP : -2 * eta ≤ P) (hQ : Q ≤ P + G + 3 * eta) :
    c₁ + delta - 9 * eta - tau ≤
      initialF r z G P delta - initialM m r z G P eta tau - Q - (z - G) ∧
    c₂ + 4 * delta - 22 * eta - 3 * tau ≤
      4 * initialF r z G P delta - 3 * initialM m r z G P eta tau -
        6 * (z - G)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.initial_prefactor_identity
statement:

      2 * initialF r z G P 0 = m

OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.step_energy_exponent
statement:
theorem step_energy_exponent {F Fc kappa lambda count delta eta tau pi eps : ℝ}
    (hid : kappa + lambda + count + 2 * Fc = F)
    (hdelta : delta ≤ 6 * eta) :
    kappa + lambda + count + 2 * (Fc + delta) +
      (9 / 2 + 18 + 11 / 2) * eta + tau + pi + eps ≤
      F + 40 * eta + tau + pi + eps

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.total_step_loss
statement:
theorem total_step_loss {D eta tau pi eps : ℝ}
    (h₁ : D * eta ≤ eps / 160) (h₂ : D * tau ≤ eps / 4)
    (h₃ : D * pi ≤ eps / 4) :
    D * (40 * eta + tau + pi) ≤ 3 * eps / 4

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.fiber_energy_bound
statement:
theorem fiber_energy_bound {ι κ : Type*} [DecidableEq κ]
    (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ) (p : ι → κ) (w : ι → ℝ)
    (D E : κ → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, p i ∈ t)
    (hE : ∀ j ∈ t, 0 ≤ E j)
    (hD : ∀ j ∈ t, ∑ i ∈ s with p i = j, w i ≤ D j) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, w i * E (p i) ≤ ∑ j ∈ t, D j * E j

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.finite_expansion_energy
statement:
theorem finite_expansion_energy {κ ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (rows : Finset κ) (terms : Finset ι) (active : κ → Finset ι)
    (w F : κ → ι → ℂ) (C : ℝ)
    (hsub : ∀ k ∈ rows, active k ⊆ terms)
    (hw : ∀ k ∈ rows, ∀ i ∈ active k, ‖w k i‖ ≤ 1)
    (hcard : ∀ k ∈ rows, ((active k).card : ℝ) ≤ C) :
    (∑ k ∈ rows, ‖∑ i ∈ active k, w k i * F k i‖ ^ 2) ≤
      C * ∑ i ∈ terms, ∑ k ∈ rows, if i ∈ active k then ‖F k i‖ ^ 2 else 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.weightedEnergy_fiber_bound
statement:
theorem weightedEnergy_fiber_bound {ι κ : Type*} [DecidableEq κ]
    (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ) (p : ι → κ) (w : ι → ℝ)
    (D : κ → ℝ) (f : κ → ℂ) (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, p i ∈ t)
    (hD : ∀ j ∈ t, ∑ i ∈ s with p i = j, w i ≤ D j) :
    weightedEnergy s w (f ∘ p) ≤ weightedEnergy t D f

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.weightedEnergy_nonneg
statement:
theorem weightedEnergy_nonneg {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ)
    (f : ι → ℂ) (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) : 0 ≤ weightedEnergy s w f

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.weighted_cauchy
statement:
theorem weighted_cauchy {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ)
    (f g : ι → ℂ) (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ s, (w i : ℂ) * f i * star (g i)‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (weightedEnergy s w f) * Real.sqrt (weightedEnergy s w g)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.weighted_cauchy_fiber
statement:
theorem weighted_cauchy_fiber {ι κ : Type*} [DecidableEq κ]
    (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ) (p : ι → κ) (w : ι → ℝ)
    (D : κ → ℝ) (f g : κ → ℂ) (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, p i ∈ t)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hD : ∀ j ∈ t, ∑ i ∈ s with p i = j, w i ≤ D j) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ s, (w i : ℂ) * f (p i) * star (g (p i))‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (weightedEnergy t D f) * Real.sqrt (weightedEnergy t D g)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.localFourier_trivial_nonzero
statement:
theorem localFourier_trivial_nonzero (ψ : AddChar F ℂ)
    (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (h : F) (hh : h ≠ 0) :
    localFourier (fun t => (1 : MulChar F ℂ) t) ψ h = -1

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.localFourier_zeroMark
statement:
theorem localFourier_zeroMark (ψ : AddChar F ℂ) (h : F) :
    localFourier zeroMark ψ h = 1

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.marked_active_eq_neg_trivial
statement:
theorem marked_active_eq_neg_trivial (χ : MulChar F ℂ)
    (ψ : AddChar F ℂ) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (σ ε : Fˣ) (x : F) :
    localReflectionActive zeroMark χ ψ σ ε x =
      -localReflectionActive (fun t => (1 : MulChar F ℂ) t) χ ψ σ ε x

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.marked_inactive_coefficient
statement:
theorem marked_inactive_coefficient (ψ : AddChar F ℂ) :
    (Fintype.card F : ℂ)⁻¹ * localFourier zeroMark ψ 0 =
      (Fintype.card F : ℂ)⁻¹

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.zeroMark_complement
statement:
theorem zeroMark_complement (x : F) :
    zeroMark x = 1 - (1 : MulChar F ℂ) x

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.primeMark_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem primeMark_empty (L : σ → Finset ι) (a : σ → ι → ℂ)
    (A : Finset ι) : primeMark ∅ L a A = 1

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.primeMark_eq_tuple_sum
statement:
theorem primeMark_eq_tuple_sum (I : Finset σ) (L : σ → Finset ι)
    (a : σ → ι → ℂ) (A : Finset ι) :
    primeMark I L a A = ∑ p ∈ I.pi L,
      ∏ i ∈ I.attach, if p i.1 i.2 ∈ A then a i.1 (p i.1 i.2) else 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.primeMark_priority
statement:
theorem primeMark_priority (I : Finset σ) (L : σ → Finset ι)
    (a : σ → ι → ℂ) (A B : Finset ι) :
    primeMark I L a (A ∪ B) =
      ∑ J ∈ I.powerset, primeMark J L a A * primeMark (I \ J) L a (B \ A)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.primeMark_residual_lists
statement:
theorem primeMark_residual_lists (I : Finset σ) (L : σ → Finset ι)
    (a : σ → ι → ℂ) (A B : Finset ι) :
    primeMark I L a (B \ A) = primeMark I (fun i => L i \ A) a B

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.primeSlot_norm_le
statement:
theorem primeSlot_norm_le (L A : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℂ)
    (ha : ∀ p ∈ L, ‖a p‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖primeSlot L a A‖ ≤ ((L ∩ A).card : ℝ)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.primeSlot_priority
statement:
theorem primeSlot_priority (L A B : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℂ) :
    primeSlot L a (A ∪ B) = primeSlot L a A + primeSlot L a (B \ A)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.primeSlot_residual_list
statement:
theorem primeSlot_residual_list (L A B : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℂ) :
    primeSlot L a (B \ A) = primeSlot (L \ A) a B

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.hybrid_mask_quotients
statement:
theorem hybrid_mask_quotients {k P c R r : M}
    (hk : Squarefree k) (hP : Squarefree P) (hc : Squarefree c)
    (hPc : IsRelPrime P c) (hRk : R ∣ k) (hrk : r ∣ k)
    (hRP : R ∣ P) (hrc : r ∣ c) :
    ∃ k' P' c' : M,
      k = (R * r) * k' ∧ P = R * P' ∧ c = r * c' ∧
      IsRelPrime R r ∧ IsRelPrime k' (R * r) ∧
      IsRelPrime P' R ∧ IsRelPrime c' r ∧
      Squarefree k' ∧ Squarefree P' ∧ Squarefree c'

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.inverse_cube_square_eq_sixth
statement:
theorem inverse_cube_square_eq_sixth {z : ℂ} (h : z ^ 6 = 0 ∨ z ^ 6 = 1) :

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.inverse_eq_square_of_fourth_eq

theorem inverse_eq_square_of_fourth_eq {z : ℂ} (hz : z ^ 4 = z) :

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.inverse_square_cube_mask
statement:
theorem inverse_square_cube_mask {M : Type*} [Monoid M]
    (ψ : M →* ℂ) (n b : M) (h : ψ b ^ 6 = 0 ∨ ψ b ^ 6 = 1) :
    (ψ (n * b ^ 3))⁻¹ ^ 2 = (ψ n)⁻¹ ^ 2 * ψ b ^ 6

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.moebius_character_overlap
statement:
theorem moebius_character_overlap (ψ : M →* ℂ) {j n₀ P₀ : M}
    (hjn : IsRelPrime j n₀) (hnP : IsRelPrime n₀ P₀) (hP : Squarefree P₀) :
    (moebius (j * n₀) : ℂ) * ψ (j * n₀) * ψ (j * P₀) =
      (moebius j : ℂ) * (moebius P₀ : ℂ) * (moebius (n₀ * P₀) : ℂ) *
        ψ j ^ 2 * ψ (n₀ * P₀)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.moebius_overlap_recovery
statement:
theorem moebius_overlap_recovery {n P : M} (hnP : IsRelPrime n P)
    (hP : Squarefree P) : moebius n = moebius (n * P) * moebius P

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.moebius_squarefree_sq
statement:
theorem moebius_squarefree_sq {P : M} (hP : Squarefree P) :
    moebius P ^ 2 = 1

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.overlap_scalar_norm_le
statement: theorem overlap_scalar_norm_le {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ 1) : ‖z ^ 2‖ ≤ 1

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.bounded_coefficient_sum_sq
statement:
theorem bounded_coefficient_sum_sq {C : Type*} [Fintype C]
    (b f : C → ℂ) (hb : ∀ c, ‖b c‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖∑ c, b c * f c‖ ^ 2 ≤ (Fintype.card C : ℝ) * ∑ c, ‖f c‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.bounded_finset_coefficient_sum_sq
statement:
theorem bounded_finset_coefficient_sum_sq {C : Type*} (s : Finset C)
    (b f : C → ℂ) (hb : ∀ c ∈ s, ‖b c‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖∑ c ∈ s, b c * f c‖ ^ 2 ≤ (s.card : ℝ) * ∑ c ∈ s, ‖f c‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.column_fiber_sieve
statement:
theorem column_fiber_sieve {K X Y : Type*} [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (rows : Finset K) (source : Finset X) (target : Finset Y)
    (φ : X → Y) (q : K → Y → ℂ) (a : X → ℂ) (Q D : ℝ) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q)
    (hφ : ∀ x ∈ source, φ x ∈ target)
    (hfiber : ∀ y ∈ target, ((source.filter (fun x => φ x = y)).card : ℝ) ≤ D)
    (hsieve : ∀ f : Y → ℂ,
      (∑ k ∈ rows, ‖∑ y ∈ target, q k y * f y‖ ^ 2) ≤
        Q * ∑ y ∈ target, ‖f y‖ ^ 2) :
    (∑ k ∈ rows, ‖∑ x ∈ source, q k (φ x) * a x‖ ^ 2) ≤
      Q * D * ∑ x ∈ source, ‖a x‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.positive_triple_enlarge
statement:
theorem positive_triple_enlarge {M H C : Type*}
    [DecidableEq M] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq C]
    (pairs : Finset (M × H)) (cset : M → Finset C)
    (hs : Finset H) (mc : Finset (M × C)) (E : H → M → C → ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ p ∈ pairs, p.2 ∈ hs)
    (hm : ∀ p ∈ pairs, ∀ c ∈ cset p.1, (p.1, c) ∈ mc)
    (hE : ∀ h m c, 0 ≤ E h m c) :
    (∑ p ∈ pairs, ∑ c ∈ cset p.1, E p.2 p.1 c) ≤
      ∑ h ∈ hs, ∑ u ∈ mc, E h u.1 u.2

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.quadratic_cubic_composition
statement:
theorem quadratic_cubic_composition
    {K M H C P : Type*} [Fintype K] [Fintype M] [Fintype H] [Fintype C] [Fintype P]
    (q : K → M → H → ℂ) (χ : M → C → P → ℂ)
    (a : H → P → ℂ) (beta : C → M → H → ℂ) (Q S : ℝ) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q)
    (hbeta : ∀ c m h, ‖beta c m h‖ ≤ 1)
    (hquadratic : ∀ f : M → H → ℂ,
      (∑ k, ‖∑ m, ∑ h, q k m h * f m h‖ ^ 2) ≤ Q * ∑ m, ∑ h, ‖f m h‖ ^ 2)
    (hcubic : ∀ u : P → ℂ,
      (∑ m, ∑ c, ‖∑ p, u p * χ m c p‖ ^ 2) ≤ S * ∑ p, ‖u p‖ ^ 2) :
    (∑ k, ‖∑ m, ∑ h, q k m h *
      (∑ c, beta c m h * (∑ p, a h p * χ m c p))‖ ^ 2) ≤
      Q * (Fintype.card C : ℝ) * S * ∑ h, ∑ p, ‖a h p‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.indexedSlotAssignment_injective
statement:
theorem indexedSlotAssignment_injective (I : Finset σ) :
    Function.Injective (indexedSlotAssignment (ι:=ι) I)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.indexedSlotAssignment_support
statement:
theorem indexedSlotAssignment_support (I : Finset σ) (L : σ → Finset ι)
    (A : Finset ι) (q : ∀ i ∈ I, ι) (hq : q ∈ I.pi (fun i => L i ∩ A))
    (j : Fin I.card) :
    indexedSlotAssignment I q j ∈ L ((I.equivFin).symm j).val ∩ A

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.primeMark_indexed_assignments
statement:
theorem primeMark_indexed_assignments (I : Finset σ) (L : σ → Finset ι)
    (a : σ → ι → ℂ) (A : Finset ι) :
    primeMark I L a A =
      ∑ r ∈ (I.pi (fun i => L i ∩ A)).image (indexedSlotAssignment I),
        slotAssignmentWeight I a (fun i hi => r (I.equivFin ⟨i,hi⟩))

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseMoment.primeMark_supported_assignments
statement:
theorem primeMark_supported_assignments (I : Finset σ) (L : σ → Finset ι)
    (a : σ → ι → ℂ) (A : Finset ι) :
    primeMark I L a A = ∑ q ∈ I.pi (fun i => L i ∩ A), slotAssignmentWeight I a q

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Detector.buffered_bin_of_rounding
OAI.SevenEighths.Detector.complex_simultaneous_saturation
statement:
theorem complex_simultaneous_saturation {U δ r m ε : ℝ} {M S : ℂ}
    (hU : 1 < U) (hδ : (1 / 50 : ℝ) ≤ δ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hprod : U ^ (δ * (r + m) - ε) ≤ ‖M * S‖ ^ 2)
    (hupperM : ‖M‖ ^ 2 ≤ U ^ (δ * r + ε))
    (hupperS : ‖S‖ ^ 2 ≤ U ^ (δ * min m (1 - m) + ε)) :
    m ≤ 1 / 2 + 75 * ε ∧
      U ^ (δ * r - 2 * ε) ≤ ‖M‖ ^ 2 ∧
      U ^ (δ * m - 2 * ε) ≤ ‖S‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Detector.exists_buffered_bin
statement:
theorem exists_buffered_bin (M : ℕ → ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {e : ℝ} (he : 0 < e)
    (hbound : ∀ j ≤ n, (51 / 100 : ℝ) ≤ M j ∧ M j ≤ 1)
    (hwidth : (49 / 100 : ℝ) ≤ n * e) :
    ∃ i < n, ∃ k : ℕ,
      let a : ℝ := 51 / 100 + e * k
      a ≤ 1 ∧ a ≤ M i ∧ M i < a + e ∧ M (i + 1) < a + 2 * e

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Detector.exists_grid_rounding
statement:
theorem exists_grid_rounding {base x e : ℝ} (he : 0 < e) (hx : base ≤ x) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, base + e * k ≤ x ∧ x < base + e * k + e

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Detector.exists_small_increment
statement:
theorem exists_small_increment (M : ℕ → ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {lo hi e : ℝ} (hlo : lo ≤ M 0) (hhi : M n ≤ hi)
    (hwidth : hi - lo ≤ n * e) :
    ∃ i < n, M (i + 1) - M i ≤ e

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Detector.inverse_length_of_saturation
OAI.SevenEighths.Detector.maximal_zero_of_floor_lt
statement:
theorem maximal_zero_of_floor_lt {ι : Type*} (L : ι → ℂ → ℂ)
    (zeros : Finset (ι × ℂ)) {floor M : ℝ}
    (hzero : ∀ p ∈ zeros, L p.1 p.2 = 0)
    (hmax : M ∈ insert floor (zeros.image (fun p => p.2.re)))
    (hfloor : floor < M) :
    ∃ χ ρ, (χ, ρ) ∈ zeros ∧ L χ ρ = 0 ∧ ρ.re = M

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Detector.simultaneous_saturation
statement:
theorem simultaneous_saturation {U δ r m ε A B : ℝ}
    (hU : 1 < U) (hδ : (1 / 50 : ℝ) ≤ δ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hprod : U ^ (δ * (r + m) - ε) ≤ A * B)
    (hupperA : A ≤ U ^ (δ * r + ε))
    (hupperB : B ≤ U ^ (δ * min m (1 - m) + ε)) :
    m ≤ 1 / 2 + 75 * ε ∧
      U ^ (δ * r - 2 * ε) ≤ A ∧ U ^ (δ * m - 2 * ε) ≤ B

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Probe.common_normalization_bounds
statement:
theorem common_normalization_bounds (I A f : ℝ → ℂ) {c : ℂ}
    {Z C_low C_high D a b ε : ℝ} (hZ : 0 < Z)
    (hc : c ≠ 0) (hA : A Z ≠ 0)
    (hrecip : ‖(c * A Z)⁻¹‖ ≤ D * Z ^ ε)
    (hlow : ‖I Z‖ ≤ C_low * Z ^ a)
    (hhigh : ‖I Z - (c * A Z) * f Z‖ ≤ C_high * Z ^ b) :
    ‖normalizedProbe I A c Z‖ ≤ (C_low * D) * Z ^ (a + ε) ∧
    ‖normalizedProbe I A c Z - f Z‖ ≤ (C_high * D) * Z ^ (b + ε)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Probe.norm_div_bound
statement:
theorem norm_div_bound {I B : ℂ} {Z C D a ε : ℝ} (hZ : 0 < Z)
    (hI : ‖I‖ ≤ C * Z ^ a) (hB : ‖B⁻¹‖ ≤ D * Z ^ ε) :
    ‖I / B‖ ≤ (C * D) * Z ^ (a + ε)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Probe.normalizedProbe_error
OAI.SevenEighths.Probe.principalScalar_ne_zero
statement:
theorem principalScalar_ne_zero {ι : Type*} (slots : Finset ι)
    {Z ℓ : ℝ} {S : ι → ℝ} (hZ : 0 < Z)
    (hS : ∀ i ∈ slots, 0 < S i) : principalScalar slots Z ℓ S ≠ 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeCompensation.tupleOperation_one
statement:
theorem tupleOperation_one {α : Type*} [CommMonoid α]
    (p : Fin 1 → α) (q : α → ℝ) (η : α → ℂ)
    (hq : q 1 = 1) (hη : η 1 = 1)
    (F : α → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℂ) (X Y Z : ℝ) :
    tupleOperation p q η F X Y Z =
      star (η (p 0)) * F (p 0) X Y (Z * q (p 0)) -
      ((q (p 0) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * F 1 (X / q (p 0)) (Y / q (p 0)) Z

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeCompensation.tupleOperation_zero
statement:
theorem tupleOperation_zero {α : Type*} [CommMonoid α]
    (p : Fin 0 → α) (q : α → ℝ) (η : α → ℂ)
    (hq : q 1 = 1) (hη : η 1 = 1)
    (F : α → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℂ) (X Y Z : ℝ) :
    tupleOperation p q η F X Y Z = F 1 X Y Z

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeEuler.marked_table_resummation
statement:
theorem marked_table_resummation (R V qInv K J : ℂ) (a : ℕ)
    (hR : ‖R‖ < 1) (hV : ‖V‖ < 1) :
    markedTableSeries R V qInv K J a = markedFactor R V qInv K J a

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeEuler.unramified_marked_error
statement:
theorem unramified_marked_error (R V qInv K W D : ℂ)
    (hR : 1 - R ≠ 0) (hV : 1 - V ≠ 0) :
    markedFactor R V qInv K (-D + W * R) 1 + D =
      (R * ((1 - qInv) + (1 - V) * (W - D)) - K * V) /
        ((1 - R) * (1 - V))

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeLocal.compensatedReplacement_eq_raw
statement:
theorem compensatedReplacement_eq_raw (V W D Pstar B q : ℂ)
    (hV : 1 - V ≠ 0) (hW : 1 - W ≠ 0) (hD : 1 - D ≠ 0)
    (hP : localFactor V W Pstar ≠ 0) :
    compensatedReplacement V W D Pstar B q =
      localCorrection V W D Pstar * (B * Pstar / localFactor V W Pstar - q)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeLocal.compensatedReplacement_ramified
statement:
theorem compensatedReplacement_ramified (V Pstar B q : ℂ) (hV : 1 - V ≠ 0) :
    compensatedReplacement V 0 0 Pstar B q =
      B * (1 - V) * Pstar - q * localCorrection V 0 0 Pstar

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeLocal.continuedCorrection_defect
statement:
theorem continuedCorrection_defect (V W D Pstar : ℂ) (hD : 1 - D ≠ 0) :
    continuedCorrection V W D Pstar - 1 =
      (D * (V + W - V * W) - V * W +
        (1 - V) * (1 - W) * (Pstar + D)) / (1 - D)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeLocal.continuedCorrection_eq_raw
statement:
theorem continuedCorrection_eq_raw (V W D Pstar : ℂ)
    (hV : 1 - V ≠ 0) (hW : 1 - W ≠ 0) (hD : 1 - D ≠ 0) :
    continuedCorrection V W D Pstar = localCorrection V W D Pstar

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeLocal.continued_normalized_cancellation
statement:
theorem continued_normalized_cancellation (V W D Pstar B q vInv : ℂ)
    (hV : 1 - V ≠ 0) (hD : 1 - D ≠ 0)
    (hBD : B * D = vInv) (hvW : vInv * W = q) :
    compensatedReplacement V W D Pstar B q +
        continuedCorrection V W D Pstar * vInv =
      (1 - V) * (1 - W) / (1 - D) *
        ((vInv - q) * (V / (1 - V) - D) +
          (B + vInv - q) * (Pstar + D))

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeLocal.continued_ramified_compensation
statement:
theorem continued_ramified_compensation (V Pstar B q : ℂ) :
    compensatedReplacement V 0 0 Pstar B q =
      B * (1 - V) * Pstar - q * continuedCorrection V 0 0 Pstar

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeLocal.correction_defect
statement:
theorem correction_defect (V W D Pstar : ℂ)
    (hV : 1 - V ≠ 0) (hW : 1 - W ≠ 0) (hD : 1 - D ≠ 0) :
    localCorrection V W D Pstar - 1 =
      (D * (V + W - V * W) - V * W +
        (1 - V) * (1 - W) * (Pstar + D)) / (1 - D)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeLocal.normalized_cancellation
statement:
theorem normalized_cancellation (V W D Pstar B q vInv : ℂ)
    (hV : 1 - V ≠ 0) (hW : 1 - W ≠ 0) (hD : 1 - D ≠ 0)
    (hBD : B * D = vInv) (hvW : vInv * W = q) :
    compensatedReplacement V W D Pstar B q +
        localCorrection V W D Pstar * vInv =
      (1 - V) * (1 - W) / (1 - D) *
        ((vInv - q) * (V / (1 - V) - D) +
          (B + vInv - q) * (Pstar + D))

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeLocal.continuedCorrection_defect_bound
statement:
theorem continuedCorrection_defect_bound (V W D Pstar : ℂ)
    (hV : ‖V‖ ≤ 1/2) (hD : ‖D‖ ≤ 1/2) :
    ‖continuedCorrection V W D Pstar - 1‖ ≤
      2 * (‖D‖ * (‖V‖+‖W‖+‖V‖*‖W‖) + ‖V‖*‖W‖ +
        2*(1+‖W‖)*‖Pstar+D‖)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeLocal.inv_one_sub_norm_le_two
statement: lemma inv_one_sub_norm_le_two (a : ℂ) (ha : ‖a‖ ≤ 1/2) : ‖(1-a)⁻¹‖ ≤ 2

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeLocal.one_sub_ne_zero_of_norm_le_half
statement: lemma one_sub_ne_zero_of_norm_le_half (a : ℂ) (ha : ‖a‖ ≤ 1/2) : 1 - a ≠ 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeLocal.unramified_marked_error_bound
statement:
theorem unramified_marked_error_bound (R V qInv K W D : ℂ)
    (hR : ‖R‖ ≤ 1/2) (hV : ‖V‖ ≤ 1/2) (hq : ‖qInv‖ ≤ 1) (hD : ‖D‖ ≤ 1/2) :
    ‖ProbeEuler.markedFactor R V qInv K (-D + W*R) 1 + D‖ ≤
      12 * ‖R‖ * (1 + ‖W‖) + 4 * ‖K‖ * ‖V‖

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeGauss.finite_gauss_convolution
statement:
theorem finite_gauss_convolution {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F]
    (χ ξ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ) (h : F) :
    (∑ d : F, χ d * frequencyGauss ξ ψ (h - d)) =
      χ⁻¹ (-1) * gaussSum χ ψ * frequencyGauss (ξ * χ⁻¹) ψ h

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeGauss.frequencyGauss_eq_shift
statement:
theorem frequencyGauss_eq_shift {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F]
    (ξ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ) (h : F) :
    frequencyGauss ξ ψ h = gaussSum ξ (ψ.mulShift h)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeGauss.frequencyGauss_nonprincipal
statement:
theorem frequencyGauss_nonprincipal {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F]
    (ξ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ) (hξ : ξ ≠ 1) (h : F) :
    frequencyGauss ξ ψ h = ξ⁻¹ h * gaussSum ξ ψ

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeGauss.frequencyGauss_nonzero
statement:
theorem frequencyGauss_nonzero {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F]
    (ξ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ) {h : F} (hh : h ≠ 0) :
    frequencyGauss ξ ψ h = ξ⁻¹ h * gaussSum ξ ψ

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeGauss.frequencyGauss_principal
statement:
theorem frequencyGauss_principal {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F]
    (ψ : AddChar F ℂ) (hψ : ψ ≠ 1) (h : F) :
    frequencyGauss 1 ψ h = if h = 0 then (Nat.card Fˣ : ℂ) else -1

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeGauss.frequencyGauss_zero_nonprincipal
statement:
theorem frequencyGauss_zero_nonprincipal {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F]
    (ξ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ) (hξ : ξ ≠ 1) :
    frequencyGauss ξ ψ 0 = 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeGauss.gauss_inverse_pair
statement:
theorem gauss_inverse_pair {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F]
    (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ) (hχ : χ ≠ 1) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    gaussSum χ ψ * gaussSum χ⁻¹ ψ = χ (-1) * (Fintype.card F : ℂ)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeGauss.normalizedGauss_inverse_pair
statement:
theorem normalizedGauss_inverse_pair {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F]
    (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (ψ : AddChar F ℂ) (hχ : χ ≠ 1) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    normalizedGauss χ ψ * normalizedGauss χ⁻¹ ψ = χ (-1)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.character_mul_star
statement:
lemma character_mul_star (χ : MulChar F ℂ) {a : F} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    χ a * star (χ a) = 1

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.character_sum
statement:
lemma character_sum (χ : MulChar F ℂ) :
    (∑ x : F, χ x) = if χ = 1 then (Fintype.card F : ℂ) - 1 else 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.fullCorrelation_fourier
statement:
theorem fullCorrelation_fourier (ψ : AddChar R ℂ) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (left : X → R) (right : Y → R) (f : X → ℂ) (g : Y → ℂ) (j : R) :
    (∑ h : R, fourierSum ψ left f h * star (fourierSum ψ right g h) * ψ (-(h * j))) =
      (Fintype.card R : ℂ) * fullCorrelation left right f g j

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.fullCorrelation_reduction_unit_left
statement:
theorem fullCorrelation_reduction_unit_left (π : A →+* B)
    (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (u : A) (v : Aˣ) (k : A) (f g : B → ℂ) :
    fullCorrelation (fun x : A => (v : A) * x) (fun y : A => u * y)
        (fun x => f (π x)) (fun y => g (π y)) k =
      (reductionMultiplicity π : ℂ) *
        fullCorrelation (fun x : B => π v * x) (fun y : B => π u * y) f g (π k)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.fullCorrelation_reduction_unit_right
statement:
theorem fullCorrelation_reduction_unit_right (π : A →+* B)
    (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (u : Aˣ) (v k : A) (f g : B → ℂ) :
    fullCorrelation (fun x : A => v * x) (fun y : A => (u : A) * y)
        (fun x => f (π x)) (fun y => g (π y)) k =
      (reductionMultiplicity π : ℂ) *
        fullCorrelation (fun x : B => π v * x) (fun y : B => π u * y) f g (π k)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.fullCorrelation_swap
statement:
theorem fullCorrelation_swap (left : X → R) (right : Y → R)
    (f : X → ℂ) (g : Y → ℂ) (j : R) :
    fullCorrelation left right f g j = star (fullCorrelation right left g f (-j))

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.fullCorrelation_unit_right
statement:
theorem fullCorrelation_unit_right (u : Aˣ) (v k : A) (f g : A → ℂ) :
    fullCorrelation (fun x => v * x) (fun y => (u : A) * y) f g k =
      ∑ x : A, f x * star (g ((↑u⁻¹ : A) * (v * x - k)))

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.localCorrelation_eq_shift
OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.localCorrelation_first_zero
statement:
theorem localCorrelation_first_zero (χ : MulChar F ℂ) {n₂ : F} (h₂ : n₂ ≠ 0) (k : F) :
    localCorrelation χ 0 n₂ k =
      if χ = 1 ∧ k ≠ 0 then (Fintype.card F : ℂ) - 1 else 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.localCorrelation_second_zero
statement:
theorem localCorrelation_second_zero (χ : MulChar F ℂ) {n₁ : F} (h₁ : n₁ ≠ 0) (k : F) :
    localCorrelation χ n₁ 0 k =
      if χ = 1 ∧ k ≠ 0 then (Fintype.card F : ℂ) - 1 else 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.localCorrelation_units
OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.reductionMultiplicity_eq_pow
statement:
theorem reductionMultiplicity_eq_pow (π : A →+* B) (hπ : Function.Surjective π)
    {P c : ℕ} (hP : 0 < P) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hA : Fintype.card A = P ^ c) (hB : Fintype.card B = P) :
    reductionMultiplicity π = P ^ (c - 1)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.reductionMultiplicity_mul_card
statement:
theorem reductionMultiplicity_mul_card (π : A →+* B) (hπ : Function.Surjective π) :
    reductionMultiplicity π * Fintype.card B = Fintype.card A

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.shiftCorrelation_nonprincipal
statement:
theorem shiftCorrelation_nonprincipal (χ : MulChar F ℂ) (hχ : χ ≠ 1)
    {k : F} (hk : k ≠ 0) : shiftCorrelation χ k = -1

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.shiftCorrelation_one
statement:
theorem shiftCorrelation_one (χ : MulChar F ℂ) :
    shiftCorrelation χ 1 = χ⁻¹ (-1) * jacobiSum χ χ⁻¹

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.shiftCorrelation_principal
statement:
theorem shiftCorrelation_principal {k : F} (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    shiftCorrelation (1 : MulChar F ℂ) k = (Fintype.card F : ℂ) - 2

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.shiftCorrelation_scale
statement:
theorem shiftCorrelation_scale (χ : MulChar F ℂ) {k : F} (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    shiftCorrelation χ k = shiftCorrelation χ 1

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.shiftCorrelation_zero
statement:
theorem shiftCorrelation_zero (χ : MulChar F ℂ) :
    shiftCorrelation χ 0 = (Fintype.card F : ℂ) - 1

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.sum_reduction
statement:
theorem sum_reduction (π : A →+* B) (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (f : B → ℂ) :
    (∑ x : A, f (π x)) = (reductionMultiplicity π : ℂ) * ∑ y : B, f y

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.common_divisor_frequency
statement:
theorem common_divisor_frequency {u v d x y j : A}
    (hdu : d ∣ u) (hdv : d ∣ v) (hcong : u * v ∣ v * x - u * y - j) : d ∣ j

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.fullModulusCorrelation_eq_zero_of_common_not_dvd
statement:
theorem fullModulusCorrelation_eq_zero_of_common_not_dvd (u v d j : A)
    [Fintype (A ⧸ Ideal.span {u})] [Fintype (A ⧸ Ideal.span {v})]
    (χu : MulChar (A ⧸ Ideal.span {u}) ℂ)
    (χv : MulChar (A ⧸ Ideal.span {v}) ℂ)
    (hdu : d ∣ u) (hdv : d ∣ v) (hdj : ¬d ∣ j) :
    fullModulusCorrelation u v χu χv j = 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.fullModulusCorrelation_fourier
statement:
theorem fullModulusCorrelation_fourier (u v : A)
    [Fintype (A ⧸ Ideal.span {u})] [Fintype (A ⧸ Ideal.span {v})]
    [Fintype (A ⧸ Ideal.span {u * v})]
    (χu : MulChar (A ⧸ Ideal.span {u}) ℂ)
    (χv : MulChar (A ⧸ Ideal.span {v}) ℂ) (j : A)
    (ψ : AddChar (A ⧸ Ideal.span {u * v}) ℂ) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    (∑ h : A ⧸ Ideal.span {u * v},
      fourierSum ψ (scaledResidue u v (u * v) rfl) χu h *
        star (fourierSum ψ (scaledResidue v u (u * v) (mul_comm u v)) χv h) *
          ψ (-(h * Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {u * v}) j))) =
      (Fintype.card (A ⧸ Ideal.span {u * v}) : ℂ) * fullModulusCorrelation u v χu χv j

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.fullModulusCorrelation_zero_frequency_diagonal
statement:
theorem fullModulusCorrelation_zero_frequency_diagonal (u : A) (hu : u ≠ 0)
    [Fintype (A ⧸ Ideal.span {u})] (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ Ideal.span {u}) ℂ) :
    fullModulusCorrelation u u χ χ 0 =
      (Fintype.card (A ⧸ Ideal.span {u})ˣ : ℂ)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.fullModulusCorrelation_zero_frequency_off_diagonal
statement:
theorem fullModulusCorrelation_zero_frequency_off_diagonal (u v : A)
    [Fintype (A ⧸ Ideal.span {u})] [Fintype (A ⧸ Ideal.span {v})]
    (χu : MulChar (A ⧸ Ideal.span {u}) ℂ)
    (χv : MulChar (A ⧸ Ideal.span {v}) ℂ)
    (hne : Ideal.span ({u} : Set A) ≠ Ideal.span ({v} : Set A)) :
    fullModulusCorrelation u v χu χv 0 = 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.scaledResidue_congruence
statement:
theorem scaledResidue_congruence (u v x y j : A) :
    scaledResidue u v (u * v) rfl (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {u}) x) -
      scaledResidue v u (u * v) (mul_comm u v)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {v}) y) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {u * v}) j ↔
      u * v ∣ v * x - u * y - j

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.scaledResidue_injective
statement:
theorem scaledResidue_injective (d a m : A) (hm : m = d * a) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (scaledResidue d a m hm)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.scaledResidue_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem scaledResidue_mk (d a m : A) (hm : m = d * a) (x : A) :
    scaledResidue d a m hm (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {d}) x) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {m}) (a * x)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.zero_frequency_units_force_divides
statement:

statement:
@[simp] lemma leftParam_mk (C n₁ b k t : A) :

statement:
lemma param_condition (C n₁ n₂ a b k : A) (hab : a*n₁+b*n₂=1) (t : ResidueQ C) :

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeGramCommon.param_injective
statement:
lemma param_injective (C n₁ n₂ a b k : A) (hab : a*n₁+b*n₂=1) (hn₁ : n₁≠0) :

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeGramCommon.param_surjective
statement:
lemma param_surjective (C n₁ n₂ a b k : A) (hC : C≠0) (hab : a*n₁+b*n₂=1) :

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeGramCommon.rightParam_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma rightParam_mk (C n₂ a k t : A) :

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeGramCommon.solutionEquiv_val
statement:
@[simp] lemma solutionEquiv_val (C n₁ n₂ a b k : A) (hC : C≠0) (hn₁ : n₁≠0)
    (hab : a*n₁+b*n₂=1) (t : ResidueQ C) :
    (solutionEquiv C n₁ n₂ a b k hC hn₁ hab t).val=(leftParam C n₁ b k t,rightParam C n₂ a k t)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeGramCommon.fullCorrelation_bezout
statement:
theorem fullCorrelation_bezout [Fintype R] (n₁ n₂ a b k : R) (hab : a*n₁+b*n₂=1)
    (f g : R→ℂ) :
    fullCorrelation (fun x=>n₂*x) (fun y=>n₁*y) f g k=
      ∑t : R,f (b*k+n₁*t)*star (g (-a*k+n₂*t))

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeGramCommon.fullCorrelation_bezout_norm
statement:
theorem fullCorrelation_bezout_norm [Fintype R] (n₁ n₂ a b k : R) (hab : a*n₁+b*n₂=1)
    (f g : R→ℂ) (hf : ∀x,‖f x‖≤1) (hg : ∀x,‖g x‖≤1) :
    ‖fullCorrelation (fun x=>n₂*x) (fun y=>n₁*y) f g k‖≤(Fintype.card R:ℝ)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeGramCommon.fullModulusCorrelation_parameter
statement:
theorem fullModulusCorrelation_parameter (C n₁ n₂ a b k : A) (hC : C≠0) (hn₁ : n₁≠0)
    (hab : a*n₁+b*n₂=1)
    [Fintype (ResidueQ C)] [Fintype (ResidueQ (C*n₁))] [Fintype (ResidueQ (C*n₂))]
    (χ : MulChar (ResidueQ (C*n₁)) ℂ) (ψ : MulChar (ResidueQ (C*n₂)) ℂ) :
    fullModulusCorrelation (C*n₁) (C*n₂) χ ψ (C*k)=
      ∑t : ResidueQ C,χ (leftParam C n₁ b k t)*star (ψ (rightParam C n₂ a k t))

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeGramCommon.fullModulusCorrelation_solutions
statement:
lemma fullModulusCorrelation_solutions (C n₁ n₂ k : A)
    [Fintype (ResidueQ (C*n₁))] [Fintype (ResidueQ (C*n₂))]
    (χ : MulChar (ResidueQ (C*n₁)) ℂ) (ψ : MulChar (ResidueQ (C*n₂)) ℂ) :
    fullModulusCorrelation (C*n₁) (C*n₂) χ ψ (C*k)=
      ∑p : Solutions C n₁ n₂ k,χ p.val.1*star (ψ p.val.2)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeEuler.factor_ne_zero_of_defect
statement: lemma factor_ne_zero_of_defect (a : ℂ) (ha : ‖a-1‖ ≤ 1/2) : a ≠ 0

statement:
lemma log_summable_of_defect {ι : Type*} (F : ι → ℂ) (b : ι → ℝ)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeEuler.norm_log_le_defect

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeEuler.norm_log_sum_le
statement:

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeEuler.normalProduct_analytic
statement:
theorem normalProduct_analytic {ι : Type*} (F : ι → ℂ → ℂ) (b : ι → ℝ)
    (U : Set ℂ) (hU : IsOpen U) (hb : Summable b)
    (hF : ∀ i, AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (F i) U)
    (hbound : ∀ i s, s ∈ U → ‖F i s-1‖ ≤ b i)
    (hhalf : ∀ i, b i ≤ 1/2) :

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ProbeEuler.product_eq_exp_log
statement:
lemma product_eq_exp_log {ι : Type*} (F : ι → ℂ) (b : ι → ℝ)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ThetaProduct.rapid_product_sub
statement:
theorem rapid_product_sub (f g : ℝ → ℂ) (a b : ℂ)
    (hf : ∀ r : ℝ, (fun x => f x - a) =O[atTop] (fun x : ℝ => x ^ r))

theorem rectangularPair_differentiableAt (a b : UnitAddCircle) (u v : ℝ)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ThetaProduct.rectangularPair_hasSum
statement:
theorem rectangularPair_hasSum (a b u v : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) (hv : 0 < v)

statement:
theorem positive_log_fourier_bound
    (V F : ℝ → ℂ) (R m Lwin CW CF : ℝ) (A J : ℕ)
    (hVc : HasCompactSupport V)
    (hVs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V)
    (hFpos : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Set.Ioi 0))
    (hR : 0 < R) (hm : 0 < m) (hm1 : m ≤ 1)
    (hL : 0 ≤ Lwin) (hCW : 0 ≤ CW) (hCF : 0 ≤ CF)
    (hVderiv : ∀ i ≤ J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower, ∀ s,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i V s‖ ≤ CW)
    (hwindow : ∀ s,
      (∃ i ≤ J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i V s‖ ≠ 0) →
        m ≤ Real.exp s ∧ |s| ≤ Lwin)
    (hEuler : ∀ i ≤ J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower,
      ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
        (1 + x) ^ A * ‖eulerDeriv F i x‖ ≤ CF) :
    (1 + R) ^ A *
      (∫ t : ℝ, (1 + ‖t‖) ^ J *
        ‖(𝓕 (positiveLogProfile V F R hVc hVs hFpos hR)) t‖) ≤
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ J *
        (FourierBridge.coefficientMomentBound 0
          (momentConstant (J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower)
            Lwin CW CF) +
         FourierBridge.coefficientMomentBound J
          (momentConstant (J + (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower)
            Lwin CW CF))) / m ^ A

    (hwindow : ∀ s,

      (∫ t : ℝ, (1 + ‖t‖) ^ J *
        ‖(𝓕 (positiveLogProfile V F R hVc hVs hFpos hR)) t‖) ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ J *
        (FourierBridge.coefficientMomentBound 0

      (1 + x) ^ A * ‖eulerDeriv F i x‖ ≤ CF)
    (s : ℝ) :

      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n

    (V F : ℝ → ℂ) (R m Lwin CW CF C : ℝ) (A K n : ℕ)
    (hVc : HasCompactSupport V)
    (hVs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V)

    (hR : 0 < R) (hm : 0 < m) (hm1 : m ≤ 1)

    (hn : n ≤ K)
    (hVderiv : ∀ i ≤ K, ∀ s,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i V s‖ ≤ CW)
    (hwindow : ∀ s,
      (∃ i ≤ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i V s‖ ≠ 0) →

    (hEuler : ∀ i ≤ K, ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →

    (hCbound : ∀ j ≤ K,
      (1 + Lwin ^ (volume : Measure ℝ).integrablePower) *

    (N M : ℕ)
    (hlow : ∀ k ≤ N, ‖F k‖ ≤ C * r ^ k)
    (hhigh : ∀ m, ‖F (N + 1 + m)‖ ≤ C * r ^ N * b m) :
    ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1 + M), F k‖ ≤
      C * (r ^ (N + 1) / (r - 1) + r ^ N * ∑' m, b m)

name: OAI.DyadicTransfer.finite_exp_reassembly
statement:
theorem finite_exp_reassembly (a : ℕ → ℂ) (φ : ℝ → ℂ)
    (ha0 : a 0 = 0)
    (hsmall : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 1 → φ y = 1)
    (hlarge : ∀ y : ℝ, 2 ≤ y → φ y = 0)
    (D : ℝ) (N K : ℕ)
    (hK : ∀ n ∈ Finset.range N, 1 ≤ n → (n : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ K) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, a n * Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) / D)) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
          a n * expAnnularTest φ D k ((n : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k)

theorem norm_horizontalSlice_le (F : SchwartzMap ℂ ℂ) (η ξ : ℝ) :
    ‖horizontalSlice F η ξ‖ ≤
      (planeDecayConstant F / (1 + η ^ 2)) * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.norm_inverse_horizontalSlice_le
statement:
theorem norm_inverse_horizontalSlice_le (F : SchwartzMap ℂ ℂ) (η x : ℝ) :
    ‖(𝓕⁻ (horizontalSlice F η)) x‖ ≤
      (planeDecayConstant F / (1 + η ^ 2)) * Real.pi

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.norm_inverse_lineDeriv
statement:
theorem norm_inverse_lineDeriv (g : SchwartzMap ℝ ℂ) (x : ℝ) :
    ‖(𝓕⁻ (∂_{(1 : ℝ)} g)) x‖ =
      (2 * Real.pi) * |x| * ‖(𝓕⁻ g) x‖

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.norm_le_verticalMajorant
statement:
theorem norm_le_verticalMajorant (f : SchwartzMap ℂ ℂ) (x y : ℝ) :
    ‖f (complexPoint x y)‖ ≤ verticalMajorant f y

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.norm_partialFourier_le
statement:
theorem norm_partialFourier_le (f : SchwartzMap ℂ ℂ) (η x : ℝ) :
    ‖partialFourier f η x‖ ≤
      partialFourierDecayConstant f * ((1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹)

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.partialFourierDecayConstant_nonneg
statement:
theorem partialFourierDecayConstant_nonneg (f : SchwartzMap ℂ ℂ) :

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.partialFourierSchwartz_apply
statement:
theorem partialFourierSchwartz_apply (f : SchwartzMap ℂ ℂ) (η x : ℝ) :

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.partialFourierSchwartz_coe
statement:
theorem partialFourierSchwartz_coe (f : SchwartzMap ℂ ℂ) (η : ℝ) :

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.partialFourier_continuous
statement:
theorem partialFourier_continuous (f : SchwartzMap ℂ ℂ) (η : ℝ) :

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.partialFourier_eq_exp_integral
statement:
theorem partialFourier_eq_exp_integral (f : SchwartzMap ℂ ℂ) (η x : ℝ) :
    partialFourier f η x = ∫ y : ℝ,
      Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * (y * η) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        f ((x : ℂ) + Complex.I * (y : ℂ))

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.partialFourier_eq_integral
statement:
theorem partialFourier_eq_integral (f : SchwartzMap ℂ ℂ) (η x : ℝ) :
    partialFourier f η x =
      ∫ y : ℝ, Real.fourierChar (-inner ℝ y η) • f (complexPoint x y)

name: OAI.second_prefactor_identity
statement:
theorem second_prefactor_identity
    (Y qe qg qx₁ qx₂ Li : ℝ)
    (hqe : 0 < qe) (hqg : 0 < qg) (hqx₁ : 0 < qx₁)
    (hqx₂ : 0 < qx₂) (hLi : 0 < Li) :
    Y / (qe * Real.sqrt ((qx₁ / qg) * (qx₂ / qg))) =
      (Y * qg / (qe * Li)) * Real.sqrt (Li / qx₁) * Real.sqrt (Li / qx₂)

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.actual_eisenstein_coset_poisson
statement:
theorem actual_eisenstein_coset_poisson (f : 𝓢(ℂ, ℂ)) (b c : O) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (∑' z : O, f (eisEmbedding (b + c * z))) =
      (2 / (Real.sqrt 3 * ‖eisEmbedding c‖ ^ 2)) • ∑' p : ℤ × ℤ,
        Real.fourierChar (inner ℝ (eisEmbedding b)
          (eisensteinDualFrequency (eisEmbedding c) (eisEmbedding_ne_zero hc) p)) •
        (𝓕 f) (eisensteinDualFrequency (eisEmbedding c) (eisEmbedding_ne_zero hc) p)

theorem actual_eisenstein_coset_summable_norm (f : 𝓢(ℂ, ℂ)) (b c : O) (hc : c ≠ 0) :

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.affinePullback_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem affinePullback_apply (f : 𝓢(ℂ, ℂ)) (A : ℂ ≃L[ℝ] ℂ) (b z : ℂ) :
    affinePullback f A b z = f (A z + b)

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.affine_lattice_poisson
statement:
theorem affine_lattice_poisson (f : 𝓢(ℂ, ℂ)) (A : ℂ ≃L[ℝ] ℂ) (b : ℂ) :
    (∑' p : ℤ × ℤ, f (A (complexPoint (p.1 : ℝ) (p.2 : ℝ)) + b)) =
      inverseJacobian A • ∑' p : ℤ × ℤ,
        Real.fourierChar (inner ℝ b (dualMap A (complexPoint (p.1 : ℝ) (p.2 : ℝ)))) •
          (𝓕 f) (dualMap A (complexPoint (p.1 : ℝ) (p.2 : ℝ)))

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.basisEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem basisEquiv_apply (w : ℂ) (hw : w.im ≠ 0) (z : ℂ) :
    basisEquiv w hw z = (z.re : ℂ) + w * (z.im : ℂ)

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.basisEquiv_det
statement:
theorem basisEquiv_det (w : ℂ) (hw : w.im ≠ 0) :
    LinearMap.det ((basisEquiv w hw) : ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] ℂ) = w.im

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.basisEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem basisEquiv_symm_apply (w : ℂ) (hw : w.im ≠ 0) (z : ℂ) :
    (basisEquiv w hw).symm z =
      complexPoint (z.re - z.im * w.re / w.im) (z.im / w.im)

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.basisMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem basisMap_apply (w z : ℂ) :
    basisMap w z = (z.re : ℂ) + w * (z.im : ℂ)

statement:
@[simp] theorem complexMulEquiv_apply (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (z : ℂ) :

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.complexMulEquiv_det
statement:
theorem complexMulEquiv_det (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.complexMulEquiv_symm_apply

@[simp] theorem complexMulEquiv_symm_apply (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (z : ℂ) :

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.dualMap_trans
statement:
theorem dualMap_trans (A B : ℂ ≃L[ℝ] ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    dualMap (A.trans B) z = dualMap B (dualMap A z)

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.dual_basis_apply
statement:
theorem dual_basis_apply (w : ℂ) (hw : w.im ≠ 0) (z : ℂ) :
    dualMap (basisEquiv w hw) z =
      complexPoint z.re ((z.im - w.re * z.re) / w.im)

statement:
theorem dual_lattice_summable_norm (f : 𝓢(ℂ, ℂ)) (A : ℂ ≃L[ℝ] ℂ) :

statement:
theorem dual_mul_apply (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (z : ℂ) :
    dualMap (complexMulEquiv c hc) z = (starRingEnd ℂ c)⁻¹ * z

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.eisensteinDualFrequency_explicit
statement:
theorem eisensteinDualFrequency_explicit (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (p : ℤ × ℤ) :
    eisensteinDualFrequency c hc p =
      complexPoint (p.1 : ℝ) (((p.1 : ℝ) + 2 * (p.2 : ℝ)) / Real.sqrt 3) /
        starRingEnd ℂ c

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.eisensteinLatticeMap_point
statement:
theorem eisensteinLatticeMap_point (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (p : ℤ × ℤ) :
    eisensteinLatticeMap c hc (complexPoint (p.1 : ℝ) (p.2 : ℝ)) =

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.eisenstein_inverseJacobian
statement:
theorem eisenstein_inverseJacobian (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    inverseJacobian (eisensteinLatticeMap c hc) = 2 / (Real.sqrt 3 * ‖c‖ ^ 2)

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.finite_phase_sum
statement:
theorem finite_phase_sum {R : Type*} [Fintype R]
    (f : 𝓢(ℂ, ℂ)) (A : ℂ ≃L[ℝ] ℂ) (b : R → ℂ) (P : R → ℂ) :
    (∑ r : R, P r * (inverseJacobian A • ∑' p : ℤ × ℤ,
      Real.fourierChar (inner ℝ (b r) (dualMap A (complexPoint (p.1 : ℝ) (p.2 : ℝ)))) •
        (𝓕 f) (dualMap A (complexPoint (p.1 : ℝ) (p.2 : ℝ))))) =
    inverseJacobian A • ∑' p : ℤ × ℤ,
      (∑ r : R, P r * (Real.fourierChar (inner ℝ (b r)
        (dualMap A (complexPoint (p.1 : ℝ) (p.2 : ℝ)))) : ℂ)) *
        (𝓕 f) (dualMap A (complexPoint (p.1 : ℝ) (p.2 : ℝ)))

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.fourier_affinePullback
statement:
theorem fourier_affinePullback (f : 𝓢(ℂ, ℂ)) (A : ℂ ≃L[ℝ] ℂ) (b w : ℂ) :
    (𝓕 (affinePullback f A b)) w =
      inverseJacobian A •
        (Real.fourierChar (inner ℝ b (dualMap A w)) • (𝓕 f) (dualMap A w))

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.fourier_comp_linearEquiv
statement:
theorem fourier_comp_linearEquiv (A : ℂ ≃L[ℝ] ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (w : ℂ) :
    𝓕 (f ∘ A) w = inverseJacobian A • 𝓕 f (dualMap A w)

statement:
theorem fourier_translate (f : ℂ → ℂ) (b w : ℂ) :
    𝓕 (fun z => f (z + b)) w =
      Real.fourierChar (inner ℝ b w) • 𝓕 f w

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.inner_linear_dual
statement:
theorem inner_linear_dual (A : ℂ ≃L[ℝ] ℂ) (x y : ℂ) :
    inner ℝ (A x) (dualMap A y) = inner ℝ x y

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.integral_comp_linearEquiv
statement:
theorem integral_comp_linearEquiv (A : ℂ ≃L[ℝ] ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) :
    (∫ x : ℂ, f (A x)) = inverseJacobian A • ∫ x : ℂ, f x

statement: theorem inverseJacobian_pos (A : ℂ ≃L[ℝ] ℂ) : 0 < inverseJacobian A

@[simp] theorem radialTest_apply (W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (z : ℂ) :

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.scaledBasisEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem scaledBasisEquiv_apply (w : ℂ) (hw : w.im ≠ 0)
    (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (z : ℂ) :
    scaledBasisEquiv w hw c hc z = c * ((z.re : ℂ) + w * (z.im : ℂ))

name: OAI.EisensteinSchwartzPoisson.scaledBasisEquiv_det

theorem scaledBasisEquiv_det (w : ℂ) (hw : w.im ≠ 0) (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :

@[simp] theorem translateSchwartz_apply (f : 𝓢(ℂ, ℂ)) (b z : ℂ) :

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.addChar_finite_crt_factor
statement:
theorem addChar_finite_crt_factor {ι T : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (R : ι → Type*) [CommRing T] [∀ i, CommRing (R i)]
    (e : T ≃+* ∀ i, R i) (ψ : AddChar T ℂ) (x : T) :
    ψ x = ∏ i, coordinateAddChar R e ψ i (e x i)

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.finite_prod_eq_iInf
statement:
theorem finite_prod_eq_iInf {ι A : Type*} [Fintype ι] [CommRing A]
    (P : ι → Ideal A) (hc : Pairwise (Function.onFun IsCoprime P)) :
    (∏ i, P i) = ⨅ i, P i

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.gauss_transform_finite_crt
statement:
theorem gauss_transform_finite_crt {ι T : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (R : ι → Type*) [CommRing T] [∀ i, Field (R i)]
    [Fintype T] [∀ i, Fintype (R i)]
    (e : T ≃+* ∀ i, R i)
    (χ : ∀ i, MulChar (R i) ℂ) (ψ : AddChar T ℂ)
    (hχ : ∀ i, χ i ≠ 1) (h : T) :
    (∑ x : T, (∏ i, χ i (e x i)) * ψ (h * x)) =
      ∏ i, if e h i = 0 then 0 else
        (χ i (e h i))⁻¹ * gaussSum (χ i) (coordinateAddChar R e ψ i)

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.gauss_transform_finite_crt_scalar
statement:
theorem gauss_transform_finite_crt_scalar {ι T : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (R : ι → Type*) [CommRing T] [∀ i, Field (R i)]
    [Fintype T] [∀ i, Fintype (R i)]
    (e : T ≃+* ∀ i, R i)
    (χ : ∀ i, MulChar (R i) ℂ) (ψ : AddChar T ℂ)
    (hχ : ∀ i, χ i ≠ 1) (h : T) :
    (∑ x : T, (∏ i, χ i (e x i)) * ψ (h * x)) =
      (∏ i, χ i (e h i))⁻¹ *
        ∑ x : T, (∏ i, χ i (e x i)) * ψ x

name: OAI.IdealGaussCRT.gauss_transform_finite_ideal_crt
statement:
theorem gauss_transform_finite_ideal_crt {ι A : Type*} [Fintype ι] [CommRing A]
    (P : ι → Ideal A) (hc : Pairwise (Function.onFun IsCoprime P))
    [∀ i, (P i).IsMaximal]
    [Fintype (A ⧸ ∏ i, P i)] [∀ i, Fintype (A ⧸ P i)]
    (χ : ∀ i, MulChar (A ⧸ P i) ℂ)
    (ψ : AddChar (A ⧸ ∏ i, P i) ℂ) (hχ : ∀ i, χ i ≠ 1)
    (h : A ⧸ ∏ i, P i) :
    (∑ x : A ⧸ ∏ i, P i, (∏ i, χ i (quotientProdEquivPi P hc x i)) * ψ (h * x)) =
      ∏ i, if quotientProdEquivPi P hc h i = 0 then 0 else
        (χ i (quotientProdEquivPi P hc h i))⁻¹ *
          gaussSum (χ i) (coordinateAddChar (fun i => A ⧸ P i)
            (quotientProdEquivPi P hc) ψ i)

name: OAI.ActualEisensteinCubic.tsum_masked_radial_dilations
statement:
theorem tsum_masked_radial_dilations
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (P : ι → Ideal O)
    [∀ i, (P i).IsMaximal] (hinj : Function.Injective P) (S : Finset ι)
    (r : O → ℂ) (hr : ∀ a b, r (a * b) = r a * r b)
    (W : ℝ → ℂ) (scale : ℝ)
    (hsum : Summable (fun u : O => r u * W (‖eisEmbedding u‖ ^ 2 / scale))) :
    (∑' u : O, rowCoprimeMask P S u * r u * W (‖eisEmbedding u‖ ^ 2 / scale)) =
      ∑ E ∈ S.powerset,
        (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.moebius (∏ i ∈ E, P i) : ℂ) *
          r (primeSubsetGenerator P E) *
          ∑' z : O, r z *
            W (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / (scale / ‖eisEmbedding (primeSubsetGenerator P E)‖ ^ 2))

name: OAI.ActualEisensteinCubic.tsum_rowCoprimeMask_dilations
statement:
theorem tsum_rowCoprimeMask_dilations

    [∀ i, (P i).IsMaximal] (hinj : Function.Injective P)
    (S : Finset ι) (f : O → ℂ) (hf : Summable f) :
    (∑' u : O, rowCoprimeMask P S u * f u) =
      ∑ E ∈ S.powerset,
        (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.moebius (∏ i ∈ E, P i) : ℂ) *
          ∑' z : O, f (primeSubsetGenerator P E * z)

name: OAI.ActualEisensteinCubic.tsum_rowCoprimeMask_subsets
statement:
theorem tsum_rowCoprimeMask_subsets
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (P : ι → Ideal O) (S : Finset ι)
    (f : O → ℂ) (hf : Summable f) :
    (∑' u : O, rowCoprimeMask P S u * f u) =
      ∑ E ∈ S.powerset, (-1 : ℂ) ^ E.card *
        ∑' u : O, if ∀ i ∈ E, u ∈ P i then f u else 0

    (p : ι → O) (hp : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (hcop : Pairwise (Function.onFun IsCoprime (fun i => Ideal.span {p i})))
    (i : ι) (u v : O) (hbez : u * p i + v * cofactor p i = 1) :
    IdealGaussCRT.coordinateAddChar (fun i => O ⧸ Ideal.span {p i}) (productElementCRT p hcop)
      (eisTraceModChar ShortDraftTrace.breveE ConcreteBreveE.breveE_period_coordinates
        (∏ k, p k) (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun k _ => hp k))) i =

    (p : ι → O) (hp : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (hcop : Pairwise (Function.onFun IsCoprime (fun i => Ideal.span {p i})))
    [Fintype (O ⧸ Ideal.span {∏ i, p i})] [∀ i, Fintype (O ⧸ Ideal.span {p i})]
    (χ : ∀ i, MulChar (O ⧸ Ideal.span {p i}) ℂ) :
    (∑ x : O ⧸ Ideal.span {∏ i, p i},
      (∏ i, χ i (productElementCRT p hcop x i)) *
        eisTraceModChar ShortDraftTrace.breveE ConcreteBreveE.breveE_period_coordinates
          (∏ i, p i) (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => hp i)) x) =
      ∏ i, χ i (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {p i}) (cofactor p i)) *
        gaussSum (χ i) (eisTraceModChar ShortDraftTrace.breveE
          ConcreteBreveE.breveE_period_coordinates (p i) (hp i))

    gaussSum (χ.ringHomComp (algebraMap F' E)) ψ ^ Fintype.card F' =

    (χ : MulChar F F') (hχ : χ ≠ 1) (ψ : AddChar F E) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (a : F') (m : ℕ) (hm : Fintype.card F' = 3 * m + 1)

    χ (Fintype.card F' : F) * a ^ m = 1

theorem quadratic_gauss_finite_crt_eq_square_sum {ι T : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (R : ι → Type*) [CommRing T] [∀ i, Field (R i)]
    [Fintype T] [∀ i, Fintype (R i)]
    (e : T ≃+* ∀ i, R i) (ψ : AddChar T ℂ)
    (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (hchar : ∀ i, ringChar (R i) ≠ 2) :
    (∑ x : T, (∏ i, ((quadraticChar (R i)).ringHomComp (Int.castRingHom ℂ)) (e x i)) * ψ x) =
      ∑ x : T, ψ (x ^ 2)

    (e : T ≃+* ∀ i, R i) (ψ : AddChar T ℂ) :
    (∑ x : T, ψ (x ^ 2)) =
      ∏ i, ∑ y : R i, coordinateAddChar R e ψ i (y ^ 2)

    (ha0 : a 0 = 0)
    (hF : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t →
      HasSum (fun n : ℕ => a n * W ((n : ℝ) * t)) (F t))
    (hint : ∀ n : ℕ,
      IntegrableOn
        (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) * (a n * W ((n : ℝ) * t)))
        (Set.Ioi 0))
    (hsumint : Summable (fun n : ℕ =>
      ∫ t : ℝ in Set.Ioi 0,
        ‖(t : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) * (a n * W ((n : ℝ) * t))‖))

    (hcoeff : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≠ 0 →

        ShortDraftHeckeBridge.pairInverseCoeff χ ψ n)
    (hcoeff0 : ShortDraftHeckeBridge.normFiberCoeff weight 0 = 0)
    (W F : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hF : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t →
      HasSum (fun n : ℕ =>
        ShortDraftHeckeBridge.normFiberCoeff weight n * W ((n : ℝ) * t)) (F t))
    (s : ℂ) (hs : 1 < s.re)
    (hint : ∀ n : ℕ,
      IntegrableOn
        (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) *
          (ShortDraftHeckeBridge.normFiberCoeff weight n * W ((n : ℝ) * t)))
        (Set.Ioi 0))
    (hsumint : Summable (fun n : ℕ =>
      ∫ t : ℝ in Set.Ioi 0,
        ‖(t : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) *
          (ShortDraftHeckeBridge.normFiberCoeff weight n * W ((n : ℝ) * t))‖)) :
    (χ.LFunction s * ψ.LFunction s) *
      mellin (fun D : ℝ => F D⁻¹) (-s) = mellin W s

    (hcoeff : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≠ 0 →
      ShortDraftHeckeBridge.normFiberCoeff weight n =
        ShortDraftHeckeBridge.pairInverseCoeff χ ψ n)
    (hcoeff0 : ShortDraftHeckeBridge.normFiberCoeff weight 0 = 0)
    (W F : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hF : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t →
      HasSum (fun n : ℕ =>
        ShortDraftHeckeBridge.normFiberCoeff weight n * W ((n : ℝ) * t)) (F t))
    (hint : ∀ (s : ℂ), 1 < s.re → ∀ n : ℕ,
      IntegrableOn
        (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) *
          (ShortDraftHeckeBridge.normFiberCoeff weight n * W ((n : ℝ) * t)))
        (Set.Ioi 0))
    (hsumint : ∀ (s : ℂ), 1 < s.re → Summable (fun n : ℕ =>
      ∫ t : ℝ in Set.Ioi 0,
        ‖(t : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) *
          (ShortDraftHeckeBridge.normFiberCoeff weight n * W ((n : ℝ) * t))‖))
    (σ : ℝ) (hσ : σ < 1)
    (hlocal : LocallyIntegrableOn (fun D : ℝ => F D⁻¹) (Set.Ioi 0))
    (hzero : (fun D : ℝ => F D⁻¹) =ᶠ[𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)] (fun _ => 0))
    (htop : (fun D : ℝ => F D⁻¹) =O[atTop] (fun D : ℝ => D ^ σ))
    (hWanalytic : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (mellin W) {s : ℂ | σ < s.re})

theorem pair_zero_free_of_compact_weight_bound_principal_left
    {q r : ℕ} [NeZero q] [NeZero r]
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ r) (hψ : ψ ≠ 1)
    (weight : Ideal ShortDraftHeckeBridge.O → ℂ)
    (hcoeff : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≠ 0 →
      ShortDraftHeckeBridge.normFiberCoeff weight n =
        ShortDraftHeckeBridge.pairInverseCoeff
          (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) ψ n)
    (hcoeff0 : ShortDraftHeckeBridge.normFiberCoeff weight 0 = 0)
    (W F : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hF : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t →
      HasSum (fun n : ℕ =>
        ShortDraftHeckeBridge.normFiberCoeff weight n * W ((n : ℝ) * t)) (F t))
    (hint : ∀ (s : ℂ), 1 < s.re → ∀ n : ℕ,
      IntegrableOn
        (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) *
          (ShortDraftHeckeBridge.normFiberCoeff weight n * W ((n : ℝ) * t)))
        (Set.Ioi 0))
    (hsumint : ∀ (s : ℂ), 1 < s.re → Summable (fun n : ℕ =>
      ∫ t : ℝ in Set.Ioi 0,
        ‖(t : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) *
          (ShortDraftHeckeBridge.normFiberCoeff weight n * W ((n : ℝ) * t))‖))
    (σ : ℝ) (hσ : σ < 1)
    (hlocal : LocallyIntegrableOn (fun D : ℝ => F D⁻¹) (Set.Ioi 0))
    (hzero : (fun D : ℝ => F D⁻¹) =ᶠ[𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)] (fun _ => 0))
    (htop : (fun D : ℝ => F D⁻¹) =O[atTop] (fun D : ℝ => D ^ σ))
    (hWanalytic : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (mellin W) {s : ℂ | σ < s.re})
    (ρ : ℂ) (hρ : σ < ρ.re) (hρone : ρ ≠ 1)
    (hWρ : mellin W ρ ≠ 0) :
    (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ q).LFunction ρ ≠ 0 ∧
      ψ.LFunction ρ ≠ 0

name: OAI.CompactMellinBridge.pair_zero_free_of_compact_weight_bound_principal_right
statement:
theorem pair_zero_free_of_compact_weight_bound_principal_right
    {q r : ℕ} [NeZero q] [NeZero r]
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hχ : χ ≠ 1)
    (weight : Ideal ShortDraftHeckeBridge.O → ℂ)
    (hcoeff : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≠ 0 →
      ShortDraftHeckeBridge.normFiberCoeff weight n =
        ShortDraftHeckeBridge.pairInverseCoeff χ
          (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ r) n)
    (hcoeff0 : ShortDraftHeckeBridge.normFiberCoeff weight 0 = 0)
    (W F : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hF : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t →
      HasSum (fun n : ℕ =>
        ShortDraftHeckeBridge.normFiberCoeff weight n * W ((n : ℝ) * t)) (F t))
    (hint : ∀ (s : ℂ), 1 < s.re → ∀ n : ℕ,
      IntegrableOn
        (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) *
          (ShortDraftHeckeBridge.normFiberCoeff weight n * W ((n : ℝ) * t)))
        (Set.Ioi 0))
    (hsumint : ∀ (s : ℂ), 1 < s.re → Summable (fun n : ℕ =>
      ∫ t : ℝ in Set.Ioi 0,
        ‖(t : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) *
          (ShortDraftHeckeBridge.normFiberCoeff weight n * W ((n : ℝ) * t))‖))
    (σ : ℝ) (hσ : σ < 1)
    (hlocal : LocallyIntegrableOn (fun D : ℝ => F D⁻¹) (Set.Ioi 0))
    (hzero : (fun D : ℝ => F D⁻¹) =ᶠ[𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)] (fun _ => 0))
    (htop : (fun D : ℝ => F D⁻¹) =O[atTop] (fun D : ℝ => D ^ σ))
    (hWanalytic : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (mellin W) {s : ℂ | σ < s.re})
    (ρ : ℂ) (hρ : σ < ρ.re) (hρone : ρ ≠ 1)

name: OAI.CompactMellinBridge.pair_zero_free_of_weighted_identity_principal_left
statement:

statement:
theorem tsum_dvd_shift {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N)
    (b : ℕ → ℂ) (φ : ℕ → ℂ) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, if N ∣ n then b (n / N) * φ n else 0) =
      ∑' m : ℕ, b m * φ (N * m)

name: OAI.FiniteEulerRestoration.tsum_restore_one_prime
statement:
theorem tsum_restore_one_prime {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N)
    (c : ℂ) (a b φ : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hcoeff : ∀ n, a n = b n + if N ∣ n then c * b (n / N) else 0)
    (hb : Summable (fun n => b n * φ n))
    (hshift : Summable (fun m => b m * φ (N * m))) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, a n * φ n) =
      (∑' n : ℕ, b n * φ n) +
        c * (∑' m : ℕ, b m * φ (N * m))

name: OAI.FiniteEulerRestoration.tsum_restore_one_prime_exp
statement:
theorem tsum_restore_one_prime_exp {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N)
    (c : ℂ) (a b : ℕ → ℂ) (t : ℝ)
    (hcoeff : ∀ n, a n = b n + if N ∣ n then c * b (n / N) else 0)
    (hb : Summable (fun n => b n * Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) * t)))
    (hscaled : Summable (fun m => b m * Real.exp (-(m : ℝ) * ((N : ℝ) * t)))) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, a n * Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) * t)) =
      (∑' n : ℕ, b n * Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) * t)) +
        c * (∑' m : ℕ, b m * Real.exp (-(m : ℝ) * ((N : ℝ) * t)))

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ResidueCharacter.inflate_apply
statement:
theorem inflate_apply {M L : Ideal A} (hML : M ≤ L) (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ L) ℂ)
    (x : A ⧸ M) :
    inflate hML χ x = if IsUnit x then χ (Ideal.Quotient.factor hML x) else 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ResidueCharacter.inflate_apply_unit
statement:
theorem inflate_apply_unit {M L : Ideal A} (hML : M ≤ L) (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ L) ℂ)
    (u : (A ⧸ M)ˣ) :
    inflate hML χ u = χ (Ideal.Quotient.factor hML (u : A ⧸ M))

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ResidueCharacter.inflate_factorsThrough
statement:
theorem inflate_factorsThrough {M L : Ideal A} [Finite (A ⧸ M)]
    (hML : M ≤ L) (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ L) ℂ) :
    FactorsThroughIdeal (inflate hML χ) (L.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk M))

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ResidueCharacter.inflate_global_units
statement:
theorem inflate_global_units {M L : Ideal A} (hML : M ≤ L) (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ L) ℂ)
    (hχ : ∀ u : Aˣ, χ (Ideal.Quotient.mk L u) = 1) :
    ∀ u : Aˣ, inflate hML χ (Ideal.Quotient.mk M u) = 1

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ResidueCharacter.inflate_mk
statement:
theorem inflate_mk {M L : Ideal A} (hML : M ≤ L) (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ L) ℂ) (a : A) :
    inflate hML χ (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a) =
      if IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a) then χ (Ideal.Quotient.mk L a) else 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ResidueCharacter.inflate_toUnitHom
statement:
theorem inflate_toUnitHom {M L : Ideal A} (hML : M ≤ L) (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ L) ℂ) :
    (inflate hML χ).toUnitHom =
      χ.toUnitHom.comp (Units.map (Ideal.Quotient.factor hML).toMonoidHom)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ResidueCharacter.inflate_trans
statement:
theorem inflate_trans {M L K : Ideal A} (hML : M ≤ L) (hLK : L ≤ K)
    (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ K) ℂ) :
    inflate hML (inflate hLK χ) = inflate (hML.trans hLK) χ

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ResidueCharacter.isUnit_mk_inf_iff
statement:
theorem isUnit_mk_inf_iff (I J : Ideal A) (a : A) :
    IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ⊓ J) a) ↔
      IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a) ∧ IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk J a)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ResidueCharacter.product_global_units
statement:
theorem product_global_units (I J : Ideal A) (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ I) ℂ)
    (ψ : MulChar (A ⧸ J) ℂ)
    (hχ : ∀ u : Aˣ, χ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I u) = 1)
    (hψ : ∀ u : Aˣ, ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk J u) = 1) :
    ∀ u : Aˣ, product I J χ ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ⊓ J) u) = 1

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ResidueCharacter.product_mk
statement:
theorem product_mk (I J : Ideal A) (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ I) ℂ) (ψ : MulChar (A ⧸ J) ℂ)
    (a : A) :
    product I J χ ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ⊓ J) a) =
      χ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a) * ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk J a)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.HeckeFamily.elementCoeff_inverse
statement:
theorem elementCoeff_inverse (χ : Character) (z : O) :
    elementCoeff χ.inverse z = (elementCoeff χ z)⁻¹

name: OAI.SevenEighths.HeckeFamily.elementCoeff_power_of_unit
statement:
theorem elementCoeff_power_of_unit (χ : Character) (n : ℕ) (z : O)
    (hz : IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk χ.modulus z)) :
    elementCoeff (χ.power n) z = elementCoeff χ z ^ n

name: OAI.SevenEighths.HeckeFamily.elementCoeff_product
statement:
theorem elementCoeff_product (χ ψ : Character) (z : O) :
    elementCoeff (χ.product ψ) z = elementCoeff χ z * elementCoeff ψ z

name: OAI.SevenEighths.IdealCharacter.isUnit_mk_iff_isCoprime
statement:
theorem isUnit_mk_iff_isCoprime (M : Ideal A) (a : A) :
    IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a) ↔ IsCoprime (Ideal.span ({a} : Set A)) M

name: OAI.SevenEighths.IdealCharacter.norm_ofResidue_le_one
statement:
theorem norm_ofResidue_le_one (M : Ideal A) [Finite (A ⧸ M)]
    (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ) (hχ : UnitInvariant M χ) (I : Ideal A) :
    ‖ofResidue M χ hχ I‖ ≤ 1

name: OAI.SevenEighths.IdealCharacter.norm_residue_le_one

name: OAI.SevenEighths.IdealCharacter.ofResidue_bot
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofResidue_bot (M : Ideal A) (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ)
    (hχ : UnitInvariant M χ) : ofResidue M χ hχ ⊥ = 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.IdealCharacter.ofResidue_finite_deletion
statement:
theorem ofResidue_finite_deletion (M K : Ideal A)
    (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ) (φ : MulChar (A ⧸ K) ℂ)
    (hχ : UnitInvariant M χ) (hφ : UnitInvariant K φ)
    (hmask : ∀ a : A, χ (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a) =
      if IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a) then φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk K a) else 0)
    (I : Ideal A) :
    ofResidue M χ hχ I =
      ofResidue M 1 (one_unitInvariant M) I * ofResidue K φ hφ I

name: OAI.SevenEighths.IdealCharacter.ofResidue_of_generator
statement:
theorem ofResidue_of_generator (M : Ideal A) (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ)
    (hχ : UnitInvariant M χ) {I : Ideal A} (hI : I ≠ ⊥) {a : A}
    (ha : Ideal.span ({a} : Set A) = I) :
    ofResidue M χ hχ I = χ (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.IdealCharacter.ofResidue_one
statement:
theorem ofResidue_one (M : Ideal A) (I : Ideal A) :
    ofResidue M 1 (one_unitInvariant M) I =
      if I = ⊥ then 0 else if IsCoprime I M then 1 else 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.IdealCharacter.ofResidue_one_top
statement:
theorem ofResidue_one_top (I : Ideal A) :
    ofResidue (⊤ : Ideal A) 1 (one_unitInvariant ⊤) I = if I = ⊥ then 0 else 1

name: OAI.SevenEighths.IdealCharacter.ofResidue_product
statement:
theorem ofResidue_product (M N : Ideal A)
    (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ) (ψ : MulChar (A ⧸ N) ℂ)
    (hχ : UnitInvariant M χ) (hψ : UnitInvariant N ψ) (I : Ideal A) :
    ofResidue (M ⊓ N) (ResidueCharacter.product M N χ ψ)
        (ResidueCharacter.product_global_units M N χ ψ hχ hψ) I =
      ofResidue M χ hχ I * ofResidue N ψ hψ I

name: OAI.SevenEighths.IdealCharacter.ofResidue_source_mask
statement:
theorem ofResidue_source_mask (M K : Ideal A)
    (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ) (φ : MulChar (A ⧸ K) ℂ)
    (hχ : UnitInvariant M χ) (hφ : UnitInvariant K φ)
    (hmask : ∀ a : A, χ (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a) =
      if IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a) then φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk K a) else 0)
    (I : Ideal A) :
    ofResidue M χ hχ I = if IsCoprime I M then ofResidue K φ hφ I else 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.IdealCharacter.ofResidue_span
statement:
theorem ofResidue_span (M : Ideal A) (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ) (hχ : UnitInvariant M χ)
    {a : A} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    ofResidue M χ hχ (Ideal.span ({a} : Set A)) = χ (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.IdealCharacter.one_unitInvariant
statement: theorem one_unitInvariant (M : Ideal A) : UnitInvariant M (1 : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.IdealCharacter.residue_eq_of_associated
statement:
theorem residue_eq_of_associated (M : Ideal A) (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseInitialMarkedReserve.exists_reserve
statement:
theorem exists_reserve (εm:ℝ)(hε:0<εm):
    ∃ρ gap η τ π eps loss:ℝ,
      0<ρ ∧ ρ≤1/4 ∧ ρ≤εm/4 ∧
      0<gap ∧ 2*gap≤ρ ∧
      0<η ∧ η≤1/7 ∧ η≤gap/50 ∧
      0<τ ∧ τ≤gap/50 ∧ 0<π ∧ 0<eps ∧ 0<loss ∧
      ρ+15*η+π+eps+loss≤εm

name: OAI.SevenEighths.InverseInitialMarkedReserve.shifted_capacity
statement:
theorem shifted_capacity (ρ gap η r r' ell G:ℝ)
    (hρ:0<ρ)(hρmax:ρ≤1/4)(hgap:2*gap≤ρ)
    (hη:0<η)(hηmax:η≤1/7)(hr:0≤r)(hell:0≤ell)
    (_hG:0≤G)(hGmax:G≤ell)(hlo:r-η≤r')(hhi:r'≤r)
    (hfirst:r+2*ell<1)(hsecond:2*r+8*ell<3):
    0≤1+ρ ∧ 1+ρ≤2 ∧ -2≤r'+ell-2*G ∧
      r'+2*ell≤(1+ρ)-2*gap ∧
      2*r'+8*ell≤3*(1+ρ)-2*gap ∧
      r'+ell+7*η≤2

name: OAI.SevenEighths.LogarithmicControl.borel_caratheodory_closedBall
statement:
theorem borel_caratheodory_closedBall {g : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℂ} {r R M A : ℝ}

name: OAI.SevenEighths.LogarithmicControl.inner_log_bound
statement:
theorem inner_log_bound {g : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℂ} {a e A M T : ℝ}
    (ha : 1 / 2 ≤ a) (ha' : a ≤ 1) (he : 0 < e) (he' : e < 1 / 1000)
    (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hT : 1 ≤ T)
    (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g (ball c (2 - a - 2 * e)))
    (hRe : ∀ z ∈ ball c (2 - a - 3 * e), (g z).re ≤ M * T)
    (hin : ∀ z ∈ closedBall c (49 / 100), ‖g z‖ ≤ A)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ closedBall c (2 - a - 6 * e)) :
    ‖g z‖ ≤ A * outerConstant e A M * T ^ uniformTheta e

name: OAI.SevenEighths.LogarithmicControl.logarithm_derivative_bound
statement:
theorem logarithm_derivative_bound {g : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℂ} {a e A M T : ℝ}
    (ha : 1 / 2 ≤ a) (ha' : a ≤ 1) (he : 0 < e) (he' : e < 1 / 1000)
    (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hT : 1 ≤ T)
    (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g (ball c (2 - a - 2 * e)))
    (hRe : ∀ z ∈ ball c (2 - a - 3 * e), (g z).re ≤ M * T)
    (hc : ‖g c‖ ≤ A) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ closedBall c (2 - a - 8 * e)) :
    ‖deriv g z‖ ≤ (outerConstant e A M / (2 * e)) * T

name: OAI.SevenEighths.LogarithmicControl.logarithmic_control
statement:
theorem logarithmic_control {e A M ε : ℝ}
    (he : 0 < e) (he' : e < 1 / 1000) (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ ∀ (a C : ℝ) (L E : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ),
      1 / 2 ≤ a → a ≤ 1 → Real.exp 1 ≤ C →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ L (ball c (2 - a - 2 * e)) →
      (∀ z ∈ ball c (2 - a - 2 * e), L z ≠ 0) →
      (∀ z ∈ ball c (2 - a - 3 * e), ‖L z‖ ≤ C ^ M) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ E (ball c (1 / 2)) →
      EqOn (Complex.exp ∘ E) L (ball c (1 / 2)) →
      (∀ z ∈ closedBall c (49 / 100), ‖E z‖ ≤ A) →
      (∀ z ∈ closedBall c (2 - a - 6 * e), ‖L z‖ + ‖(L z)⁻¹‖ ≤ D * C ^ ε) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ closedBall c (2 - a - 8 * e),
        ‖deriv L z / L z‖ ≤ (outerConstant e A M / (2 * e)) * Real.log C)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.LogarithmicControl.logarithmic_derivative_eq

name: OAI.SevenEighths.LogarithmicControl.three_circles
statement:
theorem three_circles {g : ℂ → ℂ} {c z : ℂ} {r R S A B : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hrR : r < R) (hRS : R < S)
    (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g (ball c S))
    (ha : ∀ w ∈ closedBall c r, ‖g w‖ ≤ A)
    (hb : ∀ w ∈ closedBall c R, ‖g w‖ ≤ B)
    (hzr : r ≤ ‖z - c‖) (hzR : ‖z - c‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖g z‖ ≤ A ^ (1 - (Real.log ‖z - c‖ - Real.log r) /
      (Real.log R - Real.log r)) *
      B ^ ((Real.log ‖z - c‖ - Real.log r) / (Real.log R - Real.log r))

name: OAI.SevenEighths.LogarithmicControl.three_circles_exponent_uniform
statement:

    (ha : 1 / 2 ≤ a) (ha' : a ≤ 1) (he : 0 < e) (he' : e < 1 / 1000) :
    (Real.log (2 - a - 6 * e) - Real.log (49 / 100)) /
      (Real.log (2 - a - 4 * e) - Real.log (49 / 100)) ≤ uniformTheta e

statement:

    (hr : 0 < r) (hrρ : r < ρ) (hρR : ρ < R) (hRS : R < S)
    (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hB : 1 ≤ B) (hT : 1 ≤ T)
    (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g (ball c S))
    (ha : ∀ w ∈ closedBall c r, ‖g w‖ ≤ A)
    (hb : ∀ w ∈ closedBall c R, ‖g w‖ ≤ B * T)
    (hz : z ∈ closedBall c ρ) :
    ‖g z‖ ≤ A * B * T ^ ((Real.log ρ - Real.log r) /
      (Real.log R - Real.log r))

name: OAI.SevenEighths.LogarithmicControl.zero_free_disk_logarithm
statement:
theorem zero_free_disk_logarithm {L E : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℂ} {a e A M C : ℝ}
    (ha' : a ≤ 1) (he : 0 < e) (he' : e < 1 / 1000) (hC : 0 < C)
    (hL : DifferentiableOn ℂ L (ball c (2 - a - 2 * e)))
    (h0 : ∀ z ∈ ball c (2 - a - 2 * e), L z ≠ 0)
    (hpoly : ∀ z ∈ ball c (2 - a - 3 * e), ‖L z‖ ≤ C ^ M)
    (hE : DifferentiableOn ℂ E (ball c (1 / 2)))
    (hEL : EqOn (Complex.exp ∘ E) L (ball c (1 / 2)))
    (hEb : ∀ z ∈ closedBall c (49 / 100), ‖E z‖ ≤ A) :
    ∃ g : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ g (ball c (2 - a - 2 * e)) ∧
      EqOn (Complex.exp ∘ g) L (ball c (2 - a - 2 * e)) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ closedBall c (49 / 100), ‖g z‖ ≤ A) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ ball c (2 - a - 3 * e), (g z).re ≤ M * Real.log C)

name: OAI.TwoPassProfiles.first_dyadic_profile
statement:
theorem first_dyadic_profile
    (K₀ y₀ d₀ f₀ E₀ t₀ c₀ x₁₀ x₂₀
      k y d f E t c x₁ x₂ : ℝ)
    (hK₀ : K₀ ≠ 0) (hy₀ : y₀ ≠ 0) (hd₀ : d₀ ≠ 0)
    (hf₀ : f₀ ≠ 0) (hE₀ : E₀ ≠ 0) (ht₀ : t₀ ≠ 0)
    (hc₀ : c₀ ≠ 0) (hx₁₀ : x₁₀ ≠ 0) (hx₂₀ : x₂₀ ≠ 0)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hy : 0 < y) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hf : 0 < f) (hE : 0 < E) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hx₁ : 0 < x₁) (hx₂ : 0 < x₂) :
    (K₀ * k) * (y₀ * y) /
      ((d₀ * d) * (f₀ * f) ^ 2 * (E₀ * E) *
        (t₀ * t) ^ 2 * (c₀ * c) * (x₁₀ * x₁) * (x₂₀ * x₂)) =
      (K₀ * y₀ /
        (d₀ * f₀ ^ 2 * E₀ * t₀ ^ 2 * c₀ * x₁₀ * x₂₀)) *
        Real.exp (∑ j : Fin 9,
          firstCoeff j * firstLogs k y d f E t c x₁ x₂ j)

name: OAI.TwoPassProfiles.first_logsum
statement:
theorem first_logsum
    (K y d f E t c x₁ x₂ : ℝ) :
    (∑ j : Fin 9, firstCoeff j * firstLogs K y d f E t c x₁ x₂ j) =
      Real.log K + Real.log y - Real.log d -
      2 * Real.log f - Real.log E - 2 * Real.log t -
      Real.log c - Real.log x₁ - Real.log x₂

name: OAI.TwoPassProfiles.first_poisson_profile
statement:
theorem first_poisson_profile
    (K h d f E t c x₁ x₂ : ℝ)
    (hd : d ≠ 0) (hf : f ≠ 0) (hE : E ≠ 0)
    (ht : t ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hx₁ : x₁ ≠ 0) (hx₂ : x₂ ≠ 0) :
    K * h / (d * (t * x₁) * (t * x₂) * c) =
      K * (h * f ^ 2 * E) /
        (d * f ^ 2 * E * t ^ 2 * c * x₁ * x₂)

name: OAI.TwoPassProfiles.first_profile_exp
statement:
theorem first_profile_exp
    (K y d f E t c x₁ x₂ : ℝ)
    (hK : 0 < K) (hy : 0 < y) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hf : 0 < f) (hE : 0 < E) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hx₁ : 0 < x₁) (hx₂ : 0 < x₂) :
    K * y / (d * f ^ 2 * E * t ^ 2 * c * x₁ * x₂) =
      Real.exp (∑ j : Fin 9,
        firstCoeff j * firstLogs K y d f E t c x₁ x₂ j)

name: OAI.TwoPassProfiles.first_profile_logshape
statement:
theorem first_profile_logshape
    (K y d f E t c x₁ x₂ : ℝ)
    (hK : 0 < K) (hy : 0 < y) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hf : 0 < f) (hE : 0 < E) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hx₁ : 0 < x₁) (hx₂ : 0 < x₂) :
    Real.log (K * y / (d * f ^ 2 * E * t ^ 2 * c * x₁ * x₂)) =
      Real.log K + Real.log y - Real.log d -
      2 * Real.log f - Real.log E - 2 * Real.log t -
      Real.log c - Real.log x₁ - Real.log x₂

name: OAI.TwoPassProfiles.second_dyadic_profile
statement:
theorem second_dyadic_profile
    (Y₀ k₀ d₀ e₀ v₀ n₁₀ n₂₀
      y k d e v n₁ n₂ : ℝ)
    (hY₀ : Y₀ ≠ 0) (hk₀ : k₀ ≠ 0) (hd₀ : d₀ ≠ 0)
    (he₀ : e₀ ≠ 0) (hv₀ : v₀ ≠ 0)
    (hn₁₀ : n₁₀ ≠ 0) (hn₂₀ : n₂₀ ≠ 0)
    (hy : 0 < y) (hk : 0 < k) (hd : 0 < d)
    (he : 0 < e) (hv : 0 < v)
    (hn₁ : 0 < n₁) (hn₂ : 0 < n₂) :
    (Y₀ * y) * (k₀ * k) /
      ((d₀ * d) * (e₀ * e) ^ 2 * (v₀ * v) ^ 2 *
        (n₁₀ * n₁) * (n₂₀ * n₂)) =
      (Y₀ * k₀ /
        (d₀ * e₀ ^ 2 * v₀ ^ 2 * n₁₀ * n₂₀)) *
        Real.exp (∑ j : Fin 7,
          secondCoeff j * secondLogs y k d e v n₁ n₂ j)

name: OAI.TwoPassProfiles.second_logsum
statement:
theorem second_logsum
    (Y k d e v n₁ n₂ : ℝ) :
    (∑ j : Fin 7, secondCoeff j * secondLogs Y k d e v n₁ n₂ j) =
      Real.log Y + Real.log k - Real.log d -
      2 * Real.log e - 2 * Real.log v -
      Real.log n₁ - Real.log n₂

name: OAI.TwoPassProfiles.second_poisson_profile
statement:
theorem second_poisson_profile
    (Y k'' d e v n₁ n₂ : ℝ)
    (hd : d ≠ 0) (he : e ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hn₁ : n₁ ≠ 0) (hn₂ : n₂ ≠ 0) :
    Y * k'' / (e * (v * n₁) * (v * n₂)) =
      Y * (d * e * k'') / (d * e ^ 2 * v ^ 2 * n₁ * n₂)

name: OAI.TwoPassProfiles.second_profile_exp
statement:
theorem second_profile_exp
    (Y k d e v n₁ n₂ : ℝ)
    (hY : 0 < Y) (hk : 0 < k) (hd : 0 < d)
    (he : 0 < e) (hv : 0 < v)
    (hn₁ : 0 < n₁) (hn₂ : 0 < n₂) :
    Y * k / (d * e ^ 2 * v ^ 2 * n₁ * n₂) =
      Real.exp (∑ j : Fin 7,
        secondCoeff j * secondLogs Y k d e v n₁ n₂ j)

name: OAI.TwoPassProfiles.second_profile_logshape
statement:
theorem second_profile_logshape
    (Y k d e v n₁ n₂ : ℝ)
    (hY : 0 < Y) (hk : 0 < k) (hd : 0 < d)
    (he : 0 < e) (hv : 0 < v)
    (hn₁ : 0 < n₁) (hn₂ : 0 < n₂) :
    Real.log (Y * k / (d * e ^ 2 * v ^ 2 * n₁ * n₂)) =
      Real.log Y + Real.log k - Real.log d -
      2 * Real.log e - 2 * Real.log v -
      Real.log n₁ - Real.log n₂

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMoment.MaskedCharacter.value_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem MaskedCharacter.value_mul (d : MaskedCharacter M R) (a b : M) :
