name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMoment.centered_error_identity
statement:
theorem centered_error_identity (A₁ A₂ B₁ B₂ a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ℂ)
    (hmain : a₁ * a₂ = b₁ * b₂) :
    A₁ * A₂ - B₁ * B₂ =
      (A₁ - a₁) * A₂ + a₁ * (A₂ - a₂) -
        (B₁ - b₁) * B₂ - b₁ * (B₂ - b₂)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMoment.centered_saving_of_approx
statement:
theorem centered_saving_of_approx
    (A₁ A₂ B₁ B₂ a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ℂ)
    (X₁ X₂ Y₁ Y₂ T L C E : ℝ)
    (hmain : a₁ * a₂ = b₁ * b₂)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (hA₁ : ‖A₁ - a₁‖ ≤ E) (hA₂ : ‖A₂ - a₂‖ ≤ E)
    (hB₁ : ‖B₁ - b₁‖ ≤ E) (hB₂ : ‖B₂ - b₂‖ ≤ E)
    (hvA₂ : ‖A₂‖ ≤ C * X₂) (hva₁ : ‖a₁‖ ≤ C * X₁)
    (hvB₂ : ‖B₂‖ ≤ C * Y₂) (hvb₁ : ‖b₁‖ ≤ C * Y₁)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hX₁ : L ≤ X₁) (hX₂ : L ≤ X₂)
    (hY₁ : L ≤ Y₁) (hY₂ : L ≤ Y₂)
    (hprodX : X₁ * X₂ = T) (hprodY : Y₁ * Y₂ = T) :
    ‖A₁ * A₂ - B₁ * B₂‖ ≤ 4 * E * C * (T / L)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMoment.centered_volume_fallback
statement:
theorem centered_volume_fallback (A₁ A₂ B₁ B₂ : ℂ)
    (X₁ X₂ Y₁ Y₂ T C : ℝ)
    (hA₁ : ‖A₁‖ ≤ C * X₁) (hA₂ : ‖A₂‖ ≤ C * X₂)
    (hB₁ : ‖B₁‖ ≤ C * Y₁) (hB₂ : ‖B₂‖ ≤ C * Y₂)
    (hprodX : X₁ * X₂ = T) (hprodY : Y₁ * Y₂ = T) :
    ‖A₁ * A₂ - B₁ * B₂‖ ≤ 2 * C ^ 2 * T

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMoment.coefficient_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem coefficient_mul (d : MaskedCharacter M R) (N : M →* ℝ≥0)
    (t : ℝ) (a b : M) :
    coefficient d N t (a * b) = coefficient d N t a * coefficient d N t b

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMoment.extracted_volume_phase
statement:
theorem extracted_volume_phase (X D t : ℝ) (hX : 0 ≤ X) (hD : 0 < D) :
    (D : ℂ) ^ (Complex.I * t) * ((X / D : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ (1 + Complex.I * t) =
      (X : ℂ) ^ (1 + Complex.I * t) / (D : ℂ)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMoment.extracted_volume_sum
statement:
theorem extracted_volume_sum {D : Type*} (s : Finset D) (a : D → ℂ)
    (norm : D → ℝ) (hnorm : ∀ d ∈ s, 0 < norm d)
    (c I : ℂ) (t X : ℝ) (hX : 0 ≤ X) :
    (∑ d ∈ s, a d * (norm d : ℂ) ^ (Complex.I * t) *
      volumeTerm c I t (X / norm d)) =
      volumeTerm (c * ∑ d ∈ s, a d / (norm d : ℂ)) I t X

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMoment.normTwist_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem normTwist_mul (N : M →* ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ) (a b : M) :

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMoment.norm_centered_le
statement:
theorem norm_centered_le (A₁ A₂ B₁ B₂ a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ℂ)
    (hmain : a₁ * a₂ = b₁ * b₂) :
    ‖A₁ * A₂ - B₁ * B₂‖ ≤
      ‖A₁ - a₁‖ * ‖A₂‖ + ‖a₁‖ * ‖A₂ - a₂‖ +
        ‖B₁ - b₁‖ * ‖B₂‖ + ‖b₁‖ * ‖B₂ - b₂‖

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMoment.norm_centered_le_of_approx
statement:
theorem norm_centered_le_of_approx
    (A₁ A₂ B₁ B₂ a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ℂ)
    (X₁ X₂ Y₁ Y₂ C E : ℝ)
    (hmain : a₁ * a₂ = b₁ * b₂)
    (hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (hA₁ : ‖A₁ - a₁‖ ≤ E) (hA₂ : ‖A₂ - a₂‖ ≤ E)
    (hB₁ : ‖B₁ - b₁‖ ≤ E) (hB₂ : ‖B₂ - b₂‖ ≤ E)
    (hvA₂ : ‖A₂‖ ≤ C * X₂) (hva₁ : ‖a₁‖ ≤ C * X₁)
    (hvB₂ : ‖B₂‖ ≤ C * Y₂) (hvb₁ : ‖b₁‖ ≤ C * Y₁) :
    ‖A₁ * A₂ - B₁ * B₂‖ ≤ E * C * (X₁ + X₂ + Y₁ + Y₂)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMoment.normalized_centered_saving

    ‖(Real.sqrt T : ℂ)⁻¹ * D‖ ≤ 4 * E * C * (Real.sqrt T / L)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMoment.ofResidueMask_keep_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofResidueMask_keep_one {S : Type*} [CommRing S]

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMoment.rectangle_sum_eq
statement:
theorem rectangle_sum_eq (d : MaskedCharacter M R) (N : M →* ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ)
    (s₁ s₂ : Finset M) (W₁ W₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (X₁ X₂ Y₁ Y₂ : ℝ) :
    (∑ a ∈ s₁, ∑ b ∈ s₂,
      coefficient d N t (a * b) * rectangle N W₁ W₂ X₁ X₂ Y₁ Y₂ a b) =
      plainSum d N t s₁ W₁ X₁ * plainSum d N t s₂ W₂ X₂ -
        plainSum d N t s₁ W₁ Y₁ * plainSum d N t s₂ W₂ Y₂

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMoment.scale_le_product_div
OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMoment.slot_rectangle_sum_eq
statement:
theorem slot_rectangle_sum_eq (d : MaskedCharacter M R) (N : M →* ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ)
    (p : M) (s₁ s₂ : Finset M) (W₁ W₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (X₁ X₂ Y₁ Y₂ : ℝ) :
    (∑ a ∈ s₁, ∑ b ∈ s₂,
      coefficient d N t (p * (a * b)) * rectangle N W₁ W₂ X₁ X₂ Y₁ Y₂ a b) =
      coefficient d N t p *
        (plainSum d N t s₁ W₁ X₁ * plainSum d N t s₂ W₂ X₂ -
          plainSum d N t s₁ W₁ Y₁ * plainSum d N t s₂ W₂ Y₂)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMoment.sum_scales_le
statement:
theorem sum_scales_le {X₁ X₂ Y₁ Y₂ T L : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (hX₁ : L ≤ X₁) (hX₂ : L ≤ X₂)
    (hY₁ : L ≤ Y₁) (hY₂ : L ≤ Y₂)
    (hprodX : X₁ * X₂ = T) (hprodY : Y₁ * Y₂ = T) :
    X₁ + X₂ + Y₁ + Y₂ ≤ 4 * (T / L)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMoment.volume_products_eq
statement:
theorem volume_products_eq (c I₁ I₂ : ℂ) (t X₁ X₂ Y₁ Y₂ : ℝ)
    (hX₁ : 0 ≤ X₁) (hX₂ : 0 ≤ X₂) (hY₁ : 0 ≤ Y₁) (hY₂ : 0 ≤ Y₂)
    (hscale : X₁ * X₂ = Y₁ * Y₂) :
    volumeTerm c I₁ t X₁ * volumeTerm c I₂ t X₂ =
      volumeTerm c I₁ t Y₁ * volumeTerm c I₂ t Y₂

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.crtCharacter_apply
OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.fullCorrelation_idealCRT
statement:
theorem fullCorrelation_idealCRT {S ι : Type*} [CommRing S] [Fintype ι]
    (I : ι → Ideal S) (hI : Pairwise (Function.onFun IsCoprime I))
    [Fintype (S ⧸ ⨅ i, I i)] [∀ i, Fintype (S ⧸ I i)]
    (u v k : S ⧸ ⨅ i, I i) (f g : ∀ i, S ⧸ I i → ℂ) :
    let e := Ideal.quotientInfRingEquivPiQuotient I hI
    fullCorrelation (fun x => v * x) (fun y => u * y)
        (fun x => ∏ i, f i (e x i)) (fun y => ∏ i, g i (e y i)) k =
      ∏ i, fullCorrelation (fun x => e v i * x) (fun y => e u i * y)
        (f i) (g i) (e k i)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.fullCorrelation_pi
statement:
theorem fullCorrelation_pi {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {R : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, CommRing (R i)] [∀ i, Fintype (R i)]
    (u v k : ∀ i, R i) (f g : ∀ i, R i → ℂ) :
    fullCorrelation (fun x => v * x) (fun y => u * y)
        (fun x => ∏ i, f i (x i)) (fun y => ∏ i, g i (y i)) k =
      ∏ i, fullCorrelation (fun x => v i * x) (fun y => u i * y) (f i) (g i) (k i)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.fullCorrelation_product
statement:
theorem fullCorrelation_product (u v k : A × B) (f₁ g₁ : A → ℂ) (f₂ g₂ : B → ℂ) :
    fullCorrelation (fun x => v * x) (fun y => u * y)
        (fun x => f₁ x.1 * f₂ x.2) (fun y => g₁ y.1 * g₂ y.2) k =
      fullCorrelation (fun x => v.1 * x) (fun y => u.1 * y) f₁ g₁ k.1 *
        fullCorrelation (fun x => v.2 * x) (fun y => u.2 * y) f₂ g₂ k.2

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.fullCorrelation_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem fullCorrelation_ringEquiv (e : A ≃+* B) (u v k : A) (f g : B → ℂ) :
    fullCorrelation (fun x => v * x) (fun y => u * y)
        (fun x => f (e x)) (fun y => g (e y)) k =
      fullCorrelation (fun x => e v * x) (fun y => e u * y) f g (e k)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.primePowerCharacter_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem primePowerCharacter_apply (P : Ideal (𝓞 K)) {c : ℕ} (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (χ : MulChar (𝓞 K ⧸ P) ℂ) (x : 𝓞 K ⧸ P ^ c) :
    primePowerCharacter P hc χ x = χ (primePowerReduction P hc x)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CenteredMomentCorrelation.primePowerReduction_surjective
statement:
theorem primePowerReduction_surjective (P : Ideal (𝓞 K)) {c : ℕ} (hc : 1 ≤ c) :

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Parameters.cumulative_frequency_bound
statement:
theorem cumulative_frequency_bound {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)

    (hfreq : ∀ i ∈ s, |frequency i| ≤ T / (4 * s.card)) :

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Parameters.exists_height_cutoff
statement:
theorem exists_height_cutoff {dmin allowance A : ℝ}
    (hd : 0 < dmin) (ha : 0 < allowance) (hA : 0 ≤ A) :
    ∃ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ ∧ τ < dmin / 100 ∧
      A * τ < dmin * allowance / 100

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Parameters.exists_tail_order
statement:
theorem exists_tail_order {τ B saving : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, B - τ * N < -saving

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Parameters.exists_distinct_slot_lengths
statement:
theorem exists_distinct_slot_lengths (L : ℝ) (hL : 0<L) :
    ∃N : ℕ,0<N ∧ ∃ell : Fin N→ℝ,Function.Injective ell ∧
      (∀j,0<ell j ∧ ell j<L) ∧ (∑j,ell j)=1/6

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Parameters.exists_physical_slot_lengths
statement:
theorem exists_physical_slot_lengths (dmin dmax mesh R : ℝ)
    (hdmin : 0<dmin) (hd : dmin≤dmax) (hm : 0<mesh) (hR : 0<R) :
    ∃N : ℕ,0<N ∧ ∃ell : Fin N→ℝ,∃rmin : ℝ,0<rmin ∧
      Function.Injective ell ∧ (∑j,ell j)=1/6 ∧
      (∀j,0<ell j ∧ dmax*rmin≤ell j ∧ ell j≤dmin*mesh ∧ ell j≤dmin*R) ∧
      (∀d : ℝ,dmin≤d → d≤dmax → ∀j,rmin≤ell j/d ∧ ell j/d≤mesh ∧ ell j/d≤R)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Parameters.exists_detector_scales
statement:
theorem exists_detector_scales (R rmin mesh dmin loss ellMin allowance J : ℝ)
    (hR : 0≤R) (hr : 0<rmin) (hm : 0<mesh) (hd : 0<dmin)
    (hl : 0<loss) (hell : 0<ellMin) (ha : 0<allowance) (hJ : 0≤J) :
    ∃ε e κ cost τ : ℝ,
      0<ε ∧ ε≤1/1000 ∧ ε<rmin*mesh ∧ ε≤allowance ∧
      0<e ∧ e<1/1000 ∧ e≤ellMin/4 ∧ e≤allowance ∧
      0<κ ∧ κ≤1 ∧ 0<cost ∧
      12*e*(22+2)+8*κ+2*cost≤ε/2 ∧
      8*e*R+κ≤ε ∧
      0<τ ∧ τ<dmin/2 ∧ 4*τ<dmin*cost ∧
      2*τ*(1+J)≤loss ∧ ∀eps : ℝ,0≤eps → eps≤1 → τ*(2+4*eps)<loss

name: OAI.SevenEighths.PeriodicThetaRegularity.scaledTheta_rapid

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.average_characters
statement:
theorem average_characters (H : Subgroup Rˣ) (r : R) :
    (∑ χ : characters H, (χ : MulChar R ℂ) r) / (Nat.card (Rˣ ⧸ H) : ℂ) =
      if inUnitSubgroup H r then 1 else 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.average_idealCharacters
statement:
theorem average_idealCharacters (I : Ideal A) :
    (∑ χ : rayCharacters M, idealCharacter M χ I) / (rayCard M : ℂ) =
      if I ∈ principalIdeals M then 1 else 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.average_rayCharacters
statement:
theorem average_rayCharacters (r : A ⧸ M) :
    (∑ χ : rayCharacters M, (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ) r) / (rayCard M : ℂ) =
      if principalResidue M r then 1 else 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.card_characters
statement:
theorem card_characters (H : Subgroup Rˣ) :
    Fintype.card (characters H) = Nat.card (Rˣ ⧸ H)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.exists_character_ne_one
statement:
theorem exists_character_ne_one (H : Subgroup Rˣ) {u : Rˣ} (hu : u ∉ H) :
    ∃ χ : characters H, (χ : MulChar R ℂ) u ≠ 1

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.idealCharacter_one
statement:
theorem idealCharacter_one (I : Ideal A) :
    idealCharacter M 1 I =
      if I = ⊥ then 0 else if IsCoprime I M then 1 else 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.inUnitSubgroup_globalUnits_iff
statement:
theorem inUnitSubgroup_globalUnits_iff (r : A ⧸ M) :
    inUnitSubgroup (globalUnits M) r ↔ principalResidue M r

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.mem_characters_iff
statement:
theorem mem_characters_iff (H : Subgroup Rˣ) (χ : MulChar R ℂ) :
    χ ∈ characters H ↔ ∀ u ∈ H, χ u = 1

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.mem_rayCharacters_iff
statement:
theorem mem_rayCharacters_iff (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ) :
    χ ∈ rayCharacters M ↔ IdealCharacter.UnitInvariant M χ

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.norm_idealCharacter_le_one
statement:
theorem norm_idealCharacter_le_one (χ : rayCharacters M) (I : Ideal A) :
    ‖idealCharacter M χ I‖ ≤ 1

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.principalIdeals_iff_congruent_one
statement:
theorem principalIdeals_iff_congruent_one (I : Ideal A) :
    I ∈ principalIdeals M ↔ ∃ a : A, a ≠ 0 ∧
      Ideal.span ({a} : Set A) = I ∧ Ideal.Quotient.mk M a = 1

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.principalIdeals_iff_generator
statement:
theorem principalIdeals_iff_generator {I : Ideal A} (hI : I ≠ ⊥) :
    I ∈ principalIdeals M ↔
      principalResidue M (Ideal.Quotient.mk M (Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator I))

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.rayCard_pos
statement: theorem rayCard_pos : 0 < rayCard M

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.ray_card_pos
statement: theorem ray_card_pos (H : Subgroup Rˣ) : 0 < Nat.card (Rˣ ⧸ H)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.sum_characters
statement:
theorem sum_characters (H : Subgroup Rˣ) (r : R) :
    ∑ χ : characters H, (χ : MulChar R ℂ) r =
      if inUnitSubgroup H r then (Nat.card (Rˣ ⧸ H) : ℂ) else 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.sum_characters_unit
statement:
theorem sum_characters_unit (H : Subgroup Rˣ) (u : Rˣ) :
    ∑ χ : characters H, (χ : MulChar R ℂ) u =
      if u ∈ H then (Nat.card (Rˣ ⧸ H) : ℂ) else 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.sum_idealCharacters
statement:
theorem sum_idealCharacters (I : Ideal A) :
    ∑ χ : rayCharacters M, idealCharacter M χ I =
      if I ∈ principalIdeals M then (rayCard M : ℂ) else 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.sum_rayCharacters
statement:
theorem sum_rayCharacters (r : A ⧸ M) :
    ∑ χ : rayCharacters M, (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ) r =
      if principalResidue M r then (rayCard M : ℂ) else 0

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayQuotient.character_unitInvariant
statement:
theorem character_unitInvariant (χ : Characters M H) :
    IdealCharacter.UnitInvariant M χ

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayQuotient.classNumber_pos

name: Tengoku.QuasiRiemann.fourierIntegral_self_add_deriv_deriv
statement:
theorem Tengoku.QuasiRiemann.fourierIntegral_self_add_deriv_deriv (f : W21) (u : ℝ) :
    (1 + u ^ 2) * 𝓕 (f : ℝ → ℂ) u =
      𝓕 (fun u : ℝ => (f u - (1 / (4 * π ^ 2)) * deriv^[2] f u : ℂ)) u
